```tsx
import { CaseDecidedParams, REPLY_AIM_HOURS, RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY, STANDING_RULES, StandingLists, type CaseDecision, type CaseView, type QueueReply, type StaffMe } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { STATEMENT_WORDS, statementParagraphs } from "@korbat/rules";
import type { ReactElement } from "react";
import { renderToStaticMarkup } from "react-dom/server";
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { answerable, answerDraft, decisionParamsOf, newDraft, offeredDraft, previewOf, replyOf, replyState, standingControlState, withAnswer, withdrawable, withdrawDraft, withStanding, type CaseDraft } from "../src/compose";
import { STANDING_WORDS } from "../src/messages";
import { parseCaseId } from "../src/router";
import { AppealsView } from "../src/screens/Appeals";
import { CaseScreenView, type CaseScreenViewProps } from "../src/screens/Case";
import { ComposerView, type ComposerViewProps } from "../src/screens/Composer";
import { OverviewView } from "../src/screens/Home";
import { QueueView, replyWords, type QueueViewProps } from "../src/screens/Queue";
import { StandingView } from "../src/screens/Standing";
import { dateTime } from "../src/ui";
import { CASE_LADDER, CASE_POST, CASE_REPLIED, CASE_WITHDRAW, DECISION_REPLIED, DECISION_WITHDRAW, ladderCase, overview, REPLY_TEXT, repliedCase, withdrawCase } from "./case-fixtures";
import { HOSTILE, hrefs } from "./fixtures";

/**
 * The console's part of announced suspensions, replies and termination (3e design, sections 8.3 and 8.5 to 8.8; Task 4):
 * "Announce a suspension" with its days, "Announce a termination" and "Terminate at once", each offered when the case
 * answer says the database would accept it and greyed with its sentence otherwise ([reports.first] among them); the
 * queue's Replies to answer, which never carry a reply's words; the reply's block on the case page and its answer, Keep
 * or Reverse; "Withdraw it for another measure"; the Standing screen's four lists; the home screen's two lines; and the
 * appeals' order. Pure parts are tested as functions, screens server-rendered.
 */
const html = (element: ReactElement): string => renderToStaticMarkup(element);
const esc = (text: string): string => text.replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;").replace(/"/g, "&quot;").replace(/'/g, "&#x27;");
const noop = () => undefined;
const caseId = (id: string) => parseCaseId(id)!;
const NOW = new Date("2026-10-12T09:30:00.000Z");
const ADMIN: StaffMe["role"] = "admin";
const MODERATOR: StaffMe["role"] = "moderator";
const DIGESTS = { snapshot: "cd".repeat(32), facts: "aa".repeat(32), reason: "bb".repeat(32), legalReference: null };

const final = (view: CaseView, role: StaffMe["role"], change: Partial<CaseDraft> = {}): CaseDraft => ({ ...newDraft(caseId(view.id), view, role), kind: "final", ruleId: "R3", ...change });
const withStandingOf = (view: CaseView, change: Partial<NonNullable<CaseView["standing"]>>): CaseView => ({ ...view, standing: { ...view.standing!, ...change } });

function composer(view: CaseView, role: StaffMe["role"], draft: CaseDraft) {
  const props: ComposerViewProps = { view, role, draft, now: NOW, busy: false, error: null, textErrors: {}, declining: null, onChange: noop, onTextBlur: noop, onSeal: noop, onConfirm: noop, onDeclineOpen: noop, onDeclineChange: noop, onDeclineSave: noop, onDeclineClose: noop, onCancelCorrection: noop };
  return html(<ComposerView {...props} />);
}

/** The case page as a person of this role sees it, with the controls beside each decision. */
function casePage(view: CaseView, role: StaffMe["role"]) {
  const base: CaseScreenViewProps = {
    caseId: caseId(view.id),
    view,
    shownImage: null,
    busy: null,
    notice: null,
    error: null,
    note: "",
    reveal: null,
    onOpenCase: noop,
    onShowImage: noop,
    onShowClearly: noop,
    onHideImage: noop,
    onImageError: noop,
    onSnapshot: noop,
    onNoteChange: noop,
    onNoteSave: noop,
    onRevealOpen: noop,
    onRevealChange: noop,
    onRevealConfirm: noop,
    onRevealClose: noop,
    compose: {
      role,
      draft: newDraft(caseId(view.id), view, role),
      now: NOW,
      busy: false,
      error: null,
      textErrors: {},
      declining: null,
      onChange: noop,
      onTextBlur: noop,
      onSeal: noop,
      onConfirm: noop,
      onDeclineOpen: noop,
      onDeclineChange: noop,
      onDeclineSave: noop,
      onDeclineClose: noop,
      onCancelCorrection: noop,
      onCorrect: noop,
      onReview: noop,
      onAnswer: noop,
      onWithdraw: noop,
    },
  };
  return html(<CaseScreenView {...base} />);
}

/** The decision of a fixture case that holds the measure. */
const decisionOf = (view: CaseView, id: string): CaseDecision => view.decisions.find((decided) => decided.id === id)!;

/** The replied decision with its measure's reply or period changed. */
function repliedWith(change: { reply?: Partial<NonNullable<CaseDecision["actions"][number]["reply"]>>; period?: NonNullable<CaseDecision["actions"][number]["period"]>; needsAdmin?: boolean }): CaseDecision {
  const decided = decisionOf(repliedCase(), DECISION_REPLIED);
  const measure = decided.actions[0]!;
  return {
    ...decided,
    needsAdmin: change.needsAdmin ?? decided.needsAdmin,
    actions: [{ ...measure, reply: { ...measure.reply!, ...change.reply }, period: change.period ?? measure.period }],
  };
}

describe("3e Task 4: the announced measures in the composer of an account case (design, section 8.3)", () => {
  test("the words are the design's, each number printed from STANDING_RULES or REPLY_AIM_HOURS", () => {
    expect(STANDING_WORDS.suspend.label).toBe("Announce a suspension");
    expect(STANDING_WORDS.suspend.short(2)).toBe(`Not open: an announced suspension needs ${STANDING_RULES.ladderStrikes} active strikes. This account has 2.`);
    expect(STANDING_WORDS.terminate.notYet).toContain(`needs ${STANDING_RULES.ladderDays.length} suspensions under the ladder decided in the last ${STANDING_RULES.ladderMemoryDays} days`);
    expect(STANDING_WORDS.terminate.noRepeat).toContain(`a final R5 decision at most ${STANDING_RULES.basisAgeDays} days old`);
    expect(STANDING_WORDS.reply.overAim).toBe(`waiting more than ${REPLY_AIM_HOURS} hours`);
    expect(STANDING_WORDS.lists.reportingRow("someone", 5, 8)).toBe(`@someone: 5 of the 8 rule reports sent in the last ${STANDING_RULES.reportFrameDays} days hold a mark manifestly unfounded.`);
    expect(STANDING_WORDS.home.strikes(2)).toBe(`Accounts at ${STANDING_RULES.ladderStrikes} strikes: 2.`);
    expect(STANDING_WORDS.appealsOrder).toBe("Appeals of a running suspension or of a termination come first.");
  });

  test("each control is open when the case answer says the database would accept it, and greyed with its reason otherwise", () => {
    const view = ladderCase();
    expect(standingControlState(view, MODERATOR, final(view, MODERATOR), "announce")).toEqual({ open: true });
    expect(standingControlState(ladderCase(true), MODERATOR, final(view, MODERATOR), "announce")).toEqual({ open: false, why: "reportsFirst" });
    expect(standingControlState(withStandingOf(view, { live: true }), MODERATOR, final(view, MODERATOR), "announce")).toEqual({ open: false, why: "conflict" });
    expect(standingControlState(withStandingOf(view, { activeStrikes: 2 }), MODERATOR, final(view, MODERATOR), "announce")).toEqual({ open: false, why: "short" });
    expect(standingControlState(withStandingOf(view, { maxDays: null }), MODERATOR, final(view, MODERATOR), "announce")).toEqual({ open: false, why: "stale" });
    // A termination is an admin's: announced at the ladder's end, at once on a second direct threat.
    expect(standingControlState(view, MODERATOR, final(view, MODERATOR), "announceTerminate")).toEqual({ open: false, why: "admin" });
    expect(standingControlState(view, ADMIN, final(view, ADMIN), "announceTerminate")).toEqual({ open: false, why: "notYet" });
    expect(standingControlState(withStandingOf(view, { mayTerminate: true }), ADMIN, final(view, ADMIN), "announceTerminate")).toEqual({ open: true });
    expect(standingControlState(withStandingOf(view, { mayTerminate: true, openReports: true }), ADMIN, final(view, ADMIN), "announceTerminate")).toEqual({ open: false, why: "reportsFirst" });
    expect(standingControlState(view, ADMIN, final(view, ADMIN, { ruleId: "R5" }), "terminateAtOnce")).toEqual({ open: false, why: "noRepeat" });
    expect(standingControlState(withStandingOf(view, { atOnce: ["threat_repeat"] }), ADMIN, final(view, ADMIN, { ruleId: "R5" }), "terminateAtOnce")).toEqual({ open: true });
    expect(standingControlState(withStandingOf(view, { atOnce: ["threat_repeat"] }), ADMIN, final(view, ADMIN, { ruleId: "R2" }), "terminateAtOnce")).toEqual({ open: false, why: "r2" });
    // Not shown at all while deciding, or for an outcome that restricts nothing.
    expect(standingControlState(view, MODERATOR, final(view, MODERATOR, { kind: "interim" }), "announce")).toBeNull();
    expect(standingControlState(view, MODERATOR, final(view, MODERATOR, { outcome: "no_violation" }), "announce")).toBeNull();
  });

  test("the composer shows the announce control with the rung's days and the newest strike's rule, and greys it with [reports.first] while a report waits", () => {
    const view = ladderCase();
    const open = composer(view, MODERATOR, final(view, MODERATOR));
    expect(open).toContain('<input type="checkbox"/> <span>Announce a suspension</span>');
    expect(open).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.suspend.days(3, 1)));
    expect(open).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.suspend.rule("R1")));
    // A moderator is offered no termination: both are greyed with [terminate.admin].
    expect(open).toContain('<input type="checkbox" disabled=""/> <span>Announce a termination</span>');
    expect(open).toContain('<input type="checkbox" disabled=""/> <span>Terminate at once</span>');
    expect(open).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.terminate.admin));
    const waiting = ladderCase(true);
    const greyed = composer(waiting, MODERATOR, final(waiting, MODERATOR));
    expect(greyed).toContain('<input type="checkbox" disabled=""/> <span>Announce a suspension</span>');
    expect(greyed).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.reportsFirst));
    expect(greyed).not.toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.suspend.days(3, 1)));
  });

  test("choosing it adds the announced suspension under the newest strike's rule with the drafted facts; the params sign its days and announced true; the preview says nothing is restricted yet", () => {
    const view = ladderCase();
    const draft = withStanding(view, final(view, MODERATOR), "announce", 2);
    expect(draft.actions).toEqual([{ kind: "suspend", mediaId: null, days: 2, announced: true }]);
    expect(draft.ruleId).toBe("R1");
    expect(draft.category).toBe(RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY.R1);
    expect(draft.written.facts).toBe(
      "When this was written the account had 3 active strikes. Each was given by a decision that found a breach of a korbat rule in a post, and each of those decisions was sent to the account with its reasons.",
    );
    expect(draft.written.reason).toBe("");
    expect(offeredDraft(view, MODERATOR, draft).actions).toEqual(draft.actions);
    // More days than the rung, another rule than the newest strike's, or a report that waits, lose the measure.
    expect(offeredDraft(view, MODERATOR, { ...draft, actions: [{ kind: "suspend", mediaId: null, days: 4, announced: true }] }).actions).toEqual([]);
    expect(offeredDraft(view, MODERATOR, { ...draft, ruleId: "R3" }).actions).toEqual([]);
    expect(offeredDraft(ladderCase(true), MODERATOR, draft).actions).toEqual([]);
    // At most one measure of the four: a termination chosen after it puts the suspension away.
    expect(withStanding(view, draft, "announceTerminate", null).actions).toEqual([{ kind: "terminate", mediaId: null, days: null, announced: true }]);
    const params = CaseDecidedParams.parse(decisionParamsOf(view, { ...draft, written: { ...draft.written, reason: "Three strikes in two weeks." } }, DIGESTS));
    expect(params).toMatchObject({ kind: "final", outcome: "restricted", ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R1", actions: [{ kind: "suspend", mediaId: null, days: 2, announced: true }], replaced: false });
    const told = statementParagraphs(previewOf(view, draft, NOW)).join(" | ");
    expect(told).toContain(`${STATEMENT_WORDS.suspendAnnounced(2)} It rests on the active strikes of your account:`);
    expect(told).not.toContain("It breaks korbat rule");
  });
});

describe("3e Task 4: replies, their answer and the withdrawal (design, sections 8.5 and 8.7)", () => {
  test("where a reply stands, and who may answer it", () => {
    const decided = decisionOf(repliedCase(), DECISION_REPLIED);
    const found = replyOf(decided)!;
    expect(found.reply.text).toBe(REPLY_TEXT);
    expect(replyState(found.measure, found.reply)).toBe("onTime");
    expect(answerable(decided, MODERATOR)).toBe(true);
    const late = repliedWith({ reply: { onTime: false }, period: { startsAt: "2026-10-06T09:00:00.000Z", endsAt: "2026-10-09T09:00:00.000Z", state: "ended" } });
    expect(replyState(late.actions[0]!, late.actions[0]!.reply!)).toBe("lateEnded");
    const running = repliedWith({ reply: { onTime: false }, period: { startsAt: "2026-10-11T09:00:00.000Z", endsAt: "2026-10-14T09:00:00.000Z", state: "running" } });
    expect(replyState(running.actions[0]!, running.actions[0]!.reply!)).toBe("late");
    const answered = repliedWith({ reply: { answeredAt: "2026-10-07T09:00:00.000Z", answeredBy: DECISION_WITHDRAW } });
    expect(replyState(answered.actions[0]!, answered.actions[0]!.reply!)).toBe("answered");
    expect(answerable(answered, ADMIN)).toBe(false);
    const gone = repliedWith({ period: { startsAt: null, endsAt: null, state: "basis_ended" } });
    expect(replyState(gone.actions[0]!, gone.actions[0]!.reply!)).toBe("basisGone");
    expect(answerable(gone, ADMIN)).toBe(false);
    // [reply.admin]: a reply to a measure that needed an admin is answered by an admin.
    const admins = repliedWith({ needsAdmin: true });
    expect(answerable(admins, MODERATOR)).toBe(false);
    expect(answerable(admins, ADMIN)).toBe(true);
    expect(replyOf(decisionOf(withdrawCase(), DECISION_WITHDRAW))).toBeNull();
  });

  test("the queue's Replies to answer: how long each waited, before or after the start, what it is against, over the aim; never its words", () => {
    const replies: QueueReply[] = [
      { caseId: CASE_REPLIED, decisionId: DECISION_REPLIED, kind: "suspend", days: 3, filedAt: "2026-10-12T08:00:00.000Z", onTime: true, endsAt: null },
      { caseId: CASE_REPLIED, decisionId: DECISION_WITHDRAW, kind: "suspend", days: 5, filedAt: "2026-10-10T09:00:00.000Z", onTime: false, endsAt: "2026-10-11T09:00:00.000Z" },
      { caseId: CASE_LADDER, decisionId: DECISION_WITHDRAW, kind: "terminate", days: null, filedAt: "2026-10-12T09:00:00.000Z", onTime: false, endsAt: null },
    ];
    expect(replyWords(replies[0]!, NOW.getTime())).toEqual([STANDING_WORDS.reply.before, STANDING_WORDS.reply.suspension(3)]);
    expect(replyWords(replies[1]!, NOW.getTime())).toEqual([STANDING_WORDS.reply.afterEnded(dateTime("2026-10-11T09:00:00.000Z")), STANDING_WORDS.reply.suspension(5), STANDING_WORDS.reply.overAim]);
    expect(replyWords(replies[2]!, NOW.getTime())[1]).toBe(STANDING_WORDS.reply.termination);
    const props: QueueViewProps = {
      rows: { state: "ready", value: [] },
      replies,
      more: false,
      loadingMore: false,
      now: NOW.getTime(),
      finding: { link: "", ruleId: "R1", category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC", busy: false, error: null },
      onLoadMore: noop,
      onOpenCase: noop,
      onFindingChange: noop,
      onFindingSubmit: noop,
    };
    const out = html(<QueueView {...props} />);
    expect(out).toContain(`>${STANDING_WORDS.reply.title}</h3>`);
    expect(hrefs(out)).toEqual([`/cases/${CASE_REPLIED}`, `/cases/${CASE_REPLIED}`, `/cases/${CASE_LADDER}`]);
    expect(out).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.reply.overAim));
    expect(out).not.toContain("film");
    expect(html(<QueueView {...props} replies={[]} />)).toContain(STANDING_WORDS.reply.none);
  });

  test("the case page shows the reply's text as text with [reply.onTime], and Answer this reply; once answered, the day it was answered and no control", () => {
    const out = casePage(repliedCase(), MODERATOR);
    expect(out).toContain(`aria-label="${STANDING_WORDS.reply.blockTitle}"`);
    expect(out).toContain(esc(REPLY_TEXT));
    expect(out).not.toContain(HOSTILE.script);
    expect(out).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.reply.onTime));
    expect(out).toContain(`>${STANDING_WORDS.reply.answerLabel}</button>`);
    const view = repliedCase();
    view.decisions = [repliedWith({ reply: { answeredAt: "2026-10-07T09:00:00.000Z", answeredBy: DECISION_WITHDRAW } })];
    const answered = casePage(view, MODERATOR);
    expect(answered).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.reply.answered(dateTime("2026-10-07T09:00:00.000Z"))));
    expect(answered).not.toContain(`>${STANDING_WORDS.reply.answerLabel}</button>`);
    // A reply with no text asks for a second look.
    const empty = repliedCase();
    empty.decisions = [repliedWith({ reply: { text: null } })];
    expect(casePage(empty, MODERATOR)).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.reply.empty));
  });

  test("the answer: Keep lifts nothing and Reverse lifts the measure, each said by when the reply came; the params are a correction; the preview answers the reply", () => {
    const view = repliedCase();
    const decided = decisionOf(view, DECISION_REPLIED);
    const draft = answerDraft(caseId(view.id), view, decided, MODERATOR);
    expect(draft).toMatchObject({ kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: DECISION_REPLIED, answer: "kept", actions: [] });
    const out = composer(view, MODERATOR, draft);
    expect(out).toContain(STANDING_WORDS.reply.keepLabel);
    expect(out).toContain(STANDING_WORDS.reply.reverseLabel);
    expect(out).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.keep.onTime(dateTime("2026-10-12T09:00:00.000Z"), 3)));
    expect(out).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.reply.same));
    expect(out).toContain(esc(REPLY_TEXT));
    const kept = { ...draft, written: { ...draft.written, review_reason: "Your reply did not change the strikes." } };
    expect(CaseDecidedParams.parse(decisionParamsOf(view, kept, DIGESTS))).toMatchObject({ kind: "correction", outcome: "kept", reviewsDecisionId: DECISION_REPLIED, actions: [], replaced: false });
    const keptTold = statementParagraphs(previewOf(view, kept, NOW)).join(" | ");
    expect(keptTold).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.replyKept("2026-10-05 09:00 UTC"));
    expect(keptTold).toContain("The suspension of 3 days starts at");
    const reversed = withAnswer(kept, decided, "reversed");
    expect(reversed.actions).toEqual([{ kind: "lift_suspension", mediaId: null }]);
    expect(composer(view, MODERATOR, reversed)).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.reverse.onTime));
    expect(CaseDecidedParams.parse(decisionParamsOf(view, reversed, DIGESTS))).toMatchObject({ kind: "correction", outcome: "reversed", actions: [{ kind: "lift_suspension", mediaId: null }], replaced: false });
    expect(withAnswer(reversed, decided, "kept").actions).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("Withdraw it for another measure: an admin's, while the account's measure is live, for an announced measure that has not started; signed replaced", () => {
    const view = withdrawCase();
    const decided = decisionOf(view, DECISION_WITHDRAW);
    expect(withdrawable(view, decided, ADMIN)?.kind).toBe("suspend");
    expect(withdrawable(view, decided, MODERATOR)).toBeNull();
    expect(withdrawable(withStandingOf(view, { live: false }), decided, ADMIN)).toBeNull();
    const started = { ...decided, actions: [{ ...decided.actions[0]!, period: { startsAt: "2026-10-12T09:05:00.000Z", endsAt: "2026-10-15T09:05:00.000Z", state: "running" as const } }] };
    expect(withdrawable(view, started, ADMIN)).toBeNull();
    expect(casePage(view, ADMIN)).toContain(`>${STANDING_WORDS.replace.label}</button>`);
    expect(casePage(view, MODERATOR)).not.toContain(`>${STANDING_WORDS.replace.label}</button>`);
    const draft = withdrawDraft(caseId(CASE_WITHDRAW), view, decided, ADMIN);
    expect(draft).toMatchObject({ kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: DECISION_WITHDRAW, replaced: true, actions: [{ kind: "lift_suspension", mediaId: null }] });
    const out = composer(view, ADMIN, draft);

    expect(out).not.toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.replace.reply));
    const written = { ...draft, written: { ...draft.written, review_reason: "A threat since needs a suspension at once." } };
    expect(CaseDecidedParams.parse(decisionParamsOf(view, written, DIGESTS))).toMatchObject({ kind: "correction", outcome: "reversed", actions: [{ kind: "lift_suspension", mediaId: null }], replaced: true });

    expect(told).toContain("because it is taking another measure on your account.");

  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/standing-announced.test.ts`

```ts
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { STANDING_RULES, type RuleId } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { STATEMENT_WORDS, statementParagraphs } from "@korbat/rules";
import { ModerationError } from "../../src/moderation";
import { giveUpAnnounced } from "../../src/moderation/dispatch";
import { caseStanding, fileReply } from "../../src/moderation/standing";
import { decisionStatement, sendStatement } from "../../src/moderation/statement";
import { deciderWorld, type DeciderWorld, type RealStaff } from "./moderation-decide";
import { aPost, act, ageStandingForTest, anAccount, ground, intake, newPostRow, raised, timed, type DecisionInput } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { noticesWorld, type NoticesWorld } from "./notices-harness";

// Every step of the ladder is a confirmed decision, each a round of the step-up flow: slow on a loaded machine.
vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 400_000 });

const HOUR_MS = 60 * 60_000;

/**
 * Announced suspensions and terminations (3e design, sections 7.6, 7.8 and 7.14; section 12.1, invariants 7, 8, 11 and
 * 20 for the announced measures): the start under each outcome of the notice mail (none while it is pending; the relay's
 * acceptance plus the reply window when sent; the decision plus the undelivered window when refused; the moment a give-up
 * was recorded when that is later), recorded under the subject's profile lock, and the API role unable to move either
 * column again; the ladder from three strikes to an announced termination, one rung after another with its most days;
 * and a basis that breaks under an announced measure that a reply holds. Each decision is confirmed with a real staff
 * key and mailed through the notices world's auth module and its scripted mailer.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: announced suspensions and terminations", () => {
  let n: NoticesWorld;
  let world: DeciderWorld;
  let admin: RealStaff;
  let second: RealStaff;
  let moderator: RealStaff;
  let before: Record<string, number>;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    n = noticesWorld();
    world = deciderWorld(n.apiDb, { auth: n.authForModeration });
    admin = await world.staff("admin");
    second = await world.staff("admin");
    moderator = await world.staff("moderator");
    before = await n.counts();
  }, 400_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    try {
      await n.cleanUp();
      await world.close();
    } finally {
      await n.close();
    }
  }, 400_000);

  /** A confirmed decision through the route's code: its id, or a failure that says why none was recorded. */
  async function decided(member: RealStaff, caseId: string, input: DecisionInput): Promise<string> {
    const outcome = await world.decideAs(member, caseId, input);
    if (typeof outcome === "string") throw new Error(`the decision was not recorded: ${outcome}`);
    return outcome.decisionId;
  }
  /** What a decision through the route was refused with: its code and the trigger's detail. */
  async function refused(member: RealStaff, caseId: string, input: DecisionInput): Promise<{ code: string; detail: string | null } | null> {
    try {
      await world.decideAs(member, caseId, input);
      return null;
    } catch (err) {
      if (!(err instanceof ModerationError)) throw err;
      return { code: err.code, detail: (err as ModerationError & { detail?: string | null }).detail ?? null };
    }
  }
  /** Strikes the way they come about: a post made now, an admin's own finding on it under the rule, a final removal. */
  async function strikes(accountId: string, count: number, rule: RuleId = "R1"): Promise<string[]> {
    const made: string[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const postId = await newPostRow(n.apiDb, accountId, { createdAt: sql`clock_timestamp()`, body: `a post that breaks ${rule}` });
      const caseId = (await intake(n.apiDb, ground.finding(admin.id, rule), aPost(postId))).items[0]!.caseId!;
      made.push(await decided(admin, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: rule, actions: [act("remove")] }));
    }
    return made;
  }
  /** An admin's own finding on the account under the rule: the account's case, where an account measure is decided. */
  const accountCase = async (account: { id: string; handle: string }, rule: RuleId) => (await intake(n.apiDb, ground.finding(admin.id, rule), anAccount(account.id, account.handle))).items[0]!.caseId!;
  /** The measure's period as suspension_periods gives it, with the decision's mail, each time in epoch milliseconds. */
  async function periodOf(decisionId: string) {
    const [row] = await n.apiDb.execute<{ author_mail: string; mail_ms: number | null; created_ms: number; earliest_ms: number; start_ms: number | null; end_ms: number | null }>(
      sql`select d.author_mail, extract(epoch from d.author_mail_at) * 1000 as mail_ms, extract(epoch from a.created_at) * 1000 as created_ms,
                 extract(epoch from a.starts_at) * 1000 as earliest_ms, extract(epoch from p.starts_at) * 1000 as start_ms,
                 case when isfinite(p.ends_at) then extract(epoch from p.ends_at) * 1000 end as end_ms
            from decision_actions a join decisions d on d.id = a.decision_id left join suspension_periods p on p.action_id = a.id
           where a.decision_id = ${decisionId}::uuid and a.kind::text in ('suspend', 'terminate')`,
    );
    return { ...row!, mail_ms: row!.mail_ms === null ? null : Number(row!.mail_ms), created_ms: Number(row!.created_ms), earliest_ms: Number(row!.earliest_ms), start_ms: row!.start_ms === null ? null : Number(row!.start_ms), end_ms: row!.end_ms === null ? null : Number(row!.end_ms) };
  }
  /** The profile's two derived columns, as the migrator reads them. */
  async function columnsOf(accountId: string) {
    const [row] = await world.migrateDb.execute<{ from_ms: number | null; until_ms: number | null }>(
      sql`select extract(epoch from suspended_from) * 1000 as from_ms, case when isfinite(suspended_until) then extract(epoch from suspended_until) * 1000 end as until_ms from profiles where id = ${accountId}::uuid`,
    );
    return { from: row!.from_ms === null ? null : Number(row!.from_ms), until: row!.until_ms === null ? null : Number(row!.until_ms) };
  }
  /** An account at the ladder's first step with an announced suspension of 3 days, its mail ended as the scripted mailer says. */
  async function announced(mode: "deliver" | "refuse" | "fail") {
    const account = await n.account();
    await strikes(account.id, STANDING_RULES.ladderStrikes);
    const caseId = await accountCase(account, "R1");
    n.mailer.mode = mode;
    try {
      const decisionId = await decided(moderator, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R1", actions: [timed("suspend", 3, true)] });
      return { account, caseId, decisionId };
    } finally {
      n.mailer.mode = "deliver";
    }
  }

  test("the start under each outcome of the notice mail: none while it is pending, the relay's acceptance plus the window when sent, the decision plus the undelivered window when refused, and the moment of a late give-up; and the API role cannot move either column again", async () => {
    const windowMs = STANDING_RULES.replyWindowHours * HOUR_MS;
    // Pending: the relay could not be reached. No start, nothing restricted, and /api/me says the start is not fixed.
    const pending = await announced("fail");
    let period = await periodOf(pending.decisionId);
    expect(period).toMatchObject({ author_mail: "pending", mail_ms: null, start_ms: null });
    expect(period.earliest_ms - period.created_ms).toBe(windowMs);
    expect(await columnsOf(pending.account.id)).toEqual({ from: null, until: null });
    expect((await n.moderation.standingFor(pending.account.id))?.measure).toMatchObject({ state: "unfixed", startsAt: null, endsAt: null, days: 3, replyOpen: true });
    // The dispatch job's retry sends it: the start is the relay's acceptance plus the window, never before the earliest start.
    expect(await sendStatement(n.deps, pending.decisionId)).toBe("sent");
    period = await periodOf(pending.decisionId);
    expect(period.author_mail).toBe("sent");
    expect(period.start_ms).toBe(Math.max(period.earliest_ms, period.mail_ms! + windowMs));
    expect(period.end_ms).toBe(period.start_ms! + 3 * 24 * HOUR_MS);
    expect(await columnsOf(pending.account.id)).toEqual({ from: period.start_ms, until: period.end_ms });
    expect((await n.moderation.standingFor(pending.account.id))?.measure).toMatchObject({ state: "announced" });
    // The mail is suspension_announced, with the window the statement names.
    const [mail] = n.mailer.to(pending.account.email, "suspension_announced");
    expect(mail?.data).toMatchObject({ measure: "suspend", days: "3", window: String(STANDING_RULES.replyWindowHours) });

    // Refused for good: the decision plus the undelivered window.
    const refusedMail = await announced("refuse");
    period = await periodOf(refusedMail.decisionId);
    expect(period.author_mail).toBe("failed");
    expect(period.mail_ms).not.toBeNull();
    expect(period.start_ms).toBe(period.created_ms + STANDING_RULES.undeliveredHours * HOUR_MS);

    // Given up after the dispatch job stood still for longer than the undelivered window: the start is the give-up's
    // moment, never a time already past, and the suspension runs at once.
    const late = await announced("fail");
    await ageStandingForTest(world.migrateDb, late.account.id, `${STANDING_RULES.undeliveredHours + 24} hours`);
    expect(await giveUpAnnounced(n.deps, new Date())).toContain(late.decisionId);
    period = await periodOf(late.decisionId);
    expect(period.author_mail).toBe("failed");
    expect(period.start_ms).toBe(period.mail_ms);
    expect(period.start_ms!).toBeGreaterThan(period.created_ms + STANDING_RULES.undeliveredHours * HOUR_MS);
    expect((await n.moderation.standingFor(late.account.id))?.measure?.state).toBe("running");

    // The API role can neither un-send a notice nor move its time (decisions_mail_forward, 42501).
    for (const statement of [
      sql`update decisions set author_mail = 'pending' where id = ${refusedMail.decisionId}::uuid`,
      sql`update decisions set author_mail_at = author_mail_at - interval '1 day' where id = ${pending.decisionId}::uuid`,
    ]) {
      let code: string | null = null;
      try {
        await n.apiDb.execute(statement);
      } catch (err) {
        code = raised(err)?.code ?? null;
      }
      expect(code).toBe("42501");
    }
  });

  test("the ladder to its end: three strikes announce a suspension of at most 3 days, a further strike 7, then 30, and after three suspensions in the year a termination; one standing measure at a time", async () => {
    const account = await n.account();
    const passPeriod = async (days: number) => ageStandingForTest(world.migrateDb, account.id, `${STANDING_RULES.replyWindowHours + days * 24 + 1} hours`);
    await strikes(account.id, 3, "R1");
    let caseId = await accountCase(account, "R1");
    expect(await caseStanding(n.apiDb, caseId, account.id)).toMatchObject({ activeStrikes: 3, ladderRule: "R1", maxDays: STANDING_RULES.ladderDays[0], mayTerminate: false, live: false, suspensionsInYear: 0 });
    // More than the rung is refused; a termination is not open yet; a moderator may announce a suspension.
    expect(await refused(moderator, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R1", actions: [timed("suspend", STANDING_RULES.ladderDays[0] + 1, true)] })).toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_decision" });
    expect(await refused(admin, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R1", actions: [timed("terminate", null, true)] })).toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_decision" });
    const first = await decided(moderator, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R1", actions: [timed("suspend", STANDING_RULES.ladderDays[0], true)] });
    // While it stands (it has a start, and has not run), a second standing measure is refused.
    await strikes(account.id, 1, "R3");
    expect(await refused(moderator, await accountCase(account, "R3"), { kind: "final", ruleId: "R3", actions: [timed("suspend", 1, true)] })).toMatchObject({ code: "standing_conflict" });
    // The statement: the strikes it rests on, the terms' section as its ground, and the start.
    const paragraphs = statementParagraphs((await decisionStatement(n.apiDb, first))!.statement);
    expect(paragraphs[0]!.startsWith(STATEMENT_WORDS.suspendAnnounced(STANDING_RULES.ladderDays[0]))).toBe(true);
    expect(paragraphs.some((paragraph) => paragraph.startsWith("This rests on korbat's terms, section Suspension and termination"))).toBe(true);
    expect(paragraphs).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.automationCounted);

    // The first step runs and ends; the strike made since is newer than it: the second step, at most 7 days, under R3.
    await passPeriod(STANDING_RULES.ladderDays[0]);
    caseId = await accountCase(account, "R3");
    expect(await caseStanding(n.apiDb, caseId, account.id)).toMatchObject({ activeStrikes: 4, ladderRule: "R3", maxDays: STANDING_RULES.ladderDays[1], suspensionsInYear: 1, live: false });
    expect(await refused(moderator, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R3", actions: [timed("suspend", STANDING_RULES.ladderDays[1] + 1, true)] })).toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_decision" });
    await decided(moderator, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R3", actions: [timed("suspend", STANDING_RULES.ladderDays[1], true)] });
    await passPeriod(STANDING_RULES.ladderDays[1]);

    // The third step: at most 30 days; a moderator who chooses 1 still uses it.
    await strikes(account.id, 1, "R1");
    caseId = await accountCase(account, "R1");
    expect(await caseStanding(n.apiDb, caseId, account.id)).toMatchObject({ maxDays: STANDING_RULES.ladderDays[2], suspensionsInYear: 2, mayTerminate: false });
    await decided(moderator, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R1", actions: [timed("suspend", 1, true)] });
    await passPeriod(1);

    // Three suspensions of the ladder in the year, and a strike since: a termination can be announced, by an admin only.
    await strikes(account.id, 1, "R1");
    caseId = await accountCase(account, "R1");
    expect(await caseStanding(n.apiDb, caseId, account.id)).toMatchObject({ suspensionsInYear: 3, mayTerminate: true });
    expect(await refused(moderator, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R1", actions: [timed("terminate", null, true)] })).toMatchObject({ code: "admin_required" });
    const termination = await decided(admin, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R1", actions: [timed("terminate", null, true)] });
    const [row] = await n.apiDb.execute<{ basis: string; days: number | null; announced: boolean }>(sql`select basis, days, announced from decision_actions where decision_id = ${termination}::uuid and kind::text = 'terminate'`);
    expect({ ...row! }).toEqual({ basis: "ladder_end", days: null, announced: true });
    const ended = statementParagraphs((await decisionStatement(n.apiDb, termination))!.statement);
    expect(ended[0]!.startsWith("korbat will terminate your account. Nothing is restricted yet.")).toBe(true);
    expect(ended.some((paragraph) => paragraph.startsWith("This rests on korbat's terms, section Suspension and termination: after three suspensions"))).toBe(true);
    const mails = n.mailer.to(account.email, "suspension_announced");
    expect(mails.map((mail) => mail.data.measure)).toEqual(["suspend", "suspend", "suspend", "terminate"]);
    expect((await n.moderation.standingFor(account.id))?.measure).toMatchObject({ kind: "terminate", state: "announced", days: null, endsAt: null });
  });

  test("a basis that breaks under an announced suspension held by a reply: the overruling ends it before its start, answers the reply, says so in its statement and mail, and a kept answer is then refused", async () => {
    const account = await n.account();
    const struck = await strikes(account.id, STANDING_RULES.ladderStrikes);
    const caseId = await accountCase(account, "R1");
    const decisionId = await decided(moderator, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R1", actions: [timed("suspend", 3, true)] });
    const reply = await fileReply(n.deps, account.id, decisionId, { statement: "These posts were satire." });
    expect(reply.onTime).toBe(true);
    expect((await n.moderation.standingFor(account.id))?.measure?.state).toBe("held");
    // A correction reverses one strike's decision whole: fewer than three strikes stand, so the suspension's basis breaks.
    const [strikeCase] = await n.apiDb.execute<{ case_id: string }>(sql`select case_id from decisions where id = ${struck[1]!}::uuid`);
    const reversal = await decided(second, strikeCase!.case_id, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: struck[1]!, actions: [act("restore")] });
    expect((await n.moderation.standingFor(account.id))?.measure).toBeNull();
    const [answered] = await n.apiDb.execute<{ answered_by: string | null }>(sql`select r.answered_by from suspension_replies r join decision_actions a on a.id = r.action_id where a.decision_id = ${decisionId}::uuid`);
    expect(answered?.answered_by).toBe(reversal);
    const statement = (await decisionStatement(n.apiDb, reversal))!.statement;
    expect(statement.endedStanding).toEqual([{ kind: "suspend", decidedAt: expect.any(String), periodThen: { state: "not_started", startedAt: null, endedAt: null }, seal: false, replyFiledAt: expect.any(String) }]);
    expect(statement.repliedTo).toBeUndefined();
    expect(statementParagraphs(statement).some((paragraph) => paragraph.includes(STATEMENT_WORDS.basisEndedThen.not_started) && paragraph.includes("needs no answer now"))).toBe(true);
    expect(n.mailer.to(account.email, "suspension_lifted").map((mail) => [mail.data.why, mail.data.period])).toEqual([["basis", "not_started"]]);
    expect(n.mailer.to(account.email, "reply_answered")).toEqual([]);
    // Nothing is left to keep: a kept answer to the reply is refused.
    expect(await refused(moderator, caseId, { kind: "correction", outcome: "kept", reviewsDecisionId: decisionId })).toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_decision" });
  });

  test("this file left no row behind: what it committed is removed, and the tables hold what they held before it", async () => {
    await world.moderation.settle();
    await n.cleanUp();
    expect(await n.counts()).toEqual(before);
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/standing-replies.test.ts`

```ts
import { randomBytes, randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { ErrorEnvelope, FlowResponse, MeResponse, ReplyResponse, STANDING_RULES, appealDeadline, type RuleId } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { REDRESS_TEXTS, statementParagraphs } from "@korbat/rules";
import { randomToken } from "../../src/auth/crypto";
import { ModerationError } from "../../src/moderation";
import { fileAppeal } from "../../src/moderation/appeals";
import { authorDecisionView } from "../../src/moderation/author";
import { fileReply } from "../../src/moderation/standing";
import { decisionStatement } from "../../src/moderation/statement";
import { Browser } from "./http-client";
import { deciderWorld, type DeciderWorld, type RealStaff } from "./moderation-decide";
import { aPost, act, ageStandingForTest, anAccount, decisionParams, ground, intake, newPostRow, timed, type DecisionInput } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { HUMAN, noticesWorld, type NoticesWorld } from "./notices-harness";

// Every announced measure rests on three strikes, each a confirmed decision: slow on a loaded machine.
vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 400_000 });

const HOUR_MS = 60 * 60_000;
const DAY_MS = 24 * HOUR_MS;

/**
 * The reply and its answer (3e design, sections 7.6 steps 9 to 12, 7.11 item 4 and 7.15; section 12.1, invariants 8, 11
 * and 12): the route, its session and its owner, once; a reply before the start holds it, one after changes nothing by
 * itself, and one to a measure that ended or was lifted is refused; a kept answer starts the suspension at the later of
 * the answer and the earliest start, and the six months to appeal count again from it; a reversed answer; a review that
 * keeps the measure in force answers the reply as a kept answer does; a correction drafted before the reply is refused;
 * and the withdrawal of an announced measure for a measure taken at once. Every decision is confirmed with a real staff
 * key and mailed through the notices world's auth module.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the reply to a suspension and its answer", () => {
  let n: NoticesWorld;
  let world: DeciderWorld;
  let admin: RealStaff;
  let second: RealStaff;
  let moderator: RealStaff;
  let before: Record<string, number>;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    n = noticesWorld();
    world = deciderWorld(n.apiDb, { auth: n.authForModeration });
    admin = await world.staff("admin");
    second = await world.staff("admin");
    moderator = await world.staff("moderator");
    before = await n.counts();
  }, 400_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    try {
      await n.cleanUp();
      await world.close();
    } finally {
      await n.close();
    }
  }, 400_000);

  async function decided(member: RealStaff, caseId: string, input: DecisionInput): Promise<string> {
    const outcome = await world.decideAs(member, caseId, input);
    if (typeof outcome === "string") throw new Error(`the decision was not recorded: ${outcome}`);
    return outcome.decisionId;
  }
  async function refused(member: RealStaff, caseId: string, input: DecisionInput): Promise<string | null> {
    try {
      await world.decideAs(member, caseId, input);
      return null;
    } catch (err) {
      if (!(err instanceof ModerationError)) throw err;
      return err.code;
    }
  }
  async function strikes(accountId: string, count: number, rule: RuleId = "R1"): Promise<void> {
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const postId = await newPostRow(n.apiDb, accountId, { createdAt: sql`clock_timestamp()`, body: `a post that breaks ${rule}` });
      const caseId = (await intake(n.apiDb, ground.finding(admin.id, rule), aPost(postId))).items[0]!.caseId!;
      await decided(admin, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: rule, actions: [act("remove")] });
    }
  }
  const accountCase = async (account: { id: string; handle: string }, rule: RuleId) => (await intake(n.apiDb, ground.finding(admin.id, rule), anAccount(account.id, account.handle))).items[0]!.caseId!;
  /** The ladder's first step, announced by the moderator: three strikes, then a suspension of `days` on the account's case. Its mail is sent, so its start is fixed and ahead. */
  async function announce(account: { id: string; handle: string }, days = 3, extra: DecisionInput["actions"] = []) {
    await strikes(account.id, STANDING_RULES.ladderStrikes);
    const caseId = await accountCase(account, "R1");
    const decisionId = await decided(moderator, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R1", actions: [...extra, timed("suspend", days, true)] });
    return { caseId, decisionId };
  }
  /** The measure's period and its row's earliest start, in epoch milliseconds, and its reply. */
  async function periodOf(decisionId: string) {
    const [row] = await n.apiDb.execute<{ earliest_ms: number; start_ms: number | null; end_ms: number | null; answered_by: string | null; answered_ms: number | null; on_time: boolean | null }>(
      sql`select extract(epoch from a.starts_at) * 1000 as earliest_ms, extract(epoch from p.starts_at) * 1000 as start_ms, extract(epoch from p.ends_at) * 1000 as end_ms,
                 r.answered_by, extract(epoch from r.answered_at) * 1000 as answered_ms, r.on_time
            from decision_actions a left join suspension_periods p on p.action_id = a.id left join suspension_replies r on r.action_id = a.id
           where a.decision_id = ${decisionId}::uuid and a.kind::text in ('suspend', 'terminate')`,
    );
    // To the millisecond, as JavaScript reads a time: the database's microseconds are cut off.
    const num = (value: number | null) => (value === null ? null : Math.floor(Number(value)));
    return { earliest: Math.floor(Number(row!.earliest_ms)), start: num(row!.start_ms), end: num(row!.end_ms), answeredBy: row!.answered_by, answeredAt: num(row!.answered_ms), onTime: row!.on_time };
  }
  const stateOf = async (accountId: string) => (await n.moderation.standingFor(accountId))?.measure ?? null;

  test("the route: a signed-in session of the measure's subject only, once; 201 with when it was filed and that it came before the start; /api/me then shows the start held", async () => {
    const signUp = async () => {
      const b = new Browser(n.app, n.config.APP_ORIGIN);
      const email = `reply-${randomUUID()}@korbat.local`;
      const handle = `rp_${randomBytes(4).toString("hex")}`;
      const start = await b.fetch("/api/auth/email/start", { json: { email, turnstileToken: HUMAN, deviceId: randomToken(), platform: "web" } });
      const { flowId } = FlowResponse.parse(await start.json());
      expect((await b.fetch("/api/auth/email/verify", { json: { flowId, code: n.mailer.lastCodeFor(email) } })).status).toBe(200);
      expect((await b.fetch("/api/auth/signup/complete", { json: { flowId, dateOfBirth: "1990-05-17", termsVersion: n.config.TERMS_VERSION } })).status).toBe(200);
      expect((await b.fetch("/api/auth/onboarding/handle", { json: { handle, displayName: "Reply" } })).status).toBe(200);
      const id = MeResponse.parse(await (await b.fetch("/api/me")).json()).user.id;
      n.profileIds.push(id);
      return { b, id, handle };
    };
    const ada = await signUp();
    const other = await signUp();
    const { decisionId } = await announce(ada);
    expect((await stateOf(ada.id))?.state).toBe("announced");
    const path = `/api/moderation/decisions/${decisionId}/reply`;
    const codeOf = async (res: Response) => ErrorEnvelope.parse(await res.json()).error.code;
    // Signed out: refused at the session guard. Another account: not found, as for the decision's read.
    const signedOut = await new Browser(n.app, n.config.APP_ORIGIN).fetch(path, { json: {} });
    expect(signedOut.status).toBe(401);
    const stranger = await other.b.fetch(path, { json: {} });
    expect([stranger.status, await codeOf(stranger)]).toEqual([404, "not_found"]);
    // A text longer than an appeal's statement is refused before anything is read.
    expect((await ada.b.fetch(path, { json: { statement: "x".repeat(2001) } })).status).toBe(400);
    // The reply: 201, filed before the start, which it now holds.
    const res = await ada.b.fetch(path, { json: { statement: "I want to explain these posts." } });
    expect(res.status).toBe(201);
    const answer = ReplyResponse.parse(await res.json());
    expect(answer.onTime).toBe(true);
    const me = MeResponse.parse(await (await ada.b.fetch("/api/me")).json());
    expect(me.standing?.measure).toMatchObject({ state: "held", startsAt: null, replyOpen: false, reply: { filedAt: answer.filedAt, onTime: true, answeredAt: null } });
    // Its text is kept with the salt and the digest the server made, as an appeal's statement.
    const [stored] = await world.migrateDb.execute<{ statement: string; salted: boolean }>(sql`select statement, statement_salt is not null and statement_digest is not null as salted from suspension_replies where account_id = ${ada.id}::uuid`);
    expect({ ...stored! }).toEqual({ statement: "I want to explain these posts.", salted: true });
    // Once: a second reply is refused.
    const again = await ada.b.fetch(path, { json: {} });
    expect([again.status, await codeOf(again)]).toEqual([422, "reply_not_open"]);
    // A decision that holds no suspension or termination takes no reply.
    const [strike] = await n.apiDb.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select d.id from decisions d join cases c on c.id = d.case_id join posts p on p.id = c.target_id where p.author_id = ${ada.id}::uuid limit 1`);
    expect((await ada.b.fetch(`/api/moderation/decisions/${strike!.id}/reply`, { json: {} })).status).toBe(404);
  });

  test("invariant 12: a reply after the start changes nothing by itself; a reply to a measure that has ended, or that was lifted, is refused", async () => {
    const late = await n.account();
    const lateMeasure = await announce(late);
    const fixed = await periodOf(lateMeasure.decisionId);
    await ageStandingForTest(world.migrateDb, late.id, `${STANDING_RULES.replyWindowHours + 1} hours`);
    expect((await stateOf(late.id))?.state).toBe("running");
    expect(await fileReply(n.deps, late.id, lateMeasure.decisionId, {})).toMatchObject({ onTime: false });
    expect((await stateOf(late.id))?.state).toBe("running");
    const after = await periodOf(lateMeasure.decisionId);
    expect(after.end! - after.start!).toBe(fixed.end! - fixed.start!);
    // A lift signed `replaced` is refused for a measure that runs: it withdraws only one that has not started.
    expect(await refused(admin, lateMeasure.caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: lateMeasure.decisionId, actions: [act("lift_suspension")], replaced: true })).toBe("invalid_decision");

    const ended = await n.account();
    const endedMeasure = await announce(ended, 1);
    await ageStandingForTest(world.migrateDb, ended.id, `${STANDING_RULES.replyWindowHours + 25} hours`);
    expect(await stateOf(ended.id)).toBeNull();
    await expect(fileReply(n.deps, ended.id, endedMeasure.decisionId, {})).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "reply_not_open" });

    const lifted = await n.account();
    const liftedMeasure = await announce(lifted);
    await decided(admin, liftedMeasure.caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: liftedMeasure.decisionId, actions: [act("lift_suspension")] });
    await expect(fileReply(n.deps, lifted.id, liftedMeasure.decisionId, {})).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "reply_not_open" });
    // Someone else's measure is not found.
    await expect(fileReply(n.deps, late.id, liftedMeasure.decisionId, {})).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "not_found" });
  });

  test("a kept answer before the earliest start starts the suspension at that start, never sooner for having replied; its statement and mail say so, and the six months count again from the answer", async () => {
    const dan = await n.account();
    const { caseId, decisionId } = await announce(dan);
    expect((await fileReply(n.deps, dan.id, decisionId, { statement: "Please reconsider." })).onTime).toBe(true);
    expect((await stateOf(dan.id))?.state).toBe("held");
    // The same moderator may answer: the reply is the hearing, not the appeal.
    const kept = await decided(moderator, caseId, { kind: "correction", outcome: "kept", reviewsDecisionId: decisionId });
    const period = await periodOf(decisionId);
    expect(period.answeredBy).toBe(kept);
    expect(period.start).toBe(period.earliest);
    expect(period.end).toBe(period.earliest + 3 * DAY_MS);
    expect((await stateOf(dan.id))?.state).toBe("announced");
    const statement = (await decisionStatement(n.apiDb, kept))!.statement;
    expect(statement.repliedTo).toMatchObject({ onTime: true, kind: "suspend", days: 3, periodThen: { state: "not_started" } });
    expect(Date.parse(statement.repliedTo!.startsAt!)).toBe(period.earliest);
    // The six months count from the answer: later than from the decision.
    const fromDecision = appealDeadline(new Date(statement.reviewed!.decidedAt)).getTime();
    expect(Date.parse(statement.repliedTo!.appealUntil)).toBe(appealDeadline(new Date(statement.decidedAt)).getTime());
    expect(Date.parse(statement.repliedTo!.appealUntil)).toBeGreaterThan(fromDecision);
    const paragraphs = statementParagraphs(statement);
    expect(paragraphs[0]).toContain("and keeps that decision. The suspension of 3 days starts at");
    expect(paragraphs[0]!.endsWith("with this answer, and never before the time you were first given.")).toBe(true);
    expect(paragraphs.at(-1)!.startsWith(REDRESS_TEXTS[2].replyAnswered!.slice(0, 40))).toBe(true);
    expect(n.mailer.to(dan.email, "reply_answered").map((mail) => mail.data.outcome)).toEqual(["kept"]);
    const view = await authorDecisionView(n.deps, dan.id, decisionId);
    expect(Date.parse(view.appealUntil!)).toBe(Date.parse(statement.repliedTo!.appealUntil));
    expect(view.standing).toMatchObject({ state: "announced", reply: { onTime: true, answeredBy: kept, text: "Please reconsider." }, replyOpen: false });
    // Nothing is left to answer: a second kept answer is refused.
    expect(await refused(moderator, caseId, { kind: "correction", outcome: "kept", reviewsDecisionId: decisionId })).toBe("invalid_decision");
  });

  test("a kept answer after the earliest start starts the suspension at the answer, and the appeal stays open six months from the answer while the decision's own six months have run out", async () => {
    const eve = await n.account();
    const { caseId, decisionId } = await announce(eve);
    expect((await fileReply(n.deps, eve.id, decisionId, {})).onTime).toBe(true);
    // The reply holds the start for months: nobody answered it.
    await ageStandingForTest(world.migrateDb, eve.id, "5 months");
    expect((await stateOf(eve.id))?.state).toBe("held");
    await decided(moderator, caseId, { kind: "correction", outcome: "kept", reviewsDecisionId: decisionId });
    const period = await periodOf(decisionId);
    expect(period.start).toBe(period.answeredAt);
    expect((await stateOf(eve.id))?.state).toBe("running");
    // Two months on, the decision is seven months old, and the appeal counts from the answer.
    await ageStandingForTest(world.migrateDb, eve.id, "2 months");
    const appealed = await fileAppeal(n.deps, eve.id, decisionId, {});
    expect(appealed.appeal).toMatchObject({ state: "pending" });
    const [final] = await n.apiDb.execute<{ final: Date | null }>(sql`select public.decision_final_at(${decisionId}::uuid) as final`);
    expect(final?.final).toBeNull();
    expect(n.mailer.to(eve.email, "reply_answered").map((mail) => mail.data.outcome)).toEqual(["kept"]);
  });

  test("a reversed answer: the suspension never starts, the statement leads with the reply and the lift, and the mail is reply_answered, reversed", async () => {
    const fay = await n.account();
    const { caseId, decisionId } = await announce(fay);
    await fileReply(n.deps, fay.id, decisionId, { statement: "I was hacked." });
    const reversal = await decided(moderator, caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: decisionId, actions: [act("lift_suspension")] });
    expect(await stateOf(fay.id)).toBeNull();
    expect((await periodOf(decisionId)).answeredBy).toBe(reversal);
    const statement = (await decisionStatement(n.apiDb, reversal))!.statement;
    expect(statement.repliedTo).toMatchObject({ onTime: true, startsAt: null, endsAt: null, periodThen: { state: "not_started" } });
    const paragraphs = statementParagraphs(statement);
    expect(paragraphs[0]).toContain("and reversed that decision.");
    expect(paragraphs[1]!.startsWith("korbat lifted the suspension it announced on")).toBe(true);
    expect(n.mailer.to(fay.email, "reply_answered").map((mail) => mail.data.outcome)).toEqual(["reversed"]);
    expect(n.mailer.to(fay.email, "suspension_lifted")).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("a review that reverses part and keeps the suspension answers the reply as a kept answer does: the start is fixed, and its statement and mail say so", async () => {
    const gus = await n.account();
    const { decisionId } = await announce(gus, 3, [act("retire_handle")]);
    await fileAppeal(n.deps, gus.id, decisionId, {});
    await fileReply(n.deps, gus.id, decisionId, { statement: "My handle is my name." });
    const outcome = await world.reviewAs(second, decisionId, { outcome: "partly_reversed", actions: [act("unretire_handle")] });
    if (typeof outcome === "string") throw new Error(`the review was not recorded: ${outcome}`);
    const period = await periodOf(decisionId);
    expect(period.answeredBy).toBe(outcome.decisionId);
    expect(period.start).toBe(Math.max(period.earliest, period.answeredAt!));
    const paragraphs = statementParagraphs((await decisionStatement(n.apiDb, outcome.decisionId))!.statement);
    expect(paragraphs[0]).toContain("This also answers your reply of");
    expect(paragraphs[0]).toContain("The suspension of 3 days starts at");
    expect(n.mailer.to(gus.email, "reply_answered").map((mail) => mail.data.outcome)).toEqual(["kept"]);
  });

  test("a correction drafted before the reply is refused case_changed; the withdrawal for another measure closes the reply without an answer, is mailed as such, and makes room for a suspension at once", async () => {
    const hal = await n.account();
    const { caseId, decisionId } = await announce(hal);
    // A kept answer to a measure with no reply is no answer: refused.
    expect(await refused(admin, caseId, { kind: "correction", outcome: "kept", reviewsDecisionId: decisionId })).toBe("invalid_decision");
    // A correction drafted now, then the reply, then the key: the reply raised the case's version.
    const stale = await decisionParams(n.apiDb, admin, caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: decisionId, actions: [act("lift_suspension")] });
    await fileReply(n.deps, hal.id, decisionId, { statement: "Please read this first." });
    await expect(world.moderation.forStaff.decide(admin.session, await world.confirm(admin, caseId, stale), { requestId: `req-${randomUUID()}` })).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "case_changed" });
    // The withdrawal: a lift signed `replaced`, of a measure that has not started.
    const withdrawal = await decided(admin, caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: decisionId, actions: [act("lift_suspension")], replaced: true });
    expect((await periodOf(decisionId)).answeredBy).toBe(withdrawal);
    const statement = (await decisionStatement(n.apiDb, withdrawal))!.statement;
    expect(statement.repliedTo).toBeUndefined();
    expect(statement.reversals[0]).toMatchObject({ kind: "lift_suspension", replaced: true, replyFiledAt: expect.any(String) });
    const paragraphs = statementParagraphs(statement);
    expect(paragraphs[0]!.endsWith("because it is taking another measure on your account. This is not a decision on your reply.")).toBe(true);
    expect(paragraphs.join(" ")).not.toMatch(/korbat read your reply|korbat corrected its decision/);
    expect(n.mailer.to(hal.email, "suspension_lifted").map((mail) => [mail.data.why, mail.data.replied])).toEqual([["replaced", "true"]]);
    expect(n.mailer.to(hal.email, "reply_answered")).toEqual([]);
    // Room is made: a suspension at once on a threat.
    const postId = await newPostRow(n.apiDb, hal.id, { createdAt: sql`clock_timestamp()`, body: "a direct threat" });
    const postCase = (await intake(n.apiDb, ground.finding(admin.id, "R5"), aPost(postId))).items[0]!.caseId!;
    await decided(admin, postCase, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R5", actions: [act("remove")] });
    await decided(admin, await accountCase(hal, "R5"), { kind: "final", ruleId: "R5", actions: [timed("suspend", 3, false)] });
    expect((await stateOf(hal.id))?.state).toBe("running");
  });

  test("this file left no row behind: what it committed is removed, and the tables hold what they held before it", async () => {
    await world.moderation.settle();
    await n.cleanUp();
    expect(await n.counts()).toEqual(before);
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/standing-termination.test.ts`

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import type { AccountDeps } from "../../src/account/context";
import { purgePending } from "../../src/account/purge";
import { mediaForAccount } from "../../src/media";
import { MemoryStore } from "../../src/middleware/rate-limit";
import { fileAppeal } from "../../src/moderation/appeals";
import { TAKE_DOWN_SETTLE_MS, fileReply, takeDownDue } from "../../src/moderation/standing";
import { terminationsDue } from "../../src/moderation/standing-repo";
import { exportProfile } from "../../src/social/flows/export";
import { mediaHarness, type MediaHarness } from "./media-harness";
import { closeDecisions, deciderWorld, terminateForTest, type DeciderWorld, type RealStaff } from "./moderation-decide";
import { act, ageStandingForTest, decisionParams, gate, untilBlocked, type DecisionInput } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { noticesWorld, type NoticesWorld } from "./notices-harness";
import { socialHarness, type SocialHarness } from "./social-harness";

// Every termination is a chain of confirmed decisions, each a round of the step-up flow: slow on a loaded machine.
vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 300_000 });

/**
 * Termination and its take-down (3e design, sections 5 (the lock order, item 5), 6.2 terminations_due and 7.8; section
 * 12.1, invariants 14 and 21): a termination is taken down only once it is final for its author, never during the
 * window, while an appeal waits, while a reply, on time or late, is unanswered, or after a lift; the purge round's step
 * holds the account's profile and then the terminating decision's case before it reads again, so a lift that commits
 * first takes the account out and nothing is mailed; the auth module's take-down mails termination_final once, after its
 * commit, in place of account_deleted; a take-down that fails mails nothing, is counted, and never holds an ordinary
 * deletion of the same round. The terminations are terminateForTest's (moderation-decide.ts); the answers, lifts and
 * reviews are confirmed by this file's own staff keys and mailed through the notices world's auth module.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: termination and its take-down", () => {
  let n: NoticesWorld;
  let world: DeciderWorld;
  let admin: RealStaff;
  /** An admin who takes no part in any case of this file: the reviewer of a termination's appeal. */
  let reviewer: RealStaff;
  let m: MediaHarness;
  let s: SocialHarness;
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  /** The accounts this file's purge rounds may purge: only its own, so a deletion another suite left is never touched here. */
  const mine = new Set<string>();

  beforeAll(async () => {
    n = noticesWorld();
    world = deciderWorld(n.apiDb, { auth: n.authForModeration });
    admin = await world.staff("admin");
    reviewer = await world.staff("admin");
    m = await mediaHarness(n.apiDb);
    s = socialHarness(n.apiDb);
    before = await n.counts();
  }, 300_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    try {
      await closeDecisions();
      await n.cleanUp();
      await world.close();
    } finally {
      m.cleanup();
      await n.close();
    }
  }, 300_000);

  /** The account module's dependencies as the server composes them, its purge reading only this file's deletions. */
  const accountDeps = (overrides: Partial<AccountDeps["auth"]> = {}): AccountDeps => ({
    auth: { ...n.auth.forAccount, pendingPurges: async () => (await n.auth.forAccount.pendingPurges()).filter((id) => mine.has(id)), ...overrides },
    social: { purgeProfile: (userId, now, within) => s.repo.purgeProfile(userId, now, within), exportProfile: (userId) => exportProfile(s.deps, userId) },
    media: mediaForAccount(m.deps),
    moderation: n.moderation.forAccount,
    limits: new MemoryStore(),
    log: n.deps.log,
    now: () => new Date(),
  });
  /** An onboarded account of this file. */
  async function account() {
    const made = await n.account();
    mine.add(made.id);
    return made;
  }
  /** A confirmed decision by this file's admin: its id, or a failure that says why none was recorded. */
  async function decided(caseId: string, input: DecisionInput): Promise<string> {
    const outcome = await world.decideAs(admin, caseId, input);
    if (typeof outcome === "string") throw new Error(`the decision was not recorded: ${outcome}`);
    return outcome.decisionId;
  }
  const isDue = async (accountId: string) => (await terminationsDue(n.apiDb)).some((row) => row.accountId === accountId);
  /** Ages the account's ledger past the six months of its termination's appeal, as the migrator. */
  const pastTheAppeal = (accountId: string) => ageStandingForTest(world.migrateDb, accountId, "7 months");
  const authDeletedAt = async (id: string) => (await n.authDb.execute<{ deleted_at: Date | null }>(sql`select deleted_at from auth.users where id = ${id}::uuid`))[0]?.deleted_at ?? null;

  test("not due during the window; due once the decision is final for its author; the purge round takes the account down, mails termination_final once and purges it in the same round, and a second round does nothing", async () => {
    const ada = await account();
    const terminated = await terminateForTest(n.apiDb, ada.id);
    expect((await n.moderation.standingFor(ada.id))?.measure).toMatchObject({ decisionId: terminated.decisionId, kind: "terminate", state: "running", days: null, endsAt: null });
    expect(await isDue(ada.id)).toBe(false);
    await pastTheAppeal(ada.id);
    const [due] = (await terminationsDue(n.apiDb)).filter((row) => row.accountId === ada.id);
    expect(due).toMatchObject({ accountId: ada.id, caseId: terminated.caseId });

    const report = await purgePending(accountDeps());
    expect(report).toMatchObject({ terminated: 1, failed: 0 });
    expect(report.purged).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    expect(await authDeletedAt(ada.id)).not.toBeNull();
    const [profile] = await n.apiDb.execute<{ deleted: boolean }>(sql`select deleted_at is not null as deleted from profiles where id = ${ada.id}::uuid`);
    expect(profile?.deleted).toBe(true);
    // termination_final, once, in place of account_deleted, with the decision's day and no sentence on sealed images.
    const mails = n.mailer.to(ada.email, "termination_final");
    expect(mails).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(mails[0]!.data).toEqual({ decided: expect.stringMatching(/^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2} [0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2} UTC$/), imagesSealed: "false" });
    expect(n.mailer.to(ada.email, "account_deleted")).toEqual([]);
    const [event] = await n.authDb.execute<{ metadata: Record<string, unknown> }>(sql`select metadata from auth.auth_events where user_id = ${ada.id}::uuid and type = 'account_deleted'`);
    expect(event?.metadata).toEqual({ terminated: true });
    // The account is gone: no longer due, nothing taken down again, no second mail; the auth module's take-down of an
    // account already marked deleted writes and mails nothing and answers false.
    expect(await isDue(ada.id)).toBe(false);
    expect(await purgePending(accountDeps())).toMatchObject({ terminated: 0, failed: 0 });
    expect(await n.auth.forAccount.takeDownTerminated(ada.id, { decidedAt: new Date(), imagesSealed: false })).toBe(false);
    expect(n.mailer.to(ada.email, "termination_final")).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  test("a pending appeal keeps the account out, also past the six months, until a review keeps the decision", async () => {
    const bob = await account();
    const terminated = await terminateForTest(n.apiDb, bob.id);
    await fileAppeal(n.deps, bob.id, terminated.decisionId, {});
    await pastTheAppeal(bob.id);
    expect(await isDue(bob.id)).toBe(false);
    expect((await n.moderation.standingFor(bob.id))?.measure).toMatchObject({ appealPending: true, appealUntil: null });
    // A termination is reviewed by an admin who took no part.
    const outcome = await world.reviewAs(reviewer, terminated.decisionId, { outcome: "kept" });
    expect(typeof outcome).not.toBe("string");
    expect(await isDue(bob.id)).toBe(true);
    // The take-down waits until the decision has been final for a while (TAKE_DOWN_SETTLE_MS): an appeal in flight at a
    // deadline has settled by then. Just after the answer the round leaves it; once that while has passed it takes it down.
    expect(await purgePending(accountDeps())).toMatchObject({ terminated: 0, failed: 0 });
    await ageStandingForTest(world.migrateDb, bob.id, `${TAKE_DOWN_SETTLE_MS / 1000 + 1} seconds`);
    // The round takes it down, so no later round of this file meets it again.
    expect(await purgePending(accountDeps())).toMatchObject({ terminated: 1, failed: 0 });
  });

  test("a late reply nobody answered keeps a final termination out, and the kept answer to it lets it be due; a lift keeps it out for good", async () => {
    const carl = await account();
    const terminated = await terminateForTest(n.apiDb, carl.id);
    // A reply to a measure taken at once is always late.
    expect(await fileReply(n.deps, carl.id, terminated.decisionId, { statement: "Please look again." })).toMatchObject({ onTime: false });
    await pastTheAppeal(carl.id);
    expect(await isDue(carl.id)).toBe(false);
    await decided(terminated.caseId, { kind: "correction", outcome: "kept", reviewsDecisionId: terminated.decisionId });
    expect(await isDue(carl.id)).toBe(true);
    expect(await purgePending(accountDeps())).toMatchObject({ terminated: 1, failed: 0 });
    // The kept answer to a late reply is mailed as reply_answered.
    expect(n.mailer.to(carl.email, "reply_answered").map((mail) => mail.data.outcome)).toEqual(["kept"]);

    const dora = await account();
    const lifted = await terminateForTest(n.apiDb, dora.id);
    await decided(lifted.caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: lifted.decisionId, actions: [act("lift_suspension")] });
    await pastTheAppeal(dora.id);
    expect(await isDue(dora.id)).toBe(false);
    expect((await n.moderation.standingFor(dora.id))?.measure).toBeNull();
  });

  test("the take-down holds the profile, then the terminating decision, then reads again: a lift that waited at its case commits first, and the take-down then finds the account no longer due and mails nothing", async () => {
    const eve = await account();
    const terminated = await terminateForTest(n.apiDb, eve.id);
    await pastTheAppeal(eve.id);
    expect(await isDue(eve.id)).toBe(true);
    // The lift's params and its confirmation are made first: they read the case and save its reason, which the blocker
    // below would hold back before the lift's own transaction had taken the profile.
    const params = await decisionParams(n.apiDb, admin, terminated.caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: terminated.decisionId, actions: [act("lift_suspension")] });
    const confirmed = await world.confirm(admin, terminated.caseId, params);
    // A blocker holds the termination's case, so the lift's transaction holds the profile and waits there.
    const release = gate();
    const held = gate();
    const blocker = world.migrateDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
      await tx.execute(sql`set local lock_timeout = '60s'`);
      await tx.execute(sql`select 1 from cases where id = ${terminated.caseId}::uuid for update`);
      held.open();
      await release.opened;
    });
    let lift: Promise<unknown> | null = null;
    let taken: Promise<{ terminated: number; failed: number }> | null = null;
    const called: string[] = [];
    try {
      await held.opened;
      lift = world.moderation.forStaff.decide(admin.session, confirmed, { requestId: `req-${randomUUID()}` });
      await untilBlocked(n.apiDb, "insert into decisions", 60_000);
      // The take-down reads the account as due (the lift has not committed), then waits for the profile the lift holds.
      taken = takeDownDue(n.deps, async (accountId) => {
        called.push(accountId);
        return true;
      });
      await untilBlocked(n.apiDb, "order by id for update", 60_000);
      release.open();
      await blocker;
      expect(typeof (await lift)).not.toBe("string");
      await world.moderation.settle();
      expect(await taken).toMatchObject({ failed: 0 });
      expect(called).not.toContain(eve.id);
      expect(n.mailer.to(eve.email, "termination_final")).toEqual([]);
      expect(await authDeletedAt(eve.id)).toBeNull();
    } finally {
      release.open();
      await blocker.catch(() => undefined);
      await lift?.catch(() => undefined);
      await taken?.catch(() => undefined);
    }
  });

  test("a take-down that fails mails nothing and is counted in failed, the round still purges an ordinary deletion, and the next round takes the account down", async () => {
    const fay = await account();
    await terminateForTest(n.apiDb, fay.id);
    await pastTheAppeal(fay.id);
    const gus = await account();
    // Gus deletes his own account: the take-down of step 1, as 1b's confirmation runs it.
    await n.repo.takeDown(gus.id, new Date(), null);
    const failing = accountDeps({
      takeDownTerminated: async () => {
        throw new Error("the auth pool is down");
      },
    });
    const report = await purgePending(failing);
    expect(report).toMatchObject({ terminated: 0, failed: 1, purged: 1 });
    const [gusProfile] = await n.apiDb.execute<{ deleted: boolean }>(sql`select deleted_at is not null as deleted from profiles where id = ${gus.id}::uuid`);
    expect(gusProfile?.deleted).toBe(true);
    expect(n.mailer.to(fay.email, "termination_final")).toEqual([]);
    expect(await authDeletedAt(fay.id)).toBeNull();
    // The next round, with the auth module up: taken down, mailed once, purged.
    expect(await purgePending(accountDeps())).toMatchObject({ terminated: 1, failed: 0, purged: 1 });
    expect(n.mailer.to(fay.email, "termination_final")).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  test("this file left no row behind: what it committed is removed, and the tables hold what they held before it", async () => {
    await closeDecisions();
    await world.moderation.settle();
    await n.cleanUp();
    expect(await n.counts()).toEqual(before);
  });
});
```
