      const ran = decides;
      const res = await post(moderator, caseId, { ...params, stepUp: await confirmation(moderator, caseId, params) });
      // The key confirmed it and the route handed it over: the moderation module refuses it before it reads or writes.
      expect(decides - ran).toBe(1);
      expect([res.status, (await error(res)).code]).toEqual([422, "invalid_decision"]);
      expect(await decisionsOf(caseId)).toBe(0);
    });
  });

  describe("a decision that waits for a lock", () => {
    /** The key's confirmation of the params, its challenge issued so that about `seconds` of its ten minutes are left now. */
    async function confirmationWithLeft(caseId: string, params: CaseDecidedParams, seconds: number) {
      skewMs = -(600 - seconds) * 1000;
      try {
        return await confirmation(slow, caseId, params);
      } finally {
        skewMs = 0;
      }
    }
    /**
     * Posts the decision while a transaction of the migrator holds the audit chain's head, which every decision's last
     * statement waits for, and notes each transaction it sees waiting there (by the time it began). `during` runs while the
     * request is under way and may let the head go; it goes in any case once the request is answered.
     */
    async function postBehindHead(caseId: string, body: unknown, during: (waiting: Set<string>, letGo: () => Promise<void>) => Promise<void>) {
      const [held, release] = [gate(), gate()];
      const holder = withLockTimeout(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        await tx.execute(sql`select 1 from public.audit_head where id = 1 for update`);
        held.open();
        await release.opened;
      });
      await held.opened;
      const letGo = async () => {
        release.open();
        await holder;
      };
      const waiting = new Set<string>();
      let watching = true;
      const watch = (async () => {
        while (watching) {
          const rows = await apiDb.execute<{ began: string }>(
            sql`select xact_start::text as began from pg_stat_activity where datname = current_database() and pid <> pg_backend_pid() and wait_event_type = 'Lock' and query like '%append_confirmed_audit%'`,
          );
          for (const row of rows) waiting.add(row.began);
          await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 100));
        }
      })();
      try {
        const posting = post(slow, caseId, body);
        await during(waiting, letGo);
        return { res: await posting, waiting };
      } finally {
        watching = false;
        await watch;
        await letGo();
      }
    }
    const until = async (condition: () => boolean, what: string) => {
      const deadline = Date.now() + 40_000;
      while (!condition()) {
        if (Date.now() > deadline) throw new Error(`nothing came of waiting for ${what}`);
        await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 50));
      }
    };
    const withhold: DecisionInput = { kind: "interim", actions: [act("withhold")] };

    test("a lock timeout is retried once with the same confirmation, and the second run commits: 201 and one decision", async () => {
      await withReported(async ({ postId, caseId }) => {
        const params = await decisionParams(apiDb, slow, caseId, withhold);
        const stepUp = await confirmationWithLeft(caseId, params, 75);
        const ran = decides;
        const { res, waiting } = await postBehindHead(caseId, { ...params, stepUp }, async (seen, letGo) => {
          // The first run's wait is bounded by a fifteenth of the 75 seconds left. The second run waits in a transaction
          // of its own; then the head is let go.
          await until(() => seen.size === 2, "the second run to wait for the head");
          await letGo();
        });
        expect(res.status, await res.clone().text()).toBe(201);
        expect(waiting.size).toBe(2);
        // One confirmation, handed over once: the second run is the moderation module's own.
        expect(decides - ran).toBe(1);
        expect(await decisionsOf(caseId)).toBe(1);
        expect(await postRow(apiDb, postId)).toMatchObject({ state: "withheld", level: "withheld" });
      });
    });

    test("a second lock timeout is answered 400 challenge_expired, with nothing written", async () => {
      await withReported(async ({ postId, caseId }) => {
        const params = await decisionParams(apiDb, slow, caseId, withhold);
        const stepUp = await confirmationWithLeft(caseId, params, 75);
        // The head is held through both runs.
        const { res, waiting } = await postBehindHead(caseId, { ...params, stepUp }, async () => undefined);
        expect([res.status, (await error(res)).code]).toEqual([400, "challenge_expired"]);
        expect(waiting.size).toBe(2);
        expect(await decisionsOf(caseId)).toBe(0);
        expect(await postRow(apiDb, postId)).toMatchObject({ state: "visible", level: "visible" });
      });
    });

    test("a lock timeout met with a minute or less of the challenge left is not retried: 400 challenge_expired after the one run, with nothing written", async () => {
      await withReported(async ({ postId, caseId }) => {
        const params = await decisionParams(apiDb, slow, caseId, withhold);
        // 64 seconds: the step-up itself is refused within a minute of the expiry, so the decision starts with a little
        // more than that, and its one bounded wait, a fifteenth of what is left, ends with less than a minute to go.
        const stepUp = await confirmationWithLeft(caseId, params, 64);
        const { res, waiting } = await postBehindHead(caseId, { ...params, stepUp }, async () => undefined);
        expect([res.status, (await error(res)).code]).toEqual([400, "challenge_expired"]);
        expect(waiting.size).toBe(1);
        expect(await decisionsOf(caseId)).toBe(0);
        expect(await postRow(apiDb, postId)).toMatchObject({ state: "visible", level: "visible" });
      });
    });
  });

  test("this file left no row behind: the tables it writes, the moderation tables and the four auth tables of moderation cases hold what they held before it", async () => {
    await settle();
    expect(await counts()).toEqual(before);
  });
});

  describe("gate K: every deleter against a frozen post", () => {
    /** Each way a post comes to be frozen, with nothing else that would keep its rows: no hold stands on them. */
    const FREEZES: Record<string, (w: World, post: { postId: string; ownerId: string; handle: string }) => Promise<void>> = {
      "its own item": async (w, post) => {
        await suspectItemOn(w.tx, "post", post.postId);
      },
      "its author's account's item": async (w, post) => {
        await suspectItemOn(w.tx, "account", post.ownerId);
      },
      "an item korbat added for a post that quotes it": async (w, post) => {
        const quoting = await newPostRow(w.tx, (await newProfile(w.tx as unknown as Db)).id, { quoteOfId: post.postId });
        const named = await suspectItemOn(w.tx, "post", quoting);
        await insertItem(w.tx, { intakeId: named.intakeId, caseId: await openCase(w.tx, "post", post.postId), targetId: post.postId, position: 11, lane: 0 });
      },
      "a seal taken while deciding": async (w, post) => {
        const { caseId } = await report(w.tx, anAccount(post.ownerId, post.handle), "csam");
        await decideIn(w.tx, mod, caseId, SEAL_WHILE_DECIDING);
      },
      "a seal for good, whose case is closed": async (w, post) => {
        const { caseId } = await report(w.tx, anAccount(post.ownerId, post.handle), "csam");
        await decideIn(w.tx, admin, caseId, SEAL_FOR_GOOD);
      },
    };

    test.each(Object.keys(FREEZES))("frozen through %s: each deleter leaves the rows, answers no id of them and no file of them is requested, before and after the author deleted the post", async (freeze) => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {
        const ada = await w.h.established();
        const p = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 2);
        const upload = await w.h.readyImage(ada.id);
        await FREEZES[freeze]!(w, { postId: p.postId, ownerId: ada.id, handle: ada.handle });
        expect(await postFrozen(w.tx, p.postId)).toBe(true);
        // No hold stands on the rows: what keeps them is the freeze.
        expect(await w.tx.execute(sql`select 1 from media_holds where media_id = any(${uuids(p.mediaIds)})`)).toHaveLength(0);

        const frozen: Frozen = { repo: w.repo, tx: w.tx, ownerId: ada.id, postId: p.postId, mediaIds: p.mediaIds };
        for (const when of ["as posted", "deleted by its author"]) {
          if (when === "deleted by its author") await authorDeletes(w.tx, p.postId);
          for (const [name, run] of Object.entries(DELETERS)) {
            const answered = await run(frozen);
            expect(answered.filter((id) => p.mediaIds.includes(id)), `${name}, ${when}`).toEqual([]);
            expect(await existing(w.tx, p.mediaIds), `${name}, ${when}`).toEqual(sorted(p.mediaIds));
          }
        }
        // The account's upload on no post is reached by no case: the owner's purge took it.
        expect(await existing(w.tx, [upload])).toEqual([]);
        expect((await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).filter((id) => p.mediaIds.includes(id))).toEqual([]);
      });
    });

    test("once nothing freezes the post any more, the same deleters take its rows", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {
        const ada = await w.h.established();
        const p = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 2);
        const { caseId } = await report(w.tx, anAccount(ada.id, ada.handle), "csam");
        expect(await w.repo.detachAll(w.tx, p.postId)).toEqual([]);
        await decideIn(w.tx, admin, caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
        expect(sorted(await w.repo.detachAll(w.tx, p.postId))).toEqual(sorted(p.mediaIds));
      });
    });

    test("a hold that is released on a frozen post's image frees nothing: the freeze keeps the row whether a hold stands or not", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {
        const ada = await w.h.established();
        const p = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 1);
        // A report about the post itself places its case's hold and freezes the post.
        await report(w.tx, aPost(p.postId), "csam");
        await w.tx.execute(sql`update media_holds set released_at = now() where media_id = ${p.mediaIds[0]!}::uuid`);
        const [row] = await w.tx.execute<{ held: boolean }>(sql`select hold_until is not null as held from post_media where id = ${p.mediaIds[0]!}::uuid`);
        expect(row).toEqual({ held: false });
        await authorDeletes(w.tx, p.postId);
        for (const [name, run] of Object.entries(DELETERS)) {
          await run({ repo: w.repo, tx: w.tx, ownerId: ada.id, postId: p.postId, mediaIds: p.mediaIds });
          expect(await existing(w.tx, p.mediaIds), name).toEqual(p.mediaIds);
        }
      }, migrateDb);
    });
  });

  describe("gate K through the flows: the author's deletion, the purge, the sweeper and the reconcile pass", () => {
    /** Each kind of reach through a real report of child sexual abuse material; it answers nothing, the post is frozen. */
    const REPORTS: Record<string, (w: World, post: { postId: string; ownerId: string; handle: string }) => Promise<unknown>> = {
      "its own item": (w, post) => report(w.tx, aPost(post.postId), "csam"),
      "its author's account's item": (w, post) => report(w.tx, anAccount(post.ownerId, post.handle), "csam"),
      "an item korbat added for a post that quotes it": async (w, post) => report(w.tx, aPost(await newPostRow(w.tx, (await newProfile(w.tx as unknown as Db)).id, { quoteOfId: post.postId })), "csam"),
    };

    test.each(Object.keys(REPORTS))("a post frozen through %s: its rows outlive every flow that deletes, no file of them is requested, and no reader shows them once the post is deleted", async (kind) => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {
        const ada = await w.s.established();
        const frozen = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 2);
        const free = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 1);
        const upload = await w.h.readyImage(ada.id);
        await REPORTS[kind]!(w, { postId: frozen.postId, ownerId: ada.id, handle: ada.handle });
        // A case about the account reaches every post of the account, so there the other post's image is kept too.
        const kept = kind === "its author's account's item" ? [...frozen.mediaIds, ...free.mediaIds] : frozen.mediaIds;
        const requested = async () => (await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).filter((id) => kept.includes(id));

        // The author deletes the post, through the flow: the post is a tombstone, and its image rows stay.
        await deletePost(w.s.deps, ada.id, frozen.postId);
        expect(await rejection(getPost(w.s.deps, ada.id, frozen.postId))).toBe("not_found");
        expect(await existing(w.tx, frozen.mediaIds)).toEqual(sorted(frozen.mediaIds));
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);

        // No reader shows a kept image of a deleted post, to its owner either, so the freeze tells the author nothing.
        for (const id of frozen.mediaIds) {
          for (const viewer of [ada.id, null]) expect((await ask(w, id, viewer)).kind, `serve ${String(viewer)}`).toBe("not_found");
          expect(await w.repo.find(id)).toBeNull();
          expect(await rejection(status(w.h.deps, ada.id, id))).toBe("not_found");
          expect(await w.repo.isExportable(ada.id, id)).toBe(false);
        }
        expect((await w.repo.forPosts([frozen.postId])).size).toBe(0);
        expect(await w.repo.readyImages(ada.id)).toEqual([...free.mediaIds, upload]);
        // The reconcile pass asks which ids have a row: the kept rows are seen, so their files are no orphans.
        expect(await w.repo.existing(frozen.mediaIds)).toEqual(new Set(frozen.mediaIds));

        // The export names no image under the deleted post, holds no file of it, and lists none as missing.
        const { entries, json } = await exportOf(w, ada.id);
        expect(entries).toEqual(["export.json", `media/${free.mediaIds[0]}.webp`, `media/${upload}.webp`].sort());
        expect(json.posts.find((post) => post.id === frozen.postId)).toMatchObject({ state: "deleted_by_author", body: "", media: [] });
        expect(json.posts.find((post) => post.id === free.postId)!.media.map((image) => image.id)).toEqual(free.mediaIds);
        expect(json.missingMedia).toEqual([]);

        // The sweeper two days on, with its reconcile pass: every stored file is old by then, and none of the kept rows'
        // files is taken for an orphan.
        await sweep(w.h.deps, new Date(Date.now() + 2 * DAY), { reconcile: true });
        expect(await existing(w.tx, frozen.mediaIds)).toEqual(sorted(frozen.mediaIds));
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);

        // The account is purged, by the request and then again by the job: the kept rows stay, unserved, and only the
        // files of the rows that went are requested.
        const deps = accountDeps(w, [ada.id]);
        await purge(deps, ada.id);
        expect(await purgePending(deps)).toEqual({ purged: 1, failed: 0, terminated: 0 });
        expect(deps.finished).toEqual([ada.id, ada.id]);
        expect(await existing(w.tx, [...frozen.mediaIds, ...free.mediaIds, upload])).toEqual(sorted(kept));
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
        expect(await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining([...free.mediaIds, upload].filter((id) => !kept.includes(id))));
        for (const id of frozen.mediaIds) expect((await ask(w, id, ada.id)).kind).toBe("not_found");
        expect(await postFrozen(w.tx, frozen.postId)).toBe(true);
      });
    });

    test("a purge whose transaction does not commit has asked for no file: a report that then freezes the account keeps rows whose files nobody was told to delete, neither the rerun nor the sweeper asks for them, and a seal lists images that are still there", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {
        const ada = await w.s.established();
        const own = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 2);
        const requested = async () => (await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).filter((id) => own.mediaIds.includes(id));
        const deps = accountDeps(w, [ada.id]);
        // The first run deletes the rows, and its transaction does not commit: the process stops, or the connection is lost.
        const stopping: AccountDeps = {
          ...deps,
          social: {
            ...deps.social,
            purgeProfile: (userId, now, within) =>
              w.s.repo.purgeProfile(userId, now, async (tx) => {
                await within(tx);
                throw new Error("the transaction did not commit");
              }),
          },
        };
        await expect(purge(stopping, ada.id)).rejects.toThrow("the transaction did not commit");
        expect(await existing(w.tx, own.mediaIds)).toEqual(sorted(own.mediaIds));
        // The rows are back, and no file of them was asked for: the worker deletes whatever a request names.
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);

        // Before the purge job's next round, a report on the protected path about the account: every image is frozen.
        const suspect = await report(w.tx, anAccount(ada.id, ada.handle), "csam");
        expect(await postFrozen(w.tx, own.postId)).toBe(true);
        // The job's rerun keeps the frozen rows and asks for nothing of them.
        expect(await purgePending(deps)).toEqual({ purged: 1, failed: 0, terminated: 0 });
        expect(await existing(w.tx, own.mediaIds)).toEqual(sorted(own.mediaIds));
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
        // The sweeper, which asks again for whatever a deleter still owes: a row that is still there is owed nothing,
        // at once or two days on, when the marker the failed run left is forgotten.
        await sweep(w.h.deps, new Date(), { reconcile: false });
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
        await sweep(w.h.deps, new Date(Date.now() + 2 * DAY), { reconcile: true });
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
        expect((await w.h.files.owedDeletions(Date.now())).filter((entry) => own.mediaIds.includes(entry.id))).toEqual([]);
        for (const id of own.mediaIds) expect(await w.h.files.imageRemains(id)).toBe(true);

        // An admin seals: the seal lists the rows, and their files are there for whoever they are released to.
        await decideIn(w.tx, admin, suspect.caseId, SEAL_FOR_GOOD);
        const states = await w.tx.execute<{ moderation_state: string }>(sql`select moderation_state from post_media where id = any(${uuids(own.mediaIds)})`);
        expect(states.map((row) => row.moderation_state)).toEqual(["sealed", "sealed"]);
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
      });
    });

    test("a purge that commits and whose request for the files then fails still finishes: what it deleted stays owed, is counted as late, and the sweeper's next pass asks for exactly those files", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {
        const ada = await w.s.established();
        const own = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 2);
        const upload = await w.h.readyImage(ada.id);
        const mine = [...own.mediaIds, upload];
        const requested = async () => sorted((await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).filter((id) => mine.includes(id)));
        const owed = async () => sorted((await w.h.files.owedDeletions(Date.now())).map((entry) => entry.id).filter((id) => mine.includes(id)));
        const deps = accountDeps(w, [ada.id]);
        // The requests' directory cannot be written when the purge comes to ask.
        const failing: AccountDeps = {
          ...deps,
          media: mediaForAccount({
            ...w.h.deps,
            files: {
              ...w.h.files,
              requestDeletion: async () => {
                throw new Error("EROFS: the uploads volume cannot be written");
              },
            },
          }),
        };
        await purge(failing, ada.id);
        expect(deps.finished).toEqual([ada.id]);
        expect(await existing(w.tx, mine)).toEqual([]);
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
        expect(await owed()).toEqual(sorted(mine));
        // Ten minutes on, what is still owed counts among the late erasures of the staff's home screen.
        const drained = await mediaForCases(w.h.deps).overdueDeletions();
        const later = mediaForCases({ ...w.h.deps, now: () => new Date(Date.now() + 11 * 60_000) });
        expect((await later.overdueDeletions()) - drained).toBe(mine.length);

        // The sweeper's next pass, with the volume back: the files are asked for, and nothing is owed any more.
        await sweep(w.h.deps, new Date(), { reconcile: false });
        expect(await requested()).toEqual(sorted(mine));
        expect(await owed()).toEqual([]);
        expect(await later.overdueDeletions()).toBe(drained);
      });
    });

    test("the account's purge end to end with open cases about it and a report it sent: a run that does not commit asks for nothing; the request's run and the job's keep what a case holds or a freeze keeps, ask for none of its files and forget her report; the cases then go on to their decisions, the disposal and the erasure of statements", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {
        const ada = await w.s.established();
        const own = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 1);
        const second = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 1);
        const other = await imagePost(w.tx, 0);
        // She reported someone else's post, signed in; someone reported a post of hers under a rule; and her account is
        // reported on the protected path. The take-down has marked her auth row.
        const hers = await intake(w.tx, ground.illegal(ada.id), aPost(other.postId));
        const rule = await report(w.tx, aPost(own.postId), "rule");
        const suspect = await report(w.tx, anAccount(ada.id, ada.handle), "csam");
        await authAccount(w.tx, ada.id, "0 seconds");
        const images = [...own.mediaIds, ...second.mediaIds];
        const requested = async () => (await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).filter((id) => images.includes(id));
        const base = accountDeps(w, [ada.id]);
        const deps: typeof base = {
          ...base,
          moderation: {
            forgetAccount: async (userId) => void (await forgetReporter(w.tx, userId)),
            exportFor: () => Promise.reject(new Error("not exercised here")),
            takeDownDue: async () => ({ terminated: 0, failed: 0 }),
          },
        };

        // A first run whose transaction does not commit: nothing of it stands, and no file was asked for.
        const stopping: AccountDeps = {
          ...deps,
          social: {
            ...deps.social,
            purgeProfile: (userId, now, within) =>
              w.s.repo.purgeProfile(userId, now, async (tx) => {
                await within(tx);
                throw new Error("the transaction did not commit");
              }),
          },
        };
        await expect(purge(stopping, ada.id)).rejects.toThrow("the transaction did not commit");
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);

        // The request's run, and the job's after it.
        await purge(deps, ada.id);
        expect(await purgePending(deps)).toEqual({ purged: 1, failed: 0, terminated: 0 });
        expect(deps.finished).toEqual([ada.id, ada.id]);
        const [profile] = await w.tx.execute<{ display_name: string; bio: string; deleted: boolean; handle: string }>(sql`select display_name, bio, deleted_at is not null as deleted, handle from profiles where id = ${ada.id}::uuid`);
        expect({ ...profile! }).toEqual({ display_name: "Deleted account", bio: "", deleted: true, handle: ada.handle });
        expect([...(await w.tx.execute<{ state: string; body: string }>(sql`select state, body from posts where author_id = ${ada.id}::uuid`))].map((row) => ({ ...row }))).toEqual([
          { state: "deleted_by_author", body: "" },
          { state: "deleted_by_author", body: "" },
        ]);
        // Every image row stays (the freeze keeps them all, the rule case holds one), and none of their files was asked for.
        expect(await existing(w.tx, images)).toEqual(sorted(images));
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
        expect([await postFrozen(w.tx, own.postId), await postFrozen(w.tx, second.postId)]).toEqual([true, true]);
        // Her report no longer names her, on the notice or on its items.
        const [forgotten] = await w.tx.execute<{ intake: boolean; items: boolean }>(
          sql`select n.reporter_id is null as intake, (select bool_and(i.reporter_account_id is null) from intake_items i where i.intake_id = n.id) as items from intakes n where n.id = ${hers.intakeId}::uuid`,
        );
        expect({ ...forgotten! }).toEqual({ intake: true, items: true });

        // The rule case is decided on its copy: the removal changes nothing, the post being deleted, and says so.
        const removal = await decideIn(w.tx, mod, rule.caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R1", actions: [act("remove")] });
        // 3e: the strike it gives counts all the same (a strike never has a no_effect): what counts is the breach.
        expect((await actionsOf(w.tx, removal)).map((action) => [action.kind, action.no_effect])).toEqual([
          ["remove", "deleted"],
          ["strike", null],
        ]);
        expect(statementParagraphs((await decisionStatement(w.tx as unknown as Db, removal))!.statement)[0]).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.deletedPost);
        // Its mail finds nobody: the auth module answers no_address for an account that is gone.
        expect(await sendStatement({ apiDb: w.tx as unknown as Db, auth: { mailAccount: async () => "no_address" } as never, social: socialForModeration(w.tx as unknown as Db) }, removal)).toBe("no_address");

        // The admin answers the report about her account without a seal: the freeze ends, and the disposal takes the image
        // no case holds and keeps the one the rule case holds.
        await decideIn(w.tx, admin, suspect.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
        expect([await postFrozen(w.tx, own.postId), await postFrozen(w.tx, second.postId)]).toEqual([false, false]);
        const gone = await w.cases.dropDisposable(w.tx);
        expect(gone.filter((id) => images.includes(id))).toEqual(second.mediaIds);
        expect(await existing(w.tx, images)).toEqual(own.mediaIds);

        // Thirteen months after her account was deleted, the removal's statement texts are due and erased.
        await ageCase(w.tx, rule.caseId, "13 months");
        await w.tx.execute(sql`update auth.users set deleted_at = now() - interval '13 months' where id = ${ada.id}::uuid`);
        await w.tx.execute(sql`update profiles set deleted_at = now() - interval '13 months' where id = ${ada.id}::uuid`);
        expect(await dueStatements(w.tx, 12)).toContain(removal);
        expect(await eraseStatementTexts(w.tx, removal)).toBe(2);
      }, migrateDb);
    });

    test("a deleted post whose images a case holds, with no freeze: the same for every reader and for the export", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {
        const ada = await w.s.established();
        const held = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 2);
        const free = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 1);
        // A report under a rule: its case holds the post's images as evidence.
        await report(w.tx, aPost(held.postId), "rule");
        expect(await postFrozen(w.tx, held.postId)).toBe(false);
        await deletePost(w.s.deps, ada.id, held.postId);
        expect(await existing(w.tx, held.mediaIds)).toEqual(sorted(held.mediaIds));
        expect((await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).filter((id) => held.mediaIds.includes(id))).toEqual([]);
        for (const id of held.mediaIds) {
          expect((await ask(w, id, ada.id)).kind).toBe("not_found");
          expect(await rejection(status(w.h.deps, ada.id, id))).toBe("not_found");
        }
        const { entries, json } = await exportOf(w, ada.id);
        expect(entries).toEqual(["export.json", `media/${free.mediaIds[0]}.webp`].sort());
        expect(json.posts.find((post) => post.id === held.postId)).toMatchObject({ state: "deleted_by_author", media: [] });
        expect(json.missingMedia).toEqual([]);
        // The sweeper's reconcile pass leaves the retained rows' files alone.
        await sweep(w.h.deps, new Date(Date.now() + 2 * DAY), { reconcile: true });
        expect((await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).filter((id) => held.mediaIds.includes(id))).toEqual([]);
        expect(await existing(w.tx, held.mediaIds)).toEqual(sorted(held.mediaIds));
      });
    });
  });

  describe("gates S and V: every reader, for a frozen post and for sealed images", () => {
    /** An author with an image post, a reply of their own with an image and a post Explore ranks, and a reader who follows them. */
    async function scene(w: World) {
      // Explore ranks as of a past this file has to itself, so no other suite's post is in the ranking read below.
      const asOf = new Date(Date.UTC(2019, 0, 10, 12));
      const [author, other, ...fans] = await accounts(w.tx as unknown as Db, asOf, 5);
      const top = await w.h.postWithImages(author!.id, 2);
      const strangerReply = await newPost(w.s.repo, other!.id, w.s.clock.next(), "a reply by someone else", { replyToId: top.postId });
      const reply = await newPost(w.s.repo, author!.id, w.s.clock.next(), "a reply with an image", { replyToId: top.postId });
      const replyImage = await w.h.readyImage(author!.id);
      await w.tx.execute(sql`update post_media set post_id = ${reply}::uuid, position = 0, alt_text = 'a reply image' where id = ${replyImage}::uuid`);
      const quoting = await newPost(w.s.repo, other!.id, w.s.clock.next(), "look at this", { quoteOfId: top.postId });
      const ranked = await newPostRow(w.tx, author!.id, { createdAt: sql`${earlier(asOf, 2 * HOUR).toISOString()}::timestamptz` });
      const rankedImage = await newImageRow(w.tx, author!.id, ranked, 0);
      await likedBy(w.s.repo, ranked, fans as { id: string }[], earlier(asOf, HOUR));
      // A round writes nothing while a ranking as new as its own time exists, and other suites leave theirs behind:
      // inside this transaction, which is rolled back, there is none.
      await w.tx.execute(sql`delete from explore_runs`);
      await rank(w.s.repo, asOf);
      for (const reader of [author!, other!]) {
        expect(await w.s.repo.like(reader.id, top.postId, w.s.clock.next())).toBe(true);
        expect(await w.s.repo.bookmark(reader.id, top.postId, w.s.clock.next())).toBe(true);
      }
      expect(await w.s.repo.follow(other!.id, author!.id, w.s.clock.next())).toBe(true);
      return { author: author!, other: other!, top, strangerReply, reply, replyImage, quoting, ranked, rankedImage };
    }
    type Scene = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof scene>>;
    type Listed = (MediaView | HiddenMedia)[] | undefined;

    /**
     * Every list a post's images are read through, each as the viewer gets it: the images of the named post in that list.
     * `signedIn` marks the lists only an account has; Following is read by the one who follows the author.
     */
    function lists(w: World, f: Scene): { name: string; images: string[]; signedIn?: boolean; onlyFor?: string; read: (viewer: string | null) => Promise<Listed> }[] {
      const top = [...f.top.mediaIds];
      const inItems = (items: { post: PostView }[], id: string) => items.find((item) => item.post.id === id)?.post.media;
      const inPosts = (items: PostView[], id: string) => items.find((post) => post.id === id)?.media;
      return [
        { name: "the single post", images: top, read: async (v) => (await getPost(w.s.deps, v, f.top.postId)).media },
        { name: "a thread's own post", images: top, read: async (v) => (await thread(w.s.deps, v, f.top.postId, page)).post.media },
        { name: "a thread's ancestor", images: top, read: async (v) => inPosts((await thread(w.s.deps, v, f.strangerReply, page)).ancestors as PostView[], f.top.postId) },

        { name: "the Following timeline", images: top, signedIn: true, onlyFor: f.other.id, read: async (v) => inItems((await followingTimeline(w.s.deps, v!, page)).items, f.top.postId) },
        { name: "Explore", images: [f.rankedImage], read: async (v) => inItems((await explorePage(w.s.deps, v, page)).items, f.ranked) },
        { name: "the profile's posts", images: top, read: async (v) => inItems((await profilePosts(w.s.deps, v, f.author.handle, page)).items, f.top.postId) },
        { name: "the profile's replies", images: [f.replyImage], read: async (v) => inPosts((await profileReplies(w.s.deps, v, f.author.handle, page)).items, f.reply) },
        { name: "likes", images: top, signedIn: true, read: async (v) => inPosts((await likedPosts(w.s.deps, v!, page)).items, f.top.postId) },
        { name: "bookmarks", images: top, signedIn: true, read: async (v) => inPosts((await bookmarkedPosts(w.s.deps, v!, page)).items, f.top.postId) },
        { name: "a quote embed", images: top, read: async (v) => { const quote = (await getPost(w.s.deps, v, f.quoting)).quoteOf; return quote && "media" in quote ? quote.media : undefined; } },
      ];
    }
    /** Runs every list for every viewer it has, and hands each answer to `check`. */
    async function everyList(w: World, f: Scene, check: (answer: Listed, images: string[], viewer: string | null, label: string) => void) {
      for (const list of lists(w, f)) {
        for (const viewer of [f.author.id, f.other.id, null]) {
          if (viewer === null && list.signedIn) continue;
          if (list.onlyFor && viewer !== list.onlyFor) continue;
          check(await list.read(viewer), list.images, viewer, `${list.name}, read by ${viewer === f.author.id ? "the author" : viewer === null ? "nobody signed in" : "another account"}`);
        }
      }
    }
    test("a frozen post whose images are not sealed: staff are refused, and every other reader is unchanged", async () => {

          expect(answer!.some((image) => "hidden" in image), label).toBe(false);
        });
        // Twelve lists: nine for every reader, likes and bookmarks for the two accounts, Following for the one who follows.
        expect(read).toBe(9 * 3 + 2 * 2 + 1);
        for (const id of f.top.mediaIds) {
          for (const viewer of [f.author.id, f.other.id, null]) expect(await ask(w, id, viewer), String(viewer)).toEqual({ kind: "file", cacheControl: "public, max-age=300" });
          expect(await status(w.h.deps, f.author.id, id)).toMatchObject({ status: "ready", blurhash: "L2Eo_P_3jb_3~qoL" });
          expect(await w.repo.isExportable(f.author.id, id)).toBe(true);
        }
        expect(await w.repo.readyImages(f.author.id)).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining([...f.top.mediaIds, f.replyImage, f.rankedImage]));
        // Gate V: nobody at korbat opens an image of a frozen post, though everyone else is still served it.
        for (const id of f.top.mediaIds) {
          writeFileSync(w.h.files.store.image(id, "large"), webpBytes("VP8X", 2048, 1536));
          expect(await staffOpens(w, id)).toBe(false);
        }
      });
    });

    test("sealed images: nobody is served, the author included; every list carries the placeholder, with `sealed` only for the author and nothing of the image; the export holds none", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {

          read++;

          // Nothing made from the image, and nothing that leads to it.

          for (const part of ["blurhash", "L2Eo_P", "/api/media/", "width", "alt", "image 1"]) expect(text, `${label}: ${part}`).not.toContain(part);
          // What the contract's post view accepts in its media list.

        });

          // A browser that holds the file's tag gets no "not modified" either.

        const media = async (viewer: string | null) => (await getPost(w.s.deps, viewer, p.postId)).media;

        expect(await staffOpens(w, second)).toBe(true);

    await reviewed(admin2, suspension, { outcome: "kept" });
    await reviewed(mod2, r.decisionId, { outcome: "kept" });

  test("a kept review by a second moderator: the first is refused, the author is mailed the review's statement and reads it on the decision's screen, and the post's chip still names the removal", async () => {

  test("a moderator lifts early what another withheld while deciding on a report of a threat: no admin is needed, the post is shown again and its author is told at once", async () => {

    expect(renderMail(updates.at(-1)!).text).toContain("A decision changed on review or by a correction, or given on re-examination, is final within korbat.");

  describe("an appeal against a correction that reverses everything, in either order", () => {
    test("the correction is being recorded when the appeal arrives: the appeal waits for it and is refused, since nothing is left to appeal", async () => {
      const r = await removedPost();

      const [held, release] = [gate(), gate()];

      const holder = withLockTimeout(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {

        await untilBlocked(w.apiDb, "append_confirmed_audit");

        await untilBlocked(w.apiDb, "insert into appeals");

        await holder;

      await d.moderation.settle();

      const [held, release] = [gate(), gate()];

      const appealing = withLockTimeout(w.apiDb, async (tx) => {
        const id = await appealOf(tx, r.decisionId, r.author.id);

        await release.opened;

        correcting = settled(d.moderation.forStaff.decide(admin.session, confirmed, { requestId: `req-${randomUUID()}` }));
        await untilBlocked(w.apiDb, "insert into decisions");

      expect(await appealsOf(r.decisionId)).toEqual([{ id: appeal, result: "reversed", answered_by: corrected.decisionId }]);
      // The author reads the correction as the answer to their appeal.
      expect((await authorDecisionView(w.deps, r.author.id, r.decisionId)).appeal).toMatchObject({ state: "answered", result: "reversed", answeredBy: corrected.decisionId, statement: { kind: "correction", outcome: "reversed" } });
    });

      const third = await recordIntake(w.deps, { ground: ground.rule((await w.account()).id), live: [aPost(r.postId)] });
      expect(third.items[0]).toMatchObject({ caseId: r.caseId, seq: 3 });

      await appealing;

    expect(await appealsOf(removal)).toHaveLength(1);

  test("this file left no row behind: the moderation tables and the four auth tables of moderation cases hold what they held before it", async () => {

import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import type { RuleId } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { closeDb, createDb, type Db, type DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import type { ActiveStaffSession } from "../../src/auth";
import { createAuthRepo, type AuthRepo } from "../../src/auth/repo";
import { loadConfig } from "../../src/config";
import { appealsList } from "../../src/moderation/appeals";
import { authorDecisionView } from "../../src/moderation/author";
import { overview, readCase as readCaseView } from "../../src/moderation/cases";
import { appendConfirmedAudit, insertAction, insertDecision, insertReview } from "../../src/moderation/repo";
import { newUserWithDevice } from "./auth-fixtures";

  aPost,
  act,
  actionsOf,
  appealOf,
  appealRow,
  authCaseCounts,
  decideIn,
  decisionParams,
  decisionRow,
  ground,
  hex64,
  imageStates,

  newImageRow,

  type DecisionInput,
  type TestStaff,
} from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { newProfile } from "./social-fixtures";
import { pgError, rolledBack } from "./staff-fixtures";

// Every test here runs dozens of statements inside one open transaction, each a round trip: on a loaded machine that
// takes longer than the five seconds a test gets by default.
vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 60_000 });

/**
 * Migration 0017 (3c design, section 6.3) against the real database: the trigger that decides whether an appeal is
 * open, a review as a decision of its own with its appeal forced, who may review, what a review and a correction do to
 * an appeal, and the seal taken while deciding that the database now refuses when it would not be in force.
 *
 * Each test runs inside one transaction that is rolled back, as korbat_api, the role the running API holds; the few
 * that must move a decision's time, link a staff account or change which staff accounts exist run as the migrator, and
 * say so. A decision and a review are made through the moderation module's own functions with a made-up confirmation
 * (the audit row is never committed), and the check at commit is made to run right after each. The staff accounts' auth
 * rows are committed by the file's set-up, since the triggers read them in the auth schema; their profiles exist only
 * inside each test's transaction. The file's last test holds it to leaving no row behind.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: appeals and reviews in the database (migration 0017)", () => {
  let apiDb: Db;
  let authDb: Db;
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let repo: AuthRepo;
  /** Two moderators and two admins: whoever decides, someone else of the needed role is left to review. */
  let mod: TestStaff;
  let mod2: TestStaff;
  let admin: TestStaff;
  let admin2: TestStaff;
  /** A personal account, which a test may link to a staff account inside its own transaction. */
  let personal: string;
  let before: Record<string, number>;

  const counts = async (): Promise<Record<string, number>> => ({ ...(await rowCounts(apiDb)), ...(await authCaseCounts(migrateDb)) });

  beforeAll(async () => {
    const config = loadConfig();
    apiDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 4 });
    authDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_AUTH, { max: 2 });
    // The migrate role is not part of the API configuration; the test environment carries it.
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 2 });
    repo = createAuthRepo(authDb);
    mod = await newTestStaff(authDb, migrateDb, repo, "moderator");
    mod2 = await newTestStaff(authDb, migrateDb, repo, "moderator");
    admin = await newTestStaff(authDb, migrateDb, repo, "admin");
    admin2 = await newTestStaff(authDb, migrateDb, repo, "admin");
    personal = (await newUserWithDevice(repo)).user.id;
    before = await counts();
  }, 60_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    await Promise.all([closeDb(apiDb), closeDb(authDb), closeDb(migrateDb)]);
  });

  /** One test's world: a transaction of the given pool that is rolled back, with the four staff members' profiles in it. */
  const inWorld = (fn: (tx: DbTx) => Promise<void>, db: Db = apiDb) =>
    rolledBack(db, async (tx) => {
      for (const staff of [mod, mod2, admin, admin2]) await staffProfile(tx, staff);
      await fn(tx);
    });
  const profile = (tx: DbTx) => newProfile(tx as unknown as Db);
  /** The error of one step inside a transaction, which stays usable: the step runs in a savepoint. */
  const within = (tx: DbTx, fn: (sp: DbTx) => Promise<unknown>) => pgError(tx.transaction(fn));
  /** What an appeal was refused with, in a savepoint: the trigger's code, the violated constraint, or null when it was stored. */
  const appealRefusal = async (tx: DbTx, decisionId: string, appellantId: string) => {
    try {
      await tx.transaction((sp) => appealOf(sp, decisionId, appellantId));
      return null;
    } catch (err) {
      const found = raised(err);
      return found?.code === "P0001" ? found.message : found?.code === "23505" ? "appeals_once" : `${found?.code} ${found?.message}`;
    }
  };

  /** A staff session as requireStaff hands it over. */
  function sessionOf(staff: TestStaff): ActiveStaffSession {
    const now = new Date();
    return {
      sessionId: hex64(),
      handle: randomUUID(),
      userId: staff.id,
      keyId: staff.keyId,
      role: staff.role,
      createdAt: now,
      lastUsedAt: now,
      idleExpiresAt: new Date(now.getTime() + 15 * 60_000),
      absoluteExpiresAt: new Date(now.getTime() + 12 * 60 * 60_000),
      browser: "Firefox on Linux",
    };
  }

  interface Restricted {
    authorId: string;
    postId: string;
    mediaIds: string[];
    reporterId: string | null;
    caseId: string;
    decisionId: string;
  }

  /**
   * An author's post with this many images, reported once (under a rule, or on the path for child sexual abuse material)
   * and restricted by a final decision: a removal by the first moderator under the report's rule, unless said.
   */
  async function restricted(tx: DbTx, options: { images?: number; by?: "rule" | "csam"; rule?: RuleId; reporterId?: string; decider?: TestStaff; decision?: DecisionInput } = {}): Promise<Restricted> {
    const authorId = (await profile(tx)).id;
    const postId = await newPostRow(tx, authorId);
    const mediaIds: string[] = [];
    for (let position = 0; position < (options.images ?? 0); position++) mediaIds.push(await newImageRow(tx, authorId, postId, position));
    const csam = options.by === "csam";
    const reporterId = csam ? null : (options.reporterId ?? (await profile(tx)).id);
    const recorded = await intake(tx, csam ? ground.csam() : ground.rule(reporterId!, options.rule ?? "R1"), aPost(postId));
    const caseId = recorded.items[0]!.caseId!;
    const decision: DecisionInput = { kind: "final", ruleId: csam ? "R2" : (options.rule ?? "R1"), actions: [act("remove")], ...options.decision };
    const decisionId = await decideIn(tx, options.decider ?? mod, caseId, decision);
    return { authorId, postId, mediaIds, reporterId, caseId, decisionId };
  }

  describe("an appeal is open for the author of a final restriction that is in force, within its window", () => {
    test("the author's appeal is stored unanswered and stamped by the database, whatever the insert supplied; a second one is refused by the unique index", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const r = await restricted(tx);
        const [row] = await tx.execute<Record<string, unknown>>(sql`
          insert into appeals (decision_id, appellant_account_id, filed_at, answered_by, result, answered_at, erased_at)
          values (${r.decisionId}::uuid, ${r.authorId}::uuid, '2001-01-01T00:00:00Z', ${r.decisionId}::uuid, 'kept', '2001-01-01T00:00:00Z', '2001-01-01T00:00:00Z')
          returning filed_at = now() as filed_now, answered_by, result, answered_at, erased_at`);
        expect({ ...row! }).toEqual({ filed_now: true, answered_by: null, result: null, answered_at: null, erased_at: null });
        // One appeal for each decision, also once it is answered.
        expect(await appealRefusal(tx, r.decisionId, r.authorId)).toBe("appeals_once");
        // An appeal changes nothing of its case: its version is the one the console read.
        expect((await readCase(tx, r.caseId)).state_version).toBe(1);
      });
    });

    test("an appeal of a decision taken while deciding, of one that restricts nothing, of a correction, of a review, of someone else's decision and of none is refused as appeal_not_open", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        // What korbat does while it decides cannot be appealed.
        const authorId = (await profile(tx)).id;
        const postId = await newPostRow(tx, authorId);
        const imageId = await newImageRow(tx, authorId, postId, 0);
        const reporter = await profile(tx);
        const caseId = (await intake(tx, ground.rule(reporter.id), aPost(postId))).items[0]!.caseId!;
        const interim = await decideIn(tx, mod2, caseId, { kind: "interim", actions: [act("withhold")] });
        expect(await appealRefusal(tx, interim, authorId)).toBe("appeal_not_open");
        // The final decision removes the post and one image: its author may appeal it, and nobody else may.
        const removal = await decideIn(tx, mod, caseId, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove"), act("remove_media", imageId)] });
        expect(await appealRefusal(tx, removal, reporter.id)).toBe("appeal_not_open");
        expect(await appealRefusal(tx, removal, (await profile(tx)).id)).toBe("appeal_not_open");
        expect(await appealRefusal(tx, randomUUID(), authorId)).toBe("appeal_not_open");
        // A correction that reverses part of it is no decision to appeal; the removal itself still is.
        const correction = await decideIn(tx, admin, caseId, { kind: "correction", outcome: "partly_reversed", reviewsDecisionId: removal, actions: [act("restore_media", imageId)] });
        expect(await appealRefusal(tx, correction, authorId)).toBe("appeal_not_open");
        const appeal = await appealOf(tx, removal, authorId, "I do not think this broke the rule.");
        expect(await appealRow(tx, appeal)).toMatchObject({ decision_id: removal, appellant_account_id: authorId, statement: "I do not think this broke the rule.", answered_by: null, result: null });
        // Nor is the review that answers it.
        const review = await reviewIn(tx, admin2, removal);
        expect(await appealRefusal(tx, review, authorId)).toBe("appeal_not_open");

        // A final decision that finds no breach restricts nothing.
        const other = await newPostRow(tx, authorId);
        const otherCase = (await intake(tx, ground.rule(reporter.id), aPost(other))).items[0]!.caseId!;
        const noAction = await decideIn(tx, mod, otherCase, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
        expect(await appealRefusal(tx, noAction, authorId)).toBe("appeal_not_open");
      });
    });

    test("the window ends six calendar months after the author was told, by the clock read when the appeal arrives", async () => {
      // As the migrator: only it may move the time a decision was told.
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const closed = await restricted(tx);
        const open = await restricted(tx);
        // The latest minute of being told whose window has closed by now, and the earliest whose window stays open for five more minutes.
        await tx.execute(sql`
          update decisions set informed_at = (
            select max(t) from generate_series(clock_timestamp() - interval '6 months 5 days', clock_timestamp() - interval '5 months 25 days', interval '1 minute') t
             where public.appeal_deadline(t) <= clock_timestamp())
           where id = ${closed.decisionId}::uuid`);
        await tx.execute(sql`
          update decisions set informed_at = (
            select min(t) from generate_series(clock_timestamp() - interval '6 months 5 days', clock_timestamp() - interval '5 months 25 days', interval '1 minute') t
             where public.appeal_deadline(t) > clock_timestamp() + interval '5 minutes')
           where id = ${open.decisionId}::uuid`);
        const [edges] = await tx.execute<{ apart: boolean }>(sql`
          select (select informed_at from decisions where id = ${open.decisionId}::uuid) - (select informed_at from decisions where id = ${closed.decisionId}::uuid) between interval '1 minute' and interval '10 minutes' as apart`);
        expect(edges!.apart).toBe(true);
        expect(await appealRefusal(tx, closed.decisionId, closed.authorId)).toBe("appeal_not_open");
        expect(await appealRefusal(tx, open.decisionId, open.authorId)).toBeNull();
        // The month-end clamp: told on 31 August, the window ends on the last day of February.
        const [clamp] = await tx.execute<{ ok: boolean }>(sql`select public.appeal_deadline('2025-08-31T12:00:00Z') = '2026-02-28T12:00:00Z'::timestamptz and public.appeal_deadline('2027-08-31T12:00:00Z') = '2028-02-29T12:00:00Z'::timestamptz as ok`);
        expect(clamp!.ok).toBe(true);
      }, migrateDb);
    });

    test("a restriction that a correction reversed in full leaves nothing to appeal; one reversed in part can still be appealed", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const whole = await restricted(tx);
        await decideIn(tx, admin, whole.caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: whole.decisionId, actions: [act("restore")] });
        expect(await inForce(tx, { caseId: whole.caseId })).toEqual([]);
        expect(await appealRefusal(tx, whole.decisionId, whole.authorId)).toBe("appeal_not_open");

        // A decision with two measures, of which a correction lifts one.
        const authorId = (await profile(tx)).id;
        const postId = await newPostRow(tx, authorId);
        const imageId = await newImageRow(tx, authorId, postId, 0);
        const caseId = (await intake(tx, ground.rule((await profile(tx)).id), aPost(postId))).items[0]!.caseId!;
        const both = await decideIn(tx, mod, caseId, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove"), act("remove_media", imageId)] });
        await decideIn(tx, admin, caseId, { kind: "correction", outcome: "partly_reversed", reviewsDecisionId: both, actions: [act("restore")] });
        // 3e: the strike stays with the part of the finding that stands.
        expect(await inForce(tx, { caseId })).toEqual([`remove_media:${imageId}`, "strike"]);
        expect(await appealRefusal(tx, both, authorId)).toBeNull();
      });
    });
  });

  describe("a review answers exactly its one appeal", () => {
    test("a kept review: the database forces its appeal, its source and that the author is told, answers the appeal and moves the case's version; nothing is lifted", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const r = await restricted(tx);
        const appeal = await appealOf(tx, r.decisionId, r.authorId);
        const params = await reviewParams(tx, mod2, r.decisionId);
        expect(params).toMatchObject({ appealId: appeal, outcome: "kept", actions: [] });
        const review = await reviewWith(tx, mod2, r.decisionId, params);

        const row = await decisionRow(tx, review);
        expect(row).toMatchObject({ case_id: r.caseId, kind: "review", outcome: "kept", ground: null, rule_id: null, source: "report", suspect: false, unseen: false, needs_admin: false, ended_interim: false, author_mail: "pending", decided_by: mod2.id });
        const [named] = await tx.execute<{ appeal_id: string; reviews_decision_id: string }>(sql`select appeal_id, reviews_decision_id from decisions where id = ${review}::uuid`);
        expect({ ...named! }).toEqual({ appeal_id: appeal, reviews_decision_id: r.decisionId });
        expect(await appealRow(tx, appeal)).toMatchObject({ answered_by: review, result: "kept", erased_at: null });
        const [answered] = await tx.execute<{ now: boolean }>(sql`select answered_at = now() as now from appeals where id = ${appeal}::uuid`);
        expect(answered!.now).toBe(true);
        expect((await readCase(tx, r.caseId)).state_version).toBe(2);
        // The reason is confirmed by the review, and the removal stands.
        const [text] = await tx.execute<{ kind: string; decision_id: string | null }>(sql`select kind, decision_id from staff_texts where digest = ${params.reasonDigest}`);
        expect({ ...text! }).toEqual({ kind: "review_reason", decision_id: review });
        expect(await actionsOf(tx, review)).toEqual([]);
        expect(await postRow(tx, r.postId)).toMatchObject({ level: "removed" });
        expect((await itemsOf(tx, r.caseId))[0]).toMatchObject({ revision_pending_at: null });
        // The appeal is answered: a second review finds none pending.
        expect(await refusal(reviewIn(tx, admin, r.decisionId))).toBe("case_changed");
      });
    });

    test("whatever appeal an insert names, the review's appeal is the reviewed decision's pending one; with none pending the trigger refuses it as case_changed", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const [one, other, none] = [await restricted(tx), await restricted(tx), await restricted(tx)];
        const [appeal, otherAppeal] = [await appealOf(tx, one.decisionId, one.authorId), await appealOf(tx, other.decisionId, other.authorId)];

        // A decision nobody appealed: the trigger itself refuses its review, whatever the module checked before.
        const q = await reviewParams(tx, mod2, none.decisionId);
        const raw = await within(tx, (sp) => insertReview(sp, { id: randomUUID(), caseId: none.caseId, reviewsDecisionId: none.decisionId, decidedBy: mod2.id, params: q }));
        expect(raw).toEqual({ code: "P0001", message: "case_changed" });
        // And the module refuses a review whose confirmed appeal is not the pending one before it writes anything.
        expect(await refusal(reviewWith(tx, mod2, other.decisionId, { ...(await reviewParams(tx, mod2, other.decisionId)), appealId: appeal }))).toBe("case_changed");
        expect(await appealRow(tx, otherAppeal)).toMatchObject({ answered_by: null });

        // A row that names the other decision's appeal: the database stores the reviewed decision's own. (The row has no
        // audit row, so it is the last thing this transaction writes: the check at commit would refuse it.)
        const p = await reviewParams(tx, mod2, one.decisionId);
        const id = randomUUID();
        await tx.execute(sql`
          insert into decisions (id, case_id, kind, reviews_decision_id, appeal_id, seen_state_version, outcome, rules_version, redress_version, category, snapshot_id, snapshot_digest, reason_digest, decided_by)
          values (${id}::uuid, ${one.caseId}::uuid, 'review', ${one.decisionId}::uuid, ${otherAppeal}::uuid, ${p.stateVersion}, 'kept', ${p.rulesVersion}, ${p.redressVersion}, ${p.category},
                  ${p.snapshotId}::uuid, ${p.snapshotDigest}, ${p.reasonDigest}, ${mod2.id}::uuid)`);
        const [stored] = await tx.execute<{ appeal_id: string }>(sql`select appeal_id from decisions where id = ${id}::uuid`);
        expect(stored!.appeal_id).toBe(appeal);
        expect(await appealRow(tx, appeal)).toMatchObject({ answered_by: id, result: "kept" });
        expect(await appealRow(tx, otherAppeal)).toMatchObject({ answered_by: null, result: null });
      });
    });

    test("a review whose audit row names another appeal than the one the database forced is refused at COMMIT", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const r = await restricted(tx);
        await appealOf(tx, r.decisionId, r.authorId);
        const params = await reviewParams(tx, mod2, r.decisionId);
        const forged = { ...params, appealId: randomUUID() };
        const { session, confirmed } = madeUpConfirmation(mod2, r.decisionId, params as never);
        const atCommit = tx.transaction(async (sp) => {
          const id = randomUUID();
          await insertReview(sp, { id, caseId: r.caseId, reviewsDecisionId: r.decisionId, decidedBy: mod2.id, params });
          await appendConfirmedAudit(sp, {
            actorId: mod2.id,
            keyId: mod2.keyId,
            action: "appeals_reviewed",
            targetType: "decision",
            targetId: r.decisionId,
            metadata: { params: forged, decisionId: id },
            staffSession: session.handle,
            actionHash: confirmed.actionHash,
            stepUp: confirmed.assertion,
            requestId: "req-forged",
            expiresAt: confirmed.expiresAt,
          });
          await sp.execute(sql`set constraints public.decisions_check, public.decision_actions_recheck immediate`);
        });
        expect(await pgError(atCommit)).toEqual({ code: "P0001", message: "invalid_decision" });
        expect(await refusalDetail(atCommit)).toBe("params: appealId differ from the decision.");
      });
    });

    test("a review is made of a final restriction of its own case, with that decision's category and rules version and a review reason", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const r = await restricted(tx);
        await appealOf(tx, r.decisionId, r.authorId);
        const p = await reviewParams(tx, mod2, r.decisionId);
        const insert = (overrides: Partial<typeof p>, reviewsDecisionId = r.decisionId, caseId = r.caseId) =>
          within(tx, (sp) => insertReview(sp, { id: randomUUID(), caseId, reviewsDecisionId, decidedBy: mod2.id, params: { ...p, ...overrides } }));
        const refused = { code: "P0001", message: "invalid_decision" };
        expect(await insert({ category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE" })).toEqual(refused);
        expect(await insert({ rulesVersion: p.rulesVersion + 1 })).toEqual(refused);
        // A decision of another case, and one that is no final restriction, is not reviewed here.
        const other = await restricted(tx);
        expect(await insert({}, other.decisionId)).toEqual(refused);
        // A reason of another kind is not a review's.
        const reason = await decisionParams(tx, mod2, r.caseId, { kind: "interim", actions: [act("withhold")] });
        expect(await insert({ reasonDigest: reason.reasonDigest! })).toEqual({ code: "P0001", message: "text_not_found" });
        // A review never restricts: a measure in its ledger is refused.
        const withMeasure = await within(tx, async (sp) => {
          const id = randomUUID();
          await insertReview(sp, { id, caseId: r.caseId, reviewsDecisionId: r.decisionId, decidedBy: mod2.id, params: p });
          await insertAction(sp, id, act("remove"));
        });
        expect(withMeasure).toEqual(refused);
        // The version the reviewer saw: another decision since then is case_changed.
        expect(await insert({ stateVersion: p.stateVersion + 1 })).toEqual({ code: "P0001", message: "case_changed" });
        expect(await refusal(reviewWith(tx, mod2, r.decisionId, p))).toBeNull();
      });
    });
  });

  describe("who may review", () => {
    test("nobody reviews a case in which they decided anything, a measure taken while deciding included, or opened a finding: reviewer_conflict", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        // The second moderator withheld the post while deciding; the first removed it.
        const authorId = (await profile(tx)).id;
        const postId = await newPostRow(tx, authorId);
        const caseId = (await intake(tx, ground.rule((await profile(tx)).id), aPost(postId))).items[0]!.caseId!;
        await decideIn(tx, mod2, caseId, { kind: "interim", actions: [act("withhold")] });
        const removal = await decideIn(tx, mod, caseId, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove")] });
        await appealOf(tx, removal, authorId);
        for (const decider of [mod, mod2]) expect(await refusal(reviewIn(tx, decider, removal)), decider.id).toBe("reviewer_conflict");

        // A case the first admin opened as a finding of their own and the first moderator decided.
        const found = await newPostRow(tx, authorId);
        const foundCase = (await intake(tx, ground.finding(admin.id, "R1"), aPost(found))).items[0]!.caseId!;
        const foundRemoval = await decideIn(tx, mod, foundCase, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove")] });
        await appealOf(tx, foundRemoval, authorId);
        expect(await refusal(reviewIn(tx, admin, foundRemoval))).toBe("reviewer_conflict");
        // Someone who took no part reviews each.
        expect(await refusal(reviewIn(tx, admin2, removal))).toBeNull();
        expect(await refusal(reviewIn(tx, mod2, foundRemoval))).toBeNull();
      });
    });

    test("a reviewer whose linked personal account reported the item the reviewed decision answered is recused", async () => {

        await tx.execute(sql`insert into auth.staff_personal_accounts (staff_user_id, personal_user_id) values (${mod2.id}::uuid, ${personal}::uuid)`);

    test("review_needs_admin reads two stored facts: true for a decision that cites R2 or holds a seal, false for every other, a restriction under R5 and a frozen post's included", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const needs = async (decisionId: string) => (await tx.execute<{ needs: boolean }>(sql`select public.review_needs_admin(${decisionId}::uuid) as needs`))[0]!.needs;
        expect(await needs(randomUUID())).toBe(false);

        // A removal under R5 is an admin's decision, and its review is any eligible moderator's.
        const threat = await restricted(tx, { rule: "R5", decider: admin });
        expect((await decisionRow(tx, threat.decisionId)).needs_admin).toBe(true);
        expect(await needs(threat.decisionId)).toBe(false);
        await appealOf(tx, threat.decisionId, threat.authorId);
        const review = await reviewIn(tx, mod2, threat.decisionId);
        expect(await decisionRow(tx, review)).toMatchObject({ needs_admin: false, decided_by: mod2.id });

        // A removal under R2, on a report of child sexual abuse material: its review is an admin's.
        const r2 = await restricted(tx, { by: "csam", decider: admin });

        await appealOf(tx, r2.decisionId, r2.authorId);
        expect(await refusal(reviewIn(tx, mod2, r2.decisionId))).toBe("admin_required");
        const byAdmin = await reviewIn(tx, admin2, r2.decisionId);
        expect(await decisionRow(tx, byAdmin)).toMatchObject({ needs_admin: true, suspect: true });

        // An admin's answer to such a report without a seal, restricting the text under another rule: no admin for its review.
        const authorId = (await profile(tx)).id;

        const noSeal = await decideIn(tx, admin, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R1", actions: [act("remove")] });
        expect(await decisionRow(tx, noSeal)).toMatchObject({ suspect: true, needs_admin: true });
        expect(await needs(noSeal)).toBe(false);

        // A removal under R1 of a post that a later report of this kind freezes: the answer never reads the freeze.
        const later = await restricted(tx, { images: 1 });
        await intake(tx, ground.csam(), aPost(later.postId));
        const [frozen] = await tx.execute<{ frozen: boolean }>(sql`select public.post_frozen(${later.postId}::uuid) as frozen`);
        expect(frozen!.frozen).toBe(true);
        expect(await needs(later.decisionId)).toBe(false);
      });

    test("a review that lifts a seal for good is an admin's: refused to a moderator, accepted for an admin who took no part, and the images are unsealed", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {

    test("appeal_reviewer_state answers one word: with one staff account, with two who both decided, with a second one linked to a reporter, with an eligible one, counting only admins where the review needs one, and nothing for an answered appeal", async () => {
      // As the migrator: the test decides which staff accounts korbat has, inside its own transaction.
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const only = async (...staff: TestStaff[]) => {
          await tx.execute(sql`update auth.users set role = 'moderator' where id = any(${`{${[mod.id, mod2.id].join(",")}}`}::uuid[])`);
          await tx.execute(sql`update auth.users set role = 'admin' where id = any(${`{${[admin.id, admin2.id].join(",")}}`}::uuid[])`);
          await tx.execute(sql`update auth.users set role = 'user' where role <> 'user' and not (id = any(${`{${staff.map((member) => member.id).join(",")}}`}::uuid[]))`);
        };
        const state = async (appealId: string) => (await tx.execute<{ state: string | null }>(sql`select public.appeal_reviewer_state(${appealId}::uuid) as state`))[0]!.state;
        expect(await state(randomUUID())).toBeNull();

        // The second moderator withheld, the first removed, and the reporter is the personal account.
        await tx.execute(sql`insert into profiles (id, handle, display_name) values (${personal}::uuid, ${`p_${hex64().slice(0, 10)}`}, 'Personal')`);
        const authorId = (await profile(tx)).id;
        const postId = await newPostRow(tx, authorId);
        const caseId = (await intake(tx, ground.rule(personal), aPost(postId))).items[0]!.caseId!;
        await decideIn(tx, mod2, caseId, { kind: "interim", actions: [act("withhold")] });
        const removal = await decideIn(tx, mod, caseId, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove")] });
        const appeal = await appealOf(tx, removal, authorId);

        await only(mod);
        expect(await state(appeal)).toBe("none_single_staff");
        // The author reads it in the same word, and no more.
        expect((await authorDecisionView(moderationDeps(tx), authorId, removal)).appeal).toEqual({ state: "pending", filedAt: expect.any(String), reviewer: "none_single_staff", needsAdmin: false });
        await only(mod, mod2);
        expect(await state(appeal)).toBe("none_eligible");
        await only(mod, mod2, admin);
        expect(await state(appeal)).toBe("available");
        // An account that is taken down is no reviewer.
        await tx.execute(sql`update auth.users set deleted_at = now() where id = ${admin.id}::uuid`);
        expect(await state(appeal)).toBe("none_eligible");
        await tx.execute(sql`update auth.users set deleted_at = null where id = ${admin.id}::uuid`);
        // The admin's linked personal account reported in the case: too close to review it.
        await tx.execute(sql`insert into auth.staff_personal_accounts (staff_user_id, personal_user_id) values (${admin.id}::uuid, ${personal}::uuid)`);
        expect(await state(appeal)).toBe("none_eligible");
        await only(mod, mod2, admin, admin2);
        expect(await state(appeal)).toBe("available");

        // What the console reads of it: the marks of the list, of the case and of the home screen.
        const deps = moderationDeps(tx);
        const rowFor = async (staff: TestStaff) => (await appealsList(deps, sessionOf(staff))).appeals.find((row) => row.id === appeal);
        expect(await rowFor(admin2)).toEqual({
          id: appeal,
          caseId,
          decisionId: removal,
          filedAt: expect.any(String),
          decidedAt: expect.any(String),
          deadline: expect.any(String),
          ruleId: "R1",
          legal: false,
          actions: ["remove", "strike"],
          reviewer: "available",
          needsAdmin: false,
          mayReview: true,
          // 3e Task 4: a removal holds no suspension that runs, so the row is listed with the rest, newest first.
          standingFirst: false,
        });
        // The deciders and the linked admin may not, and the row says no more than that.
        for (const staff of [mod, mod2, admin]) expect((await rowFor(staff))?.mayReview, staff.id).toBe(false);
        expect(JSON.stringify(await rowFor(mod))).not.toMatch(/statement/);
        const counted = async (staff: TestStaff) => {
          const seen = await overview(deps, sessionOf(staff));
          return [seen.appealsWaiting, seen.appealsYouMayReview, seen.appealsWithoutReviewer];
        };
        const [waiting, , without] = await counted(mod);
        expect(await counted(mod)).toEqual([waiting, 0, without]);
        expect(await counted(admin2)).toEqual([waiting, 1, without]);
        await only(mod, mod2);
        expect(await counted(mod)).toEqual([waiting, 0, without! + 1]);
        await only(mod, mod2, admin, admin2);
        expect((await readCaseView(deps, sessionOf(admin2), caseId)).appeals).toEqual([
          { id: appeal, decisionId: removal, filedAt: expect.any(String), statement: null, answeredAt: null, result: null, answeredBy: null, reviewer: "available", needsAdmin: false, mayReview: true },
        ]);

        // A decision under R2: only admins count, in each answer.
        const r2 = await restricted(tx, { by: "csam", decider: admin });
        const r2Appeal = await appealOf(tx, r2.decisionId, r2.authorId);
        await only(admin, mod, mod2);
        expect(await state(r2Appeal)).toBe("none_single_staff");
        expect((await authorDecisionView(moderationDeps(tx), r2.authorId, r2.decisionId)).appeal).toMatchObject({ reviewer: "none_single_staff", needsAdmin: true });
        await only(admin, admin2, mod);
        expect(await state(r2Appeal)).toBe("available");
        const r2Row = async (staff: TestStaff) => (await appealsList(deps, sessionOf(staff))).appeals.find((row) => row.id === r2Appeal);
        expect(await r2Row(mod)).toMatchObject({ needsAdmin: true, mayReview: false, reviewer: "available" });
        expect(await r2Row(admin2)).toMatchObject({ needsAdmin: true, mayReview: true });

        // Answered, an appeal has no reviewer state, and nobody may review it.
        const review = await reviewIn(tx, admin2, removal);
        expect(await state(appeal)).toBeNull();
        expect((await readCaseView(deps, sessionOf(admin2), caseId)).appeals).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({ id: appeal, result: "kept", answeredBy: review, reviewer: null, mayReview: false })]);
        expect(await rowFor(admin2)).toBeUndefined();

  describe("what a review and a correction do", () => {
    test("a review that reverses lifts the measures still in force and marks the answered items; one that reverses part leaves the rest; the outcome is held to the ledger", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {

        expect(await refusalDetail(reviewIn(tx, mod2, removal, { outcome: "kept", actions: [act("restore")] }))).toBe("kept: a review that keeps the decision holds no measure and no reversal.");
        expect(await refusalDetail(reviewIn(tx, mod2, removal, { outcome: "reversed", actions: [act("restore")] }))).toBe("reversed: a measure of the reviewed decision is still in force.");
        // 3e: the strike falls only with its whole finding, so a reversal "in part" that leaves nothing but the strike is refused.
        expect(await refusalDetail(reviewIn(tx, mod2, removal, { outcome: "partly_reversed", actions: [act("restore"), act("restore_media", imageId)] }))).toBe("partly_reversed: no measure of the reviewed decision but its strike is left in force.");
        expect(await refusalDetail(reviewIn(tx, mod2, removal, { outcome: "reversed", actions: [], overrule: false }))).toBe("reversed: a reversing decision holds at least one reversal.");

        expect(await actionsOf(tx, review)).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({ kind: "restore", post_id: postId, no_effect: null })]);
        const [lifted] = await tx.execute<{ reverses: string; of: string }>(sql`select r.reverses_action_id as reverses, a.decision_id as of from decision_actions r join decision_actions a on a.id = r.reverses_action_id where r.decision_id = ${review}::uuid`);
        expect(lifted!.of).toBe(removal);
        // The post is shown again, its image stays removed, and the report's sender is told the new outcome at the next release.
        expect(await postRow(tx, postId)).toMatchObject({ state: "visible", level: "visible" });
        expect(await imageStates(tx, [imageId])).toEqual(["removed"]);
        // 3e: the strike stays with the part of the finding that stands.
        expect(await inForce(tx, { caseId })).toEqual([`remove_media:${imageId}`, "strike"]);
        const [item] = await tx.execute<{ pending: boolean }>(sql`select revision_pending_at = now() as pending from intake_items where case_id = ${caseId}::uuid`);
        expect(item!.pending).toBe(true);
        const [appeal] = await tx.execute<{ result: string; answered_by: string }>(sql`select result, answered_by from appeals where decision_id = ${removal}::uuid`);
        expect({ ...appeal! }).toEqual({ result: "partly_reversed", answered_by: review });
      });
    });

    test("a correction that reverses everything answers the pending appeal as reversed; one that reverses part leaves it for a review of what remains", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const whole = await restricted(tx);
        const wholeAppeal = await appealOf(tx, whole.decisionId, whole.authorId);
        const correction = await decideIn(tx, admin, whole.caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: whole.decisionId, actions: [act("restore")] });
        expect(await appealRow(tx, wholeAppeal)).toMatchObject({ answered_by: correction, result: "reversed" });
        const [at] = await tx.execute<{ now: boolean }>(sql`select answered_at = now() as now from appeals where id = ${wholeAppeal}::uuid`);
        expect(at!.now).toBe(true);
