```tsx
import { FINDING_CATEGORIES, MEASURES, RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY, type AppealsReviewedParams, type CaseDecision, type CaseView, type DecisionActionParams, type MeasureKind, type RuleId, type TdbCategory } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { RULES, statementParagraphs, type StatementInput } from "@korbat/rules";
import {
  COMPOSER,
  complete,
  correctable,
  correctionChoices,
  holds,
  kindsOffered,
  lawOffered,
  leftOpen,
  liftable,
  liftedKind,
  hiddenWhileDeciding,
  imagesOffered,
  measuresOffered,
  AT_ONCE_DAYS,
  AT_ONCE_ORDER,
  answerable,
  atOnceState,
  ofControl,
  replyOf,
  standingControlState,
  suspensionOf,
  withAnswer,
  withAtOnce,
  withStanding,
  withdrawable,
  type AtOnceKey,
  type StandingClosed,
  type StandingControl,
  noEffectOf,
  offeredDraft,
  outcomesListed,
  previewOf,
  previewable,
  retireMoved,
  retireOpen,
  reviewChoices,
  reviewOutcomeOf,
  reviewable,
  sealOffered,
  snapshotImages,
  standingStrikeOf,
  strikeCarriesStanding,
  strikeLine,
  statementSent,
  suspectOpen,
  throughSeqOf,
  toggled,
  type CaseDraft,
  type DraftTextKind,
  type StaffRole,
} from "../compose";
import { APPEAL_WORDS, COMPOSER_KINDS, COMPOSER_OUTCOMES, COMPOSER_WORDS, REVIEW_OUTCOMES, STANDING_WORDS } from "../messages";
import { dateTime, UserText } from "../ui";
import { categoryLabel } from "../words";

/**
 * The decision composer (3c design, section 8): the outcome first, then, for a restriction, the kind, the ground and the
 * measures this target and kind allow; the category; the facts and the reason; and the preview, which is the statement
 * exactly as its author will receive it. What it offers follows the case and the person's role; the database checks
 * every rule again when the key has confirmed. A correction ("Lift what was done while deciding", "Correct this
 * decision") takes the composer's place while it is open, and so does the review of an appeal ("Review this appeal").
 */

/** "Do not seal now": the reason as typed, and what became of saving it. */
export interface DecliningState {
  reason: string;
  busy: boolean;
  error: string | null;
}

export interface ComposerViewProps {
  view: CaseView;
  role: StaffRole;
  draft: CaseDraft;
  /** The time the preview is rendered for: the decision's time, were it confirmed now. */
  now: Date;
  busy: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  /** The refusal of a text's save, worded in place under its field. */
  textErrors: Partial<Record<DraftTextKind, string>>;
  declining: DecliningState | null;
  onChange(change: Partial<CaseDraft>): void;
  /** A text's field lost focus: the text is saved, without the key. */
  onTextBlur(kind: DraftTextKind): void;
  /** "Seal the images this case reaches". */
  onSeal(): void;
  onConfirm(): void;
  onDeclineOpen(): void;
  onDeclineChange(reason: string): void;
  onDeclineSave(): void;
  onDeclineClose(): void;
  onCancelCorrection(): void;
}

/**
 * The statement as its author will receive it, each paragraph as text in a frame of its own direction. In its place the
 * page says so when there is nothing to show yet (a restriction without a measure), nothing it can show (a post whose
 * snapshot cannot be shown: no creation time is made up), or nothing that is sent.
 */
function Preview({ view, draft, now }: Pick<ComposerViewProps, "view" | "draft" | "now">) {
  // A restriction without a measure has no statement yet: the page says so rather than show one that restricts nothing.
  if (draft.kind !== "correction" && draft.kind !== "review" && draft.outcome === "restricted" && !draft.actions.some((action) => MEASURES[action.kind].lifts === null)) {
    return <p className="hint">{COMPOSER.previewNeedsMeasure}</p>;
  }
  if (!previewable(view)) return <p className="hint">{COMPOSER_WORDS.previewAfterSnapshot}</p>;
  let input: StatementInput;
  let paragraphs: string[];
  try {
    input = previewOf(view, draft, now);
    paragraphs = statementParagraphs(input);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
  // A decision that restricts nothing and ends nothing sends its author nothing: no statement is shown as if it were sent.
  if (!statementSent(input)) return <p className="hint">{COMPOSER_WORDS.noStatement}</p>;
  return (
    <div className="frame preview">
      <h4>Preview: the statement as its author will receive it</h4>
      {paragraphs.map((paragraph, index) => (
        <p key={index} className="frame-text">
          <UserText>{paragraph}</UserText>
        </p>
      ))}
      {draft.actions.some((action) => action.kind === "seal_media") ? <p className="hint">{COMPOSER_WORDS.sealSettled}</p> : null}
    </div>
  );
}

/** One of the draft's texts, as its person types it. It is saved when the field loses focus; a refusal of that save stands under the field. */
function TextField({ id, label, kind, rows, props, under }: { id: string; label: string; kind: DraftTextKind; rows: number; props: ComposerViewProps; under: string[] }) {
  const { draft } = props;
  const refused = props.textErrors[kind];
  return (
    <>
      <label htmlFor={id}>{label}</label>
      <textarea
        id={id}
        rows={rows}
        value={draft.written[kind]}
        disabled={props.busy}
        onChange={(event) => props.onChange({ written: { ...draft.written, [kind]: event.target.value } })}
        onBlur={() => props.onTextBlur(kind)}
      />
      {refused ? (
        <p role="alert" className="error">
          {refused}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {under.map((sentence) => (
        <p key={sentence} className="hint">
          {sentence}
        </p>
      ))}
    </>
  );
}

function Confirm({ props, onCancel }: { props: ComposerViewProps; onCancel?: () => void }) {
  return (
    <>
      {props.error ? (
        <p role="alert" className="error">
          {props.error}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      <div className="actions">
        <button type="button" className="primary" onClick={props.onConfirm} disabled={props.busy || !complete(props.view, props.draft)} aria-busy={props.busy}>
          Confirm with your staff key
        </button>
        {onCancel ? (
          <button type="button" onClick={onCancel} disabled={props.busy}>
            Cancel
          </button>
        ) : null}
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

/**
 * 3e (design, section 8.7): beside a correction or a review of a decision whose strike stands, that the strike falls only
 * with its whole finding, and, when a suspension or termination that stands rests on it, what reversing it does.
 */
function StrikeNotes({ decision }: { decision: CaseDecision }) {
  if (standingStrikeOf(decision) === undefined) return null;
  return (
    <>
      <p className="hint">{STANDING_WORDS.reviewStrike}</p>
      {strikeCarriesStanding(decision) ? <p className="notice">{STANDING_WORDS.reviewRests}</p> : null}
    </>
  );
}

/** A correction of one decision: what of it to lift, the reason, and the preview. */
function CorrectionView(props: ComposerViewProps) {
  const { view, role, draft } = props;
  const decision = view.decisions.find((decided) => decided.id === draft.reviewsDecisionId);
  const choices = correctionChoices(view, draft, role);
  if (!decision || choices.length === 0) {
    return (
      <section className="panel composer" aria-labelledby="composer-title">
        <h3 id="composer-title">{COMPOSER.correctLabel}</h3>
        <p>Nothing of that decision is in force any more.</p>
        <div className="actions">
          <button type="button" onClick={props.onCancelCorrection}>
            Cancel
          </button>
        </div>
      </section>
    );
  }
  const deciding = decision.kind === "interim";
  return (
    <section className="panel composer" aria-labelledby="composer-title">
      <h3 id="composer-title">{deciding ? COMPOSER.liftLabel : COMPOSER.correctLabel}</h3>
      <p>{`The decision of ${dateTime(decision.decidedAt)}. A correction only lifts: choose what of it to lift.`}</p>
      <ul className="plain">
        {choices.map(({ measure, reversal }) => (
          <li key={measure.id}>
            <label>
              <input type="checkbox" checked={holds(draft, reversal)} disabled={props.busy} onChange={(event) => props.onChange({ actions: toggled(draft, reversal, event.target.checked) })} />{" "}
              <span>{MEASURES[reversal.kind].label}</span>
              {measure.mediaId === null ? null : (
                <>
                  {" "}
                  <code>{measure.mediaId}</code>
                </>
              )}
            </label>
            {reversal.kind === "unseal_media" ? <p className="notice">{deciding ? COMPOSER.sealInError : COMPOSER.sealForGood}</p> : null}
            {/* 3e (design, section 8.7): [review.handle] beside "Give the handle back". */}
            {reversal.kind === "unretire_handle" ? <p className="hint">{STANDING_WORDS.reviewHandle}</p> : null}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      <StrikeNotes decision={decision} />
      <StandingNotes decision={decision} />
      <TextField id="compose-review-reason" label="Reason of the correction" kind="review_reason" rows={3} props={props} under={[COMPOSER.personalData]} />
      <Preview view={view} draft={draft} now={props.now} />
      <Confirm props={props} onCancel={props.onCancelCorrection} />
    </section>
  );
}

const REVIEW_ANSWERS: AppealsReviewedParams["outcome"][] = ["kept", "partly_reversed", "reversed"];

/**
 * The review of an appeal (3c design, section 8): Keep, Reverse in part or Reverse; the reversals of the decision's
 * measures that are still in force; the reason; and the preview of the review's statement. A review only lifts. "Keep"
 * lifts nothing and "Reverse" everything still in force, so the page sets those itself; "Reverse in part" is chosen
 * measure by measure. Once the appeal is answered, or for a person the API did not mark as its reviewer, nothing is
 * offered but the way back.
 */
function ReviewView(props: ComposerViewProps) {
  const { view, role, draft } = props;
  const decision = view.decisions.find((decided) => decided.id === draft.reviewsDecisionId);
  const offered = decision ? reviewable(view, decision) : null;
  if (!decision || offered === null) {
    return (
      <section className="panel composer" aria-labelledby="composer-title">
        <h3 id="composer-title">{COMPOSER.reviewLabel}</h3>
        <p>{APPEAL_WORDS.notYours}</p>
        <div className="actions">
          <button type="button" onClick={props.onCancelCorrection}>
            Cancel
          </button>
        </div>
      </section>
    );
  }
  const choices = reviewChoices(view, draft, role);
  const answer = reviewOutcomeOf(view, draft);
  // "Keep" lifts nothing and "Reverse" everything still in force; a part keeps what was chosen while it is one, and starts empty otherwise.
  const partial = draft.actions.length > 0 && draft.actions.length < choices.length;
  const choose = (next: AppealsReviewedParams["outcome"]) => props.onChange({ review: next, actions: next === "reversed" ? choices.map((choice) => choice.reversal) : next === "partly_reversed" && partial ? draft.actions : [] });
  return (
    <section className="panel composer" aria-labelledby="composer-title">
      <h3 id="composer-title">{COMPOSER.reviewLabel}</h3>
      <p>{`The decision of ${dateTime(decision.decidedAt)}. A review keeps it or lifts measures of it, and never adds one.`}</p>
      <fieldset>
        <legend>Answer</legend>
        {REVIEW_ANSWERS.map((option) => (
          <label key={option}>
            <input type="radio" name="compose-review" checked={answer === option} disabled={props.busy} onChange={() => choose(option)} /> <span>{REVIEW_OUTCOMES[option]}</span>
          </label>
        ))}
      </fieldset>
      <ul className="plain">
        {choices.map(({ measure, reversal }) => (
          <li key={measure.id}>
            <label>
              {/* What "Keep" and "Reverse" lift follows from the answer: only a part is chosen measure by measure. */}
              <input type="checkbox" checked={holds(draft, reversal)} disabled={props.busy || answer !== "partly_reversed"} onChange={(event) => props.onChange({ actions: toggled(draft, reversal, event.target.checked) })} />{" "}
              <span>{MEASURES[reversal.kind].label}</span>
              {measure.mediaId === null ? null : (
                <>
                  {" "}
                  <code>{measure.mediaId}</code>
                </>
              )}
            </label>
            {reversal.kind === "unseal_media" ? <p className="notice">{COMPOSER.sealForGood}</p> : null}
            {reversal.kind === "unretire_handle" ? <p className="hint">{STANDING_WORDS.reviewHandle}</p> : null}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      <StrikeNotes decision={decision} />
      <StandingNotes decision={decision} />
      {/* 3e Task 4 (8.7): [review.reply] while the decision's reply waits, and [review.admin] for a decision that needed an admin. */}
      {replyOf(decision)?.reply.answeredAt === null ? <p className="notice">{STANDING_WORDS.reviewReply}</p> : null}
      {decision.needsAdmin ? <p className="hint">{STANDING_WORDS.reviewAdmin}</p> : null}
      <TextField id="compose-review-reason" label="Reason of the review" kind="review_reason" rows={3} props={props} under={[COMPOSER.personalData]} />
      <Preview view={view} draft={draft} now={props.now} />
      <Confirm props={props} onCancel={props.onCancelCorrection} />
    </section>
  );
}

/**
 * 3e (design, section 8.7): beside a review or a correction, what reversing the decision ends: a suspension (or
 * termination) taken at once that rests on it ([review.basis]); and for a decision that holds a protective suspension,
 * that its review does not wait for the authorities ([review.protective]).
 */
function StandingNotes({ decision }: { decision: CaseDecision }) {
  const basis = (decision.standingOn ?? []).some((entry) => entry.basis === "threat" || entry.basis === "terrorist" || entry.basis === "protective" || entry.basis === "threat_repeat");
  const protective = decision.actions.some((action) => action.kind === "suspend" && action.basis === "protective");
  if (!basis && !protective) return null;
  return (
    <>
      {basis ? <p className="notice">{STANDING_WORDS.reviewBasis}</p> : null}
      {protective ? <p className="hint">{STANDING_WORDS.reviewProtective}</p> : null}
    </>
  );
}

/** The sentence of one ground of a suspension at once, with the case answer's numbers where it has them. */
function groundSentence(view: CaseView, ground: AtOnceKey): string {
  const standing = view.standing;
  if (ground === "flood") return STANDING_WORDS.atOnce.flood(standing?.flood.posts ?? 0, dateTime(standing?.flood.from ?? ""), dateTime(standing?.flood.to ?? ""));
  if (ground === "protective") return standing?.seal ? STANDING_WORDS.atOnce.protective(standing.seal.decidedOn) : STANDING_WORDS.atOnce.noSeal;
  return STANDING_WORDS.atOnce[ground];
}

/** The sentence that greys "Suspend at once", by its key. */
const CLOSED_WORDS = {
  conflict: STANDING_WORDS.conflict,
  admin: STANDING_WORDS.atOnce.admin,
  other: STANDING_WORDS.atOnce.other,
  reportsFirst: STANDING_WORDS.reportsFirst,
  noSeal: STANDING_WORDS.atOnce.noSeal,
  unmet: STANDING_WORDS.atOnce.unmet,
} as const;

/**
 * 3e (design, section 8.3): "Suspend at once" on an account case's final restriction, offered to an admin when the ground
 * of the chosen rule is met, with its days, and greyed with its reason otherwise. The four grounds are listed, each marked
 * whether the database would accept it now. Choosing it adds the suspension and the ground's drafted facts.
 */
function AtOnce({ props }: { props: ComposerViewProps }) {
  const { view, role, draft } = props;
  const state = atOnceState(view, role, draft);
  if (state === null || view.standing === null) return null;
  const held = suspensionOf(draft);
  const max = state.ground === null ? 1 : AT_ONCE_DAYS[state.ground];
  const days = typeof held?.days === "number" ? held.days : max;
  const choose = (on: boolean, value: number) => {
    if (!state.open) return;
    props.onChange(on ? withAtOnce(view, draft, state.ground, Math.min(max, Math.max(1, value))) : { actions: draft.actions.filter((action) => action.kind !== "suspend") });
  };
  return (
    <li>
      <label>
        <input type="checkbox" checked={held !== undefined} disabled={props.busy || !state.open} onChange={(event) => choose(event.target.checked, days)} /> <span>{STANDING_WORDS.atOnce.label}</span>
      </label>
      {held !== undefined && state.open ? (
        <>
          {" "}
          <label htmlFor="compose-at-once-days">{STANDING_WORDS.atOnce.days(max)}</label>{" "}
          <input id="compose-at-once-days" type="number" min={1} max={max} value={days} disabled={props.busy} onChange={(event) => choose(true, Number(event.target.value) || 1)} />
        </>
      ) : null}
      {state.open ? null : <p className="hint">{CLOSED_WORDS[state.why]}</p>}
      <p className="hint">{STANDING_WORDS.atOnce.what}</p>
      <ul className="plain grounds">
        {AT_ONCE_ORDER.map((ground) => (
          <li key={ground}>
            <strong>{view.standing!.atOnce.includes(ground) ? STANDING_WORDS.atOnce.met : STANDING_WORDS.atOnce.unmet}</strong> <span>{groundSentence(view, ground)}</span>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      {held !== undefined ? (
        <>
          <p className="hint">{STANDING_WORDS.facts}</p>
          <p className="hint">{STANDING_WORDS.previewTimes}</p>
        </>
      ) : null}
    </li>
  );
}

/** The sentence that greys a control of Task 4, by its key. */
function standingClosedWords(view: CaseView, why: StandingClosed): string {
  switch (why) {
    case "conflict":
      return STANDING_WORDS.conflict;
    case "reportsFirst":
      return STANDING_WORDS.reportsFirst;
    case "short":
      return STANDING_WORDS.suspend.short(view.standing?.activeStrikes ?? 0);
    case "stale":
      return STANDING_WORDS.suspend.stale;
    case "notYet":
      return STANDING_WORDS.terminate.notYet;
    case "admin":
      return STANDING_WORDS.terminate.admin;
    case "noRepeat":
      return STANDING_WORDS.terminate.noRepeat;
    case "r2":
      return STANDING_WORDS.terminateR2;
  }
}

/**
 * 3e Task 4 (design, section 8.3): "Announce a suspension" with its days, "Announce a termination" and "Terminate at
 * once" on an account case's final restriction, each offered when the case answer says the database would accept it and
 * greyed with its reason otherwise. Choosing one puts any other suspension or termination away, sets the newest strike's
 * rule for a measure of the ladder, and drafts the facts.
 */
function StandingMeasureControl({ props, control }: { props: ComposerViewProps; control: StandingControl }) {
  const { view, role, draft } = props;
  const state = standingControlState(view, role, draft, control);
  const standing = view.standing;
  if (state === null || standing === null) return null;
  const held = draft.actions.find((action) => ofControl(action, control));
  const max = standing.maxDays ?? 1;
  const days = typeof held?.days === "number" ? held.days : max;
  const label = control === "announce" ? STANDING_WORDS.suspend.label : control === "announceTerminate" ? STANDING_WORDS.terminate.announceLabel : STANDING_WORDS.terminate.atOnceLabel;
  const choose = (on: boolean, value: number) => {
    if (!state.open) return;
    props.onChange(on ? withStanding(view, draft, control, control === "announce" ? Math.min(max, Math.max(1, value)) : null) : { actions: draft.actions.filter((action) => !ofControl(action, control)) });
  };
  const id = `compose-${control}`;
  return (
    <li>
      <label>
        <input type="checkbox" checked={held !== undefined} disabled={props.busy || !state.open} onChange={(event) => choose(event.target.checked, days)} /> <span>{label}</span>
      </label>
      {held !== undefined && state.open && control === "announce" ? (
        <>
          {" "}
          <label htmlFor={`${id}-days`}>{STANDING_WORDS.suspend.daysLabel(max)}</label>{" "}
          <input id={`${id}-days`} type="number" min={1} max={max} value={days} disabled={props.busy} onChange={(event) => choose(true, Number(event.target.value) || 1)} />
        </>
      ) : null}
      {state.open ? null : <p className="hint">{standingClosedWords(view, state.why)}</p>}
      {control === "announce" ? (
        <>
          <p className="hint">{STANDING_WORDS.suspend.what(days)}</p>
          {state.open && standing.maxDays !== null ? <p className="hint">{STANDING_WORDS.suspend.days(standing.maxDays, standing.suspensionsInYear + 1)}</p> : null}
          {state.open && standing.ladderRule !== null ? <p className="hint">{STANDING_WORDS.suspend.rule(standing.ladderRule)}</p> : null}
        </>
      ) : (
        <p className="hint">{STANDING_WORDS.terminate.what}</p>
      )}
      {held !== undefined ? (
        <>
          <p className="hint">{STANDING_WORDS.facts}</p>
          <p className="hint">{STANDING_WORDS.previewTimes}</p>
        </>
      ) : null}
    </li>
  );
}

/**
 * 3e Task 4 (design, section 8.5): the answer to the person's reply, a correction of the decision that holds the measure:
 * Keep or Reverse, with what each does by when the reply came, the reply's text, the reason for the person, and the
 * preview of the answer's statement.
 */
function AnswerView(props: ComposerViewProps) {
  const { view, role, draft } = props;
  const decision = view.decisions.find((decided) => decided.id === draft.reviewsDecisionId);
  const found = decision ? replyOf(decision) : null;
  if (!decision || found === null || !answerable(decision, role)) {
    return (
      <section className="panel composer" aria-labelledby="composer-title">
        <h3 id="composer-title">{STANDING_WORDS.reply.answerLabel}</h3>
        <p>Nothing is left to answer: the reply was answered, or its measure ended with the decision it rested on.</p>
        <div className="actions">
          <button type="button" onClick={props.onCancelCorrection}>
            Cancel
          </button>
        </div>
      </section>
    );
  }
  const { measure, reply } = found;
  const ended = measure.period?.state === "ended";
  const endsAt = measure.period?.endsAt ? dateTime(measure.period.endsAt) : "";
  const does =
    draft.answer === "kept"
      ? reply.onTime
        ? STANDING_WORDS.keep.onTime(dateTime(measure.earliestStart ?? ""), measure.kind === "terminate" ? null : measure.days)
        : ended
          ? STANDING_WORDS.keep.lateEnded(endsAt)
          : STANDING_WORDS.keep.late(endsAt)
      : reply.onTime
        ? STANDING_WORDS.reverse.onTime
        : ended
          ? STANDING_WORDS.reverse.lateEnded(endsAt)
          : STANDING_WORDS.reverse.late;
  return (
    <section className="panel composer" aria-labelledby="composer-title">
      <h3 id="composer-title">{STANDING_WORDS.reply.answerLabel}</h3>
      <p>{`The reply of ${dateTime(reply.filedAt)} to the decision of ${dateTime(decision.decidedAt)}.`}</p>
      {reply.text === null ? (
        <p className="hint">{STANDING_WORDS.reply.empty}</p>
      ) : (
        <div className="frame">
          <h4>{STANDING_WORDS.reply.writtenBy}</h4>
          <p className="frame-text">
            <UserText>{reply.text}</UserText>
          </p>
        </div>
      )}
      <fieldset>
        <legend>Answer</legend>
        {(["kept", "reversed"] as const).map((option) => (
          <label key={option}>
            <input type="radio" name="compose-answer" checked={draft.answer === option} disabled={props.busy} onChange={() => props.onChange(withAnswer(draft, decision, option))} />{" "}
            <span>{option === "kept" ? STANDING_WORDS.reply.keepLabel : STANDING_WORDS.reply.reverseLabel}</span>
          </label>
        ))}
        <p className="hint">{does}</p>
      </fieldset>
      <p className="hint">{STANDING_WORDS.reply.same}</p>
      {decision.needsAdmin ? <p className="hint">{STANDING_WORDS.reply.admin}</p> : null}
      <TextField id="compose-review-reason" label="Reason of the answer" kind="review_reason" rows={3} props={props} under={[STANDING_WORDS.reply.reason, COMPOSER.personalData]} />
      <Preview view={view} draft={draft} now={props.now} />
      <Confirm props={props} onCancel={props.onCancelCorrection} />
    </section>
  );
}

/**
 * 3e Task 4 (design, section 8.7): "Withdraw it for another measure": a correction that lifts an announced measure that
 * has not started, signed `replaced`, to make room for a measure at once; with [replace.what], and [replace.reply] when a
 * reply waits, which the withdrawal closes without an answer on its merits.
 */
function WithdrawView(props: ComposerViewProps) {
  const { view, role, draft } = props;
  const decision = view.decisions.find((decided) => decided.id === draft.reviewsDecisionId);
  const measure = decision ? withdrawable(view, decision, role) : null;
  if (!decision || measure === null) {
    return (
      <section className="panel composer" aria-labelledby="composer-title">
        <h3 id="composer-title">{STANDING_WORDS.replace.label}</h3>
        <p>Nothing can be withdrawn: the measure has started, was lifted, or no other measure is waiting for room.</p>
        <div className="actions">
          <button type="button" onClick={props.onCancelCorrection}>
            Cancel
          </button>
        </div>
      </section>
    );
  }
  return (
    <section className="panel composer" aria-labelledby="composer-title">
      <h3 id="composer-title">{STANDING_WORDS.replace.label}</h3>
      <p>{`The ${measure.kind === "terminate" ? "termination" : "suspension"} announced by the decision of ${dateTime(decision.decidedAt)}.`}</p>
      <p className="notice">{STANDING_WORDS.replace.what}</p>
      {measure.reply !== null && measure.reply.answeredAt === null ? <p className="hint">{STANDING_WORDS.replace.reply}</p> : null}
      <TextField id="compose-review-reason" label="Reason of the withdrawal" kind="review_reason" rows={3} props={props} under={[COMPOSER.personalData]} />
      <Preview view={view} draft={draft} now={props.now} />
      <Confirm props={props} onCancel={props.onCancelCorrection} />
    </section>
  );
}

/** Beside a decision whose reply waits: "Answer this reply", for whoever may ([reply.admin] where only an admin may). */
export function AnswerControl({ decision, role, disabled, onAnswer }: { decision: CaseDecision; role: StaffRole; disabled: boolean; onAnswer(decision: CaseDecision): void }) {
  if (!answerable(decision, role)) return null;
  return (
    <button type="button" onClick={() => onAnswer(decision)} disabled={disabled}>
      {STANDING_WORDS.reply.answerLabel}
    </button>
  );
}

/** Beside a decision whose announced measure has not started, while the account's case shows [conflict]: "Withdraw it for another measure", for an admin. */
export function WithdrawControl({ view, decision, role, disabled, onWithdraw }: { view: CaseView; decision: CaseDecision; role: StaffRole; disabled: boolean; onWithdraw(decision: CaseDecision): void }) {
  if (withdrawable(view, decision, role) === null) return null;
  return (
    <button type="button" onClick={() => onWithdraw(decision)} disabled={disabled}>
      {STANDING_WORDS.replace.label}
    </button>
  );
}

/** One measure's checkbox, with the image it names for an image measure, and the sentence that it changes nothing now when it would not. */
function Measure({ measure, props, images }: { measure: MeasureKind; props: ComposerViewProps; images: string[] }) {
  const { view, draft } = props;
  const ofImage = MEASURES[measure].target === "image";
  const held = draft.actions.find((action) => action.kind === measure);
  const action: DecisionActionParams = { kind: measure, mediaId: ofImage ? (held?.mediaId ?? images[0] ?? null) : null };
  if (ofImage && images.length === 0) return null;
  // 3e (design, section 8.3): the retirement is greyed with [retire.none] while the profile holds a placeholder.
  const retiring = measure === "retire_handle";
  const closed = retiring && !retireOpen(view);
  return (
    <li>
      <label>
        <input type="checkbox" checked={held !== undefined} disabled={props.busy || closed} onChange={(event) => props.onChange({ actions: toggled({ ...draft, actions: draft.actions.filter((other) => other.kind !== measure) }, action, event.target.checked) })} />{" "}
        <span>{MEASURES[measure].label}</span>
      </label>
      {ofImage && held !== undefined ? (
        <>
          {" "}
          <label htmlFor={`compose-image-${measure}`} className="visually-hidden">
            Which image
          </label>
          <select
            id={`compose-image-${measure}`}
            value={action.mediaId ?? ""}
            disabled={props.busy}
            onChange={(event) => props.onChange({ actions: [...draft.actions.filter((other) => other.kind !== measure), { kind: measure, mediaId: images.find((image) => image === event.target.value) ?? null }] })}
          >
            {/* Each image keeps its number in the snapshot, also when an image before it is not offered. */}
            {images.map((image) => (
              <option key={image} value={image}>
                {`Image ${snapshotImages(view).indexOf(image) + 1}`}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </>
      ) : null}
      {noEffectOf(view, action, draft.kind === "final" ? "final" : "interim") !== null ? <p className="hint">{COMPOSER.noEffect}</p> : null}
      {retiring ? <RetireNotes view={view} chosen={held !== undefined} closed={closed} /> : null}
    </li>
  );
}

/**
 * 3e (design, section 8.3): the sentences beside "Retire the handle": why it is greyed ([retire.none]); else what it does
 * ([retire.what]), that it is the decision's first measure once chosen ([retire.first]), and that the profile changed its
 * handle after the snapshot, whose handle is the one retired ([retire.moved]).
 */
function RetireNotes({ view, chosen, closed }: { view: CaseView; chosen: boolean; closed: boolean }) {
  if (closed) return <p className="hint">{STANDING_WORDS.retire.none}</p>;
  return (
    <>
      <p className="hint">{STANDING_WORDS.retire.what}</p>
      {chosen ? <p className="hint">{STANDING_WORDS.retire.first}</p> : null}
      {retireMoved(view) ? <p className="notice">{STANDING_WORDS.retire.moved}</p> : null}
    </>
  );
}

export function ComposerView(shown: ComposerViewProps) {
  const { view, role } = shown;
  // 3e Task 4: a correction that answers a reply, and one that withdraws an announced measure, have views of their own.
  if (shown.draft.kind === "correction") return shown.draft.answer !== undefined ? <AnswerView {...shown} /> : shown.draft.replaced === true ? <WithdrawView {...shown} /> : <CorrectionView {...shown} />;
  if (shown.draft.kind === "review") return <ReviewView {...shown} />;
  // What the draft holds is shown as far as it is offered, and that is what the key confirms.
  const draft = offeredDraft(view, role, shown.draft);
  const props: ComposerViewProps = { ...shown, draft };
  const kinds = kindsOffered(view, role);
  if (kinds.length === 0) {
    return (
      <section className="panel composer" aria-labelledby="composer-title">
        <h3 id="composer-title">Decide</h3>
        <p>{COMPOSER.closed}</p>
      </section>
    );
  }
  const kind = draft.kind === "final" ? "final" : "interim";
  const listed = outcomesListed(view, role);
  const outcome = draft.outcome;
  const restricts = outcome === "restricted";
  const law = restricts && draft.ground === "illegal";
  const suspect = suspectOpen(view);
  const sealChosen = draft.actions.some((action) => action.kind === "seal_media");
  const left = leftOpen(view);
  const rule = RULES.find((each) => each.id === draft.ruleId) ?? RULES[0];
  const postHidden = view.target.type === "post" && view.target.state !== null && view.target.state !== "visible";
  // Beside the two outcomes of a decision without a measure, whenever they are listed: on a post whose images cannot be
  // opened, such an answer to a report about an image is given unseen.
  const unseen = view.target.type === "post" && !view.imagesAllowed && listed.some((each) => each !== "restricted");
  // Under the facts and under the reason: on a case with an unanswered suspect item, never to say what the images are;
  // then the rule on personal data, with where the text goes. The texts of a decision without a measure never reach its author.
  const underTexts = [...(suspect.length > 0 ? [COMPOSER.neverWrite] : []), restricts ? COMPOSER.personalData : `${COMPOSER_WORDS.personalDataRule} ${COMPOSER_WORDS.staysInRecord}`];
  // 3e: the strike line on a post case, under "Restrict".
  const strike = strikeLine(view, draft);

  return (
    <section className="panel composer" aria-labelledby="composer-title">
      <h3 id="composer-title">Decide</h3>

      <fieldset>
        <legend>Outcome</legend>
        {kinds.includes("final") ? null : <p className="notice">{COMPOSER.adminFinal}</p>}
        {listed.map((each) => (
          <label key={each}>
            {/* An outcome without a measure is a final decision's: choosing it makes the decision final, and puts its measures away. */}
            <input
              type="radio"
              name="compose-outcome"
              checked={outcome === each}
              disabled={props.busy}
              onChange={() => props.onChange(each === "restricted" ? { outcome: each } : { outcome: each, kind: "final", actions: draft.actions.filter((action) => MEASURES[action.kind].lifts !== null) })}
            />{" "}
            <span>{COMPOSER_OUTCOMES[each]}</span>
          </label>
        ))}
        {unseen ? <p className="notice">{COMPOSER.unseen}</p> : null}
      </fieldset>

      {restricts ? (
        <fieldset>
          <legend>When</legend>
          {kinds.map((each) => (
            <label key={each}>
              {/* A measure belongs to one kind: the other kind's measures are put away with the change. */}
              <input type="radio" name="compose-kind" checked={kind === each} disabled={props.busy} onChange={() => props.onChange({ kind: each, actions: [] })} /> <span>{COMPOSER_KINDS[each]}</span>
            </label>
          ))}
          {/* 3e (design, section 8.2): not a choice; the console signs the strike exactly when this says it is given. */}
          {strike === null ? null : <p className="hint">{strike === "due" ? STANDING_WORDS.strike.due : STANDING_WORDS.strike.none[strike]}</p>}
        </fieldset>
      ) : null}

      {suspect.length > 0 ? (
        <div className="banner suspect">
          <p>{(view.suspicion?.reach.served ?? 0) > 0 ? COMPOSER.onlySealEnds : COMPOSER.noteEnds}</p>
          {sealOffered(view, kind, role) ? (
            <div className="actions">
              <button type="button" onClick={props.onSeal} disabled={props.busy || sealChosen}>
                {MEASURES.seal_media.label}
              </button>
              {/* The choice not to seal belongs beside the seal taken while deciding: an admin deciding the case seals for good or answers without a seal. */}
              {kind === "interim" ? (
                <button type="button" onClick={props.onDeclineOpen} disabled={props.busy || props.declining !== null}>
                  Do not seal now
                </button>
              ) : null}
            </div>
          ) : null}
          {props.declining === null || kind !== "interim" ? null : (
            <div className="dialog" role="group" aria-labelledby="decline-title">
              <h4 id="decline-title">Do not seal now</h4>
              <p>{COMPOSER.declineWords}</p>
              <label htmlFor="decline-reason">Why you do not seal now</label>
              <textarea id="decline-reason" rows={3} value={props.declining.reason} disabled={props.declining.busy} onChange={(event) => props.onDeclineChange(event.target.value)} />
              {props.declining.error ? (
                <p role="alert" className="error">
                  {props.declining.error}
                </p>
              ) : null}
              <div className="actions">
                <button type="button" onClick={props.onDeclineSave} disabled={props.declining.busy || props.declining.reason.trim() === ""} aria-busy={props.declining.busy}>
                  Record this choice
                </button>
                <button type="button" onClick={props.onDeclineClose} disabled={props.declining.busy}>
                  Cancel
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
          {role === "admin" && kind === "final" ? (
            <>
              <p>{COMPOSER.admin.endsFreeze}</p>
              <p>{COMPOSER.admin.unseen}</p>
              {view.target.type === "post" ? <p>{COMPOSER.admin.answersEarlier}</p> : null}
              <p>{COMPOSER.admin.afterwards}</p>
            </>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      ) : view.lane === 0 && (postHidden || view.target.type === "account") ? (
        <p className="notice">{view.target.type === "account" ? COMPOSER.noteAdviceAccount : COMPOSER.noteAdvicePost}</p>
      ) : null}

      {restricts ? (
        <>
          <label htmlFor="compose-ground">Ground</label>
          <select
            id="compose-ground"
            value={law ? "illegal" : "incompatible"}
            disabled={props.busy}
            onChange={(event) => props.onChange(event.target.value === "illegal" ? { ground: "illegal", terrorist: false } : { ground: "incompatible", terrorist: false, category: RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY[draft.ruleId] })}
          >
            <option value="incompatible">A korbat rule</option>
            {lawOffered(view, kind) ? <option value="illegal">The law</option> : null}
          </select>
          {law ? (
            <>
              <TextField id="compose-legal" label="Legal reference" kind="legal_reference" rows={2} props={props} under={[]} />
              <label>
                <input type="checkbox" checked={draft.terrorist} disabled={props.busy} onChange={(event) => props.onChange({ terrorist: event.target.checked })} /> <span>Terrorist content (Regulation (EU) 2021/784, Article 2(7))</span>
              </label>
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <label htmlFor="compose-rule">Rule</label>
              <select id="compose-rule" value={draft.ruleId} disabled={props.busy} onChange={(event) => props.onChange({ ruleId: event.target.value as RuleId, category: RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY[event.target.value as RuleId] })}>
                {/* A decision under R2 rests on a report or finding of child sexual abuse material: it is offered only where one is unanswered. */}
                {RULES.filter((each) => each.id !== "R2" || suspect.length > 0).map((each) => (
                  <option key={each.id} value={each.id}>{`${each.id}: ${each.title}`}</option>
                ))}
              </select>
              <p>{rule.text}</p>
              <div className="examples">
                <div>
                  <h5>Allowed</h5>
                  <ul>
                    {rule.allowed.map((example) => (
                      <li key={example}>{example}</li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h5>Not allowed</h5>
                  <ul>
                    {rule.notAllowed.map((example) => (
                      <li key={example}>{example}</li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                </div>
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </>
      ) : null}

      {/* Every decision carries a category, so every decision shows the one the key will confirm. */}
      <label htmlFor="compose-category">Category</label>
      <select id="compose-category" value={draft.category} disabled={props.busy} onChange={(event) => props.onChange({ category: event.target.value as TdbCategory })}>
        {FINDING_CATEGORIES.map((category) => (
          <option key={category} value={category}>
            {categoryLabel(category)}
          </option>
        ))}
      </select>

      {restricts ? (
        <fieldset>
          <legend>Measures</legend>
          <ul className="plain">
            {sealChosen ? (
              <li>
                <label>
                  <input type="checkbox" checked disabled={props.busy} onChange={() => props.onChange({ actions: draft.actions.filter((action) => action.kind !== "seal_media") })} /> <span>{`${MEASURES.seal_media.label}: chosen`}</span>
                </label>
              </li>
            ) : null}
            {measuresOffered(view, kind).map((measure) => (
              <Measure key={measure} measure={measure} props={props} images={imagesOffered(view, kind, measure)} />
            ))}
            {/* 3e (design, section 8.3): a suspension at once, on an account case's final restriction. */}
            <AtOnce props={props} />
            {/* 3e Task 4: an announced suspension, an announced termination and a termination at once. */}
            <StandingMeasureControl props={props} control="announce" />
            <StandingMeasureControl props={props} control="announceTerminate" />
            <StandingMeasureControl props={props} control="terminateAtOnce" />
            {kind === "interim" && view.target.type === "post" && hiddenWhileDeciding(view) ? (
              <li>
                <p className="hint">{COMPOSER.alreadyHidden}</p>
              </li>
            ) : null}
          </ul>
        </fieldset>
      ) : null}

      {/* A restriction needs both texts; a decision without a measure may carry them, for the case's record. */}
      <TextField id="compose-facts" label="Facts" kind="facts" rows={4} props={props} under={underTexts} />
      <TextField id="compose-reason" label="Reason" kind="reason" rows={4} props={props} under={underTexts} />

      {kind === "final" && left.length > 0 && liftable(view).length > 0 ? (
        <fieldset>
          <legend>Measures taken while deciding</legend>
          <ul className="plain">
            {liftable(view).map((reversal) => (
              <li key={`${reversal.kind} ${reversal.mediaId ?? ""}`}>
                <label>
                  <input type="checkbox" checked={holds(draft, reversal)} disabled={props.busy} onChange={(event) => props.onChange({ actions: toggled(draft, reversal, event.target.checked) })} />{" "}
                  <span>{`Lift: ${MEASURES[liftedKind(reversal)].label}`}</span>
                </label>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </fieldset>
      ) : null}
      {kind === "final" && suspect.length > 0 && left.length > 0 ? <p className="notice">{COMPOSER.staysOpen(throughSeqOf(view), left.length)}</p> : null}

      <Preview view={view} draft={draft} now={props.now} />
      <Confirm props={props} />
    </section>
  );
}

/** Beside a decision with a measure in force: "Lift what was done while deciding" or "Correct this decision", for whoever may. */
export function CorrectControl({ view, decision, role, disabled, onCorrect }: { view: CaseView; decision: CaseDecision; role: StaffRole; disabled: boolean; onCorrect(decision: CaseDecision): void }) {
  const offered = correctable(view, decision, role);
  if (offered === null) return null;
  return (
    <button type="button" onClick={() => onCorrect(decision)} disabled={disabled}>
      {offered.label}
    </button>
  );
}

/** Beside a pending appeal: "Review this appeal", for the person the API marked as one who may review it. */
export function ReviewControl({ view, decision, disabled, onReview }: { view: CaseView; decision: CaseDecision; disabled: boolean; onReview(decision: CaseDecision): void }) {
  if (reviewable(view, decision) === null) return null;
  return (
    <button type="button" onClick={() => onReview(decision)} disabled={disabled}>
      {APPEAL_WORDS.reviewLabel}
    </button>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { OVERVIEW_LIST_MAX, type AuditEntry, type StaffKey, type StaffMe, type StaffOverview, type StaffSession } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { StaffApi } from "../api";
import { APPEAL_WORDS, describeError, PROTECTION_LIFTED_WORDS, STANDING_WORDS } from "../messages";
import { CaseLink, NavLink } from "../nav";
import { parseCaseId, type CaseId, type ConsolePath } from "../router";
import { readSignInsAtOpening } from "../signins";
import { revokeSessionWithKey } from "../step-up";
import { clockTime, dateTime, Loaded, UserText, type Loadable } from "../ui";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import type { CredentialsLike } from "../webauthn";
import { counted, LANE_NAMES, waited } from "../words";

/**
 * One of the home screen's lists of the path for child sexual abuse material: each row with its time, its staff handle
 * as text, a link to its case built from a checked id, and the console's own words for what the row is. A list holds at
 * most OVERVIEW_LIST_MAX rows, and says how many there are when there are more.
 */
function StaffList<T extends { at: string; handle: string; caseId: string }>({ title, hint, empty, list, words, onOpenCase }: { title: string; hint: string; empty: string; list: { total: number; items: T[] }; words(item: T): ReactNode; onOpenCase(id: CaseId): void }) {
  return (
    <>
      <h3>{title}</h3>
      <p className="hint">{hint}</p>
      {list.items.length === 0 ? (
        <p>{empty}</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="reveals">
          {list.items.map((item, index) => {
            const id = parseCaseId(item.caseId);
            return (
              <li key={`${item.at} ${item.caseId} ${index}`}>
                <time dateTime={item.at}>{dateTime(item.at)}</time> <UserText>{item.handle}</UserText>{" "}
                {id ? (
                  <CaseLink id={id} onOpen={onOpenCase}>
                    the case
                  </CaseLink>
                ) : null}{" "}
                {words(item)}
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
      )}
      {list.total > list.items.length ? <p>{`Showing the newest ${OVERVIEW_LIST_MAX} of ${list.total}.`}</p> : null}
    </>
  );
}

/**
 * The runbook's sentence for a count of decisions not released, in the words of the runbook's own bullet (3c design,
 * section 13, Task 12(a)). It is a constant of its own so that the test of the README's runbook can hold the two to the
 * same words: what the home screen tells staff is what the runbook tells the operator.
 */
export const RELEASE_OVERDUE_RUNBOOK =
  "A count of decisions not released means the daily release keeps failing: notifiers are not told and re-examination windows do not open, so read the API log for moderation-dispatch and fix it the same day.";

/** The home screen's line when decided items wait for the daily release longer than it ever takes: the count, then the runbook's sentence for it. */
export const releaseOverdue = (n: number): string => `Decisions not released after 26 hours: ${n}. ${RELEASE_OVERDUE_RUNBOOK}`;

/**
 * The runbook's sentence for a count of late erasures, in the words of the runbook's own bullet (3c design, section 13,
 * Task 12(a)), a constant of its own for the same reason as the one above.
 */
export const ERASURE_OVERDUE_RUNBOOK =
  "A count of late erasures names the due rule whose step keeps failing, so evidence, an intake record or a notifier's name and address outlives its published period: read the API log for moderation-retention and for auth janitor: purge failed, and check that API_MODERATION_RETENTION was not left off after a restore (the API logs it at every start).";

/** What each count of late erasures counts, in the order the retention job's steps run; the two last are the image rows and the auth janitor's. */
export const ERASURE_OVERDUE_WORDS: Record<keyof StaffOverview["erasureOverdue"], string> = {
  drafts: "unconfirmed drafts",
  caseEvidence: "closed cases whose evidence is due",
  intakeRecords: "records of reports and notices",
  redactions: "R4 erasures",
  statements: "statements of deleted accounts",
  accessLog: "access log rows",
  images: "image rows nothing retains",
  contacts: "notifiers' contacts and confirmations",
};

/**
 * The home screen's line for what retention is late with by more than a day: each count above zero under its own words,
 * then the runbook's sentence. Null when nothing is late, and then the screen says nothing.
 */
export function erasureOverdue(counts: StaffOverview["erasureOverdue"]): string | null {
  const late = (Object.keys(ERASURE_OVERDUE_WORDS) as (keyof StaffOverview["erasureOverdue"])[]).filter((key) => counts[key] > 0).map((key) => `${ERASURE_OVERDUE_WORDS[key]}: ${counts[key]}`);
  return late.length === 0 ? null : `Erasures more than a day late: ${late.join("; ")}. ${ERASURE_OVERDUE_RUNBOOK}`;
}

/**
 * What every staff member sees of the cases (3c design, section 8): the lanes with their open cases and how long the
 * oldest has waited, the appeals waiting (with those this person may review and those nobody may review now), every reveal of a source in the last 30 days with its staff handle and its
 * case, the decisions that lifted the protection of reported images, the recorded choices not to seal and the seals
 * taken while deciding that are in force, what each staff account viewed and opened today, the mails that wait or were
 * given up, and the emergency switch. Counts, times, handles and case links only.
 */
/**
 * The home screen's appeals line (3c design, section 8): how many wait, how many of them the reading person may review,
 * and how many no staff account may review now.
 */
export function appealsLine(overview: Pick<StaffOverview, "appealsWaiting" | "appealsYouMayReview" | "appealsWithoutReviewer">): string {
  const { appealsWaiting: waiting, appealsYouMayReview: yours, appealsWithoutReviewer: without } = overview;
  if (waiting === 0) return "No appeal waits.";
  const parts = [waiting === 1 ? "1 appeal waits" : `${waiting} appeals wait`, `you may review ${yours === 0 ? "none" : yours}`];
  if (without > 0) parts.push(`${without} ${without === 1 ? "has" : "have"} no possible reviewer now`);
  return `${parts.join("; ")}.`;
}

/**
 * 3e Task 4 (design, section 8.8): the home screen's two lines, each shown when above zero and each a link to its list:
 * the replies waiting, with the oldest one's age, and the accounts at the ladder's number of strikes. Without a way to
 * move between pages (a test's rendering), each is plain text.
 */
function StandingLines({ overview, now, onNavigate }: { overview: StaffOverview; now: number; onNavigate?: (path: ConsolePath) => void }) {
  const { repliesWaiting, strikeAccounts } = overview;
  const line = (text: string, to: ConsolePath) => (onNavigate ? <NavLink to={to} onNavigate={onNavigate}>{text}</NavLink> : text);
  return (
    <>
      {repliesWaiting.count > 0 ? <p>{line(STANDING_WORDS.home.replies(repliesWaiting.count, repliesWaiting.oldestAt === null ? "" : waited(repliesWaiting.oldestAt, now)), "/queue")}</p> : null}
      {strikeAccounts > 0 ? <p>{line(STANDING_WORDS.home.strikes(strikeAccounts), "/standing")}</p> : null}
    </>
  );
}

export function OverviewView({ overview, now, onOpenCase, onNavigate }: { overview: StaffOverview; now: number; onOpenCase(id: CaseId): void; onNavigate?: (path: ConsolePath) => void }) {
  const { reveals, mailsWaiting, mailsFailed } = overview;
  const lateErasures = erasureOverdue(overview.erasureOverdue);
  const waiting = mailsWaiting.receipts + mailsWaiting.authorMails + mailsWaiting.outcomes;
  const failed = mailsFailed.receipts + mailsFailed.authorMails + mailsFailed.outcomes;
  const mails = (m: StaffOverview["mailsWaiting"]) => `${counted(m.receipts, "receipt", "receipts")}, ${counted(m.authorMails, "statement to an author", "statements to authors")}, ${counted(m.outcomes, "outcome", "outcomes")}`;
  return (
    <>
      <h3>Cases</h3>
      <ul className="lanes">
        {overview.lanes.map((lane) => (
          <li key={lane.lane}>{`${LANE_NAMES[lane.lane]}: ${lane.open === 0 || lane.oldestAt === null ? "no open case" : `${counted(lane.open, "case", "cases")}, oldest ${waited(lane.oldestAt, now)}`}`}</li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      <p>{appealsLine(overview)}</p>
      {overview.appealsWaiting > 0 ? <p className="hint">{APPEAL_WORDS.reviewerRule}</p> : null}
      <StandingLines overview={overview} now={now} onNavigate={onNavigate} />
      <p>{overview.deferUnproven ? "The emergency switch is on: cases whose unanswered items all come from unproven sources are listed after the others of their lane." : "The emergency switch is off."}</p>
      {overview.releaseOverdue > 0 ? (
        <p role="alert" className="error">
          {releaseOverdue(overview.releaseOverdue)}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {lateErasures !== null ? (
        <p role="alert" className="error">
          {lateErasures}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {waiting > 0 ? <p className="notice">{`Mails waiting for more than an hour: ${mails(mailsWaiting)}.`}</p> : null}
      {failed > 0 ? <p className="notice">{`Mails given up in the last 30 days: ${mails(mailsFailed)}.`}</p> : null}

      <h3>Sources revealed in the last 30 days</h3>
      <p className="hint">Every staff account's. A reveal nobody expected means someone else holds a staff key: tell the operator.</p>
      {reveals.items.length === 0 ? (
        <p>No source was revealed in the last 30 days.</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="reveals">
          {reveals.items.map((item, index) => {
            const id = parseCaseId(item.caseId);
            return (
              <li key={`${item.at} ${item.caseId} ${index}`}>
                <time dateTime={item.at}>{dateTime(item.at)}</time> <UserText>{item.handle}</UserText>{" "}
                {id ? (
                  <CaseLink id={id} onOpen={onOpenCase}>
                    the case
                  </CaseLink>
                ) : null}
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
      )}
      {reveals.total > reveals.items.length ? <p>{`Showing the newest ${OVERVIEW_LIST_MAX} of ${reveals.total}.`}</p> : null}

      <StaffList
        title="Protection of reported images lifted in the last 30 days"
        hint="Every staff account's: each lifted seal, and each admin's answer to a report or finding of child sexual abuse material without a seal. One nobody expected means someone else holds a staff key: tell the operator."
        empty="No decision lifted the protection of reported images in the last 30 days."
        list={overview.protectionLifted}
        words={(item) => PROTECTION_LIFTED_WORDS[item.kind]}
        onOpenCase={onOpenCase}
      />
      <StaffList
        title="Choices not to seal in the last 30 days"
        hint="Every staff account's: each recorded choice not to seal reported images, whose reason is on its case."
        empty="Nobody recorded a choice not to seal in the last 30 days."
        list={overview.sealsDeclined}
        words={() => "Chose not to seal"}
        onOpenCase={onOpenCase}
      />
      <StaffList
        title="Seals taken while deciding that are in force"
        hint="Which images stand sealed until an admin answers, and by whom."
        empty="No seal taken while deciding is in force."
        list={overview.interimSeals}
        words={(item) => `${counted(item.images, "image", "images")} on ${counted(item.posts, "post", "posts")}`}
        onOpenCase={onOpenCase}
      />

      <h3>Today, by staff account</h3>
      {overview.imagesToday.length === 0 && overview.findingsToday.length === 0 ? (
        <p>No image was viewed and no finding opened today.</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="today">
          {overview.imagesToday.map((row) => (
            <li key={`images ${row.handle}`}>
              <UserText>{row.handle}</UserText>
              {`: ${counted(row.count, "image", "images")} viewed`}
            </li>
          ))}
          {overview.findingsToday.map((row) => (
            <li key={`findings ${row.handle}`}>
              <UserText>{row.handle}</UserText>
              {`: ${counted(row.count, "finding", "findings")} opened`}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

/**
 * The home screen (3a design, section 9; 3c design, section 8): who is signed in and with which role, the session's
 * absolute end, the cases' overview, every staff account's sign-ins of the last 7 days, the person's own staff sessions
 * with "Sign out that session" confirmed by the key, and the person's keys. Keys are added and revoked only with the
 * command line, so no button here touches them.
 */
export interface HomeViewProps {
  me: StaffMe;
  overview: Loadable<StaffOverview>;
  /** The time the overview's waiting times are counted to. */
  now: number;
  onOpenCase(id: CaseId): void;
  /** 3e: a move to one of the console's pages, which the home screen's lines of Task 4 link to. */
  onNavigate?: (path: ConsolePath) => void;
  signIns: Loadable<AuditEntry[]>;
  sessions: Loadable<StaffSession[]>;
  keys: Loadable<StaffKey[]>;
  /** The handle of the session whose revocation is under way. */
  revoking: string | null;
  notice: string | null;
  error: string | null;
  onRevoke(handle: string): void;
}

export function HomeView({ me, overview, now, onOpenCase, onNavigate, signIns, sessions, keys, revoking, notice, error, onRevoke }: HomeViewProps) {
  return (
    <section aria-labelledby="home-title">
      <h2 id="home-title">Home</h2>
      <p>
        Signed in as <UserText>{me.handle}</UserText>, {me.role}.
      </p>
      <p>{`Signed in until ${clockTime(me.absoluteExpiresAt)}.`}</p>
      {notice ? (
        <p role="status" className="notice">
          {notice}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {error ? (
        <p role="alert" className="error">
          {error}
        </p>
      ) : null}

      <Loaded value={overview} render={(value) => <OverviewView overview={value} now={now} onOpenCase={onOpenCase} onNavigate={onNavigate} />} />

      <h3>Staff sign-ins in the last 7 days</h3>
      <p className="hint">Every staff account's, newest first. A sign-in nobody recognises means someone else holds a staff key: tell the operator.</p>
      <Loaded
        value={signIns}
        render={(list) =>
          list.length === 0 ? (
            <p>No staff sign-ins in the last 7 days.</p>
          ) : (
            <ul className="signins">
              {list.map((entry) => (
                <li key={entry.seq}>
                  <time dateTime={entry.createdAt}>{dateTime(entry.createdAt)}</time> <UserText>{entry.actorHandle ?? "no handle"}</UserText>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          )
        }
      />

      <h3>Your staff sessions</h3>
      <p className="hint">Signing out another session asks your staff key to confirm it.</p>
      <Loaded
        value={sessions}
        render={(list) => (
          <table>
            <caption className="visually-hidden">Your staff sessions</caption>
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th scope="col">Browser</th>
                <th scope="col">Started</th>
                <th scope="col">Last used</th>
                <th scope="col">
                  <span className="visually-hidden">Sign out</span>
                </th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {list.map((session) => (
                <tr key={session.handle}>
                  <td>
                    <UserText>{session.browser}</UserText>
                  </td>
                  <td>{dateTime(session.createdAt)}</td>
                  <td>{dateTime(session.lastUsedAt)}</td>
                  <td>
                    {session.current ? (
                      "This session"
                    ) : (
                      <button type="button" onClick={() => onRevoke(session.handle)} disabled={revoking !== null} aria-busy={revoking === session.handle}>
                        Sign out that session
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        )}
      />

      <h3>Your staff keys</h3>
      <p className="hint">The operator adds and revokes staff keys with the staff command line.</p>
      <Loaded
        value={keys}
        render={(list) => (
          <ul className="keys">
            {list.map((key) => (
              <li key={key.id}>
                <UserText>{key.name}</UserText>
                {`: added ${dateTime(key.createdAt)}, ${key.lastUsedAt === null ? "never used" : `last used ${dateTime(key.lastUsedAt)}`}`}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      />
    </section>
  );
}

/** Runs one read and hands its outcome to `set`, unless the screen has gone meanwhile. */
function load<T>(alive: { current: boolean }, set: (value: Loadable<T>) => void, read: () => Promise<T>): void {
  read().then(
    (value) => alive.current && set({ state: "ready", value }),
    (err: unknown) => alive.current && set({ state: "failed", message: describeError(err) }),
  );
}

/** The person's staff sessions, marked: the screen reads them when it opens and after a revocation the person asked for. */
function readSessions(api: StaffApi, alive: { current: boolean }, set: (value: Loadable<StaffSession[]>) => void): void {
  load(alive, set, async () => (await api.sessions({ activity: true })).sessions);
}

/** Where the screen's lists go as each read finishes. */
export interface HomeLists {
  overview(value: Loadable<StaffOverview>): void;
  signIns(value: Loadable<AuditEntry[]>): void;
  sessions(value: Loadable<StaffSession[]>): void;
  keys(value: Loadable<StaffKey[]>): void;
}

/**
 * What the screen reads when it opens, every read marked, since opening the screen is its person's action. It takes no
 * session: the sign-ins' 7 days are counted from a /me read now (readSignInsAtOpening), never from the session the page
 * holds, which can be hours old.
 */
export function openHome(api: StaffApi, alive: { current: boolean }, set: HomeLists): void {
  load(alive, set.signIns, () => readSignInsAtOpening(api));
  load(alive, set.overview, () => api.overview({ activity: true }));
  readSessions(api, alive, set.sessions);
  load(alive, set.keys, async () => (await api.keys({ activity: true })).keys);
}

export function Home({ me, api, credentials, onOpenCase, onNavigate }: { me: StaffMe; api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike; onOpenCase(id: CaseId): void; onNavigate?: (path: ConsolePath) => void }) {
  const [overview, setOverview] = useState<Loadable<StaffOverview>>({ state: "loading" });
  const [now, setNow] = useState(() => Date.now());
  const [signIns, setSignIns] = useState<Loadable<AuditEntry[]>>({ state: "loading" });
  const [sessions, setSessions] = useState<Loadable<StaffSession[]>>({ state: "loading" });
  const [keys, setKeys] = useState<Loadable<StaffKey[]>>({ state: "loading" });
  const [revoking, setRevoking] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const alive = useRef(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    openHome(api, alive, {
      overview: (value) => {
        setNow(Date.now());
        setOverview(value);
      },
      signIns: setSignIns,
      sessions: setSessions,
      keys: setKeys,
    });
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
    };
    // Read once per opening of the screen, never again when the idle timer's reads change `me`; the API client never
    // changes while the page lives.
  }, [api]);

  const revoke = async (handle: string) => {
    setRevoking(handle);
    setNotice(null);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const outcome = await revokeSessionWithKey({ api, credentials }, handle);
      if (!alive.current) return;
      setNotice(outcome === "revoked" ? "That session is signed out." : "That session had already ended.");
      readSessions(api, alive, setSessions);
    } catch (err) {
      if (alive.current) setError(describeError(err));
    } finally {
      if (alive.current) setRevoking(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <HomeView me={me} overview={overview} now={now} onOpenCase={onOpenCase} onNavigate={onNavigate} signIns={signIns} sessions={sessions} keys={keys} revoking={revoking} notice={notice} error={error} onRevoke={(handle) => void revoke(handle)} />
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { FINDING_CATEGORIES, FindingRequest, REPLY_AIM_HOURS, RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY, RULE_IDS, type QueueReply, type QueueRow, type RuleId, type TdbCategory } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { getRule } from "@korbat/rules";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import type { StaffApi } from "../api";
import { systemClock, type Clock } from "../idle";
import { describeError, FINDING_WORDS, STANDING_WORDS } from "../messages";
import { CaseLink } from "../nav";
import { parseCaseId, type CaseId } from "../router";
import { dateTime, Loaded, type Loadable } from "../ui";
import { categoryLabel, counted, LANE_NAMES, waited } from "../words";

/**
 * The queue (3c design, sections 7.3 and 8): open cases by lane and then by age, as the API orders them. Nothing here
 * weighs a case: no count of reports, no standing of a reporter. The page reads the queue again every 60 seconds without
 * the activity mark, so a queue left open never keeps a staff session alive. Beside it, "Open a case" takes a korbat link
 * on the moderator's own finding.
 */

/** How often the queue reads itself again. */
export const QUEUE_REFRESH_MS = 60_000;

/**
 * The screen's reads of the queue, on a clock that is the page's or a test's (as the idle timer's is): one now, marked,
 * since opening the screen is its person's action, and one every QUEUE_REFRESH_MS after it, unmarked, since those are the
 * page's own and must never move the session's idle end. Answers what ends them, for when the screen is left.
 */
export function startQueueReads(clock: Clock, read: (activity: boolean) => void): () => void {
  let handle: unknown = null;
  let ended = false;
  const refresh = () => {
    if (ended) return;
    read(false);
    handle = clock.setTimeout(refresh, QUEUE_REFRESH_MS);
  };
  read(true);
  handle = clock.setTimeout(refresh, QUEUE_REFRESH_MS);
  return () => {
    ended = true;
    clock.clearTimeout(handle);
  };
}

/** What marks a row beyond its lane and age: the console's own words for what its unanswered items are. */
export function marksOf(row: QueueRow): string[] {
  const marks: string[] = [];
  if (row.allegesIllegal) marks.push("notice under Art. 16");
  if (row.suspect) marks.push("CSAM: no images");
  if (row.reexamination) marks.push("re-examination");
  if (row.deferred) marks.push("deferred");
  return marks;
}

export interface FindingFormState {
  link: string;
  ruleId: RuleId;
  category: TdbCategory;
  busy: boolean;
  error: string | null;
}

export interface QueueViewProps {
  rows: Loadable<QueueRow[]>;
  /** 3e Task 4: the replies no decision answered, oldest first, which lead the queue's first page; never their text. */
  replies?: QueueReply[];
  /** Whether the API named a further page. */
  more: boolean;
  loadingMore: boolean;
  /** The time the ages are counted to. */
  now: number;
  finding: FindingFormState;
  onLoadMore(): void;
  onOpenCase(id: CaseId): void;
  onFindingChange(change: Partial<Pick<FindingFormState, "link" | "ruleId" | "category">>): void;
  onFindingSubmit(): void;
}

/**
 * 3e Task 4 (design, section 8.5): one reply in "Replies to answer": how long it has waited; before the start (the
 * suspension is held) or after it, until or since its end; the measure; and whether it has waited longer than korbat's
 * aim. The reply's text is read on the case page, where the access log and the recusal apply.
 */
export function replyWords(reply: QueueReply, now: number): string[] {
  const where = reply.onTime
    ? STANDING_WORDS.reply.before
    : reply.endsAt !== null && Date.parse(reply.endsAt) <= now
      ? STANDING_WORDS.reply.afterEnded(dateTime(reply.endsAt))
      : STANDING_WORDS.reply.after(reply.endsAt === null ? "" : dateTime(reply.endsAt));
  const what = reply.kind === "terminate" ? STANDING_WORDS.reply.termination : STANDING_WORDS.reply.suspension(reply.days ?? 1);
  const late = now - Date.parse(reply.filedAt) > REPLY_AIM_HOURS * 60 * 60 * 1000 ? [STANDING_WORDS.reply.overAim] : [];
  return [where, what, ...late];
}

function Replies({ replies, now, onOpenCase }: { replies: QueueReply[]; now: number; onOpenCase(id: CaseId): void }) {

  );
}

/** The finding a form's values make, or null when the link is no web address of at most 300 characters: the contracts' schema decides. */
export function findingOf(form: Pick<FindingFormState, "link" | "ruleId" | "category">): FindingRequest | null {
  const parsed = FindingRequest.safeParse({ target: { kind: "link", url: form.link.trim() }, ground: "rule", ruleId: form.ruleId, category: form.category });
  return parsed.success ? parsed.data : null;
}

/**
 * Reads the queue from its start through as many pages as the screen shows, one after the other. `activity` says whether
 * a person's action started the read: the screen's opening and "Load more" do, its own refresh every minute does not.
 */
export async function readQueue(api: StaffApi, pages: number, activity: boolean): Promise<{ rows: QueueRow[]; next: string | null; replies: QueueReply[] }> {
  const rows: QueueRow[] = [];
  const replies: QueueReply[] = [];
  let cursor: string | null = null;
  for (let page = 0; page < Math.max(1, pages); page++) {
    const answer = await api.queue(cursor, { activity });
    rows.push(...answer.cases);
    // Only the first page carries the replies.
    replies.push(...answer.replies);
    cursor = answer.nextCursor;
    if (cursor === null) break;
  }
  return { rows, next: cursor, replies };
}

export function Queue({ api, onOpenCase, clock = systemClock }: { api: StaffApi; onOpenCase(id: CaseId): void; clock?: Clock }) {
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<Loadable<QueueRow[]>>({ state: "loading" });
  const [replies, setReplies] = useState<QueueReply[]>([]);
  const [next, setNext] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [pages, setPages] = useState(1);
  const [loadingMore, setLoadingMore] = useState(false);
  const [now, setNow] = useState(() => Date.now());
  const [finding, setFinding] = useState<FindingFormState>({ link: "", ruleId: "R1", category: RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY.R1, busy: false, error: null });
  const alive = useRef(true);
  const shown = useRef(1);

  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    const read = (activity: boolean) =>
      readQueue(api, shown.current, activity).then(
        (answer) => {
          if (!alive.current) return;
          setRows({ state: "ready", value: answer.rows });
          setReplies(answer.replies);
          setNext(answer.next);
          setNow(Date.now());
        },
        // A refresh that fails leaves the list as it was; only the first read shows its failure.
        (err: unknown) => alive.current && activity && setRows({ state: "failed", message: describeError(err) }),
      );
    const stop = startQueueReads(clock, (activity) => void read(activity));
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
      stop();
    };
    // Read from the opening of the screen on; neither the API client nor the clock changes while the page lives.
  }, [api, clock]);

  const loadMore = async () => {
    if (next === null || rows.state !== "ready") return;
    setLoadingMore(true);
    try {
      const answer = await api.queue(next, { activity: true });
      if (!alive.current) return;
      shown.current = pages + 1;
      setPages(pages + 1);
      setRows({ state: "ready", value: [...rows.value, ...answer.cases] });
      setNext(answer.nextCursor);
    } catch (err) {
      if (alive.current) setRows({ state: "failed", message: describeError(err) });
    } finally {
      if (alive.current) setLoadingMore(false);
    }
  };

  const openFinding = async () => {
    const request = findingOf(finding);
    if (request === null) {
      setFinding((form) => ({ ...form, error: FINDING_WORDS.invalid_request }));
      return;
    }
    setFinding((form) => ({ ...form, busy: true, error: null }));
    try {
      const answer = await api.openFinding(request, { activity: true });
      const id = parseCaseId(answer.caseId);
      if (!alive.current) return;
      setFinding((form) => ({ ...form, busy: false, link: "" }));
      if (id) onOpenCase(id);
    } catch (err) {
      if (alive.current) setFinding((form) => ({ ...form, busy: false, error: describeError(err, FINDING_WORDS) }));
    }
  };

  return (
    <QueueView
      rows={rows}
      replies={replies}
      more={next !== null}
      loadingMore={loadingMore}
      now={now}
      finding={finding}
      onLoadMore={() => void loadMore()}
      onOpenCase={onOpenCase}
      // Choosing a rule presets its category; the moderator may still choose another.
      onFindingChange={(change) => setFinding((form) => ({ ...form, ...change, ...(change.ruleId ? { category: RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY[change.ruleId] } : {}), error: null }))}
      onFindingSubmit={() => void openFinding()}
    />
  );
}
```

```ts
import type { Logger } from "pino";
import type { AuthForAccount } from "../auth";
import type { MediaForAccount } from "../media";
import type { ModerationForAccount } from "../moderation";
import type { RateLimitStore } from "../middleware/rate-limit";
import type { SocialForAccount } from "../social";

/** The codes this module raises itself; the modules it calls raise their own, which the app's error handler also renders. */
export type AccountErrorKind = "not_found" | "invalid_request" | "rate_limited" | "service_unavailable";
export type AccountErrorStatus = 400 | 404 | 429 | 503;

const MESSAGES: Record<AccountErrorKind, string> = {
  not_found: "Not found.",
  invalid_request: "Some details are missing or invalid.",
  rate_limited: "Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.",
  service_unavailable: "That could not be done right now. Try again in a moment.",
};

/** An expected, user-facing failure. The HTTP layer turns it into an ErrorEnvelope with this code and status. */
export class AccountError extends Error {
  constructor(
    readonly code: AccountErrorKind,
    readonly status: AccountErrorStatus,
    message: string = MESSAGES[code],
    /** Set for rate_limited and service_unavailable so the response can carry Retry-After. */
    readonly retryAfterSeconds?: number,
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "AccountError";
  }
}

export function accountErrorMessage(code: AccountErrorKind): string {
```

```ts
import { createJob, type JobLock } from "../lib/jobs";
import type { AccountDeps } from "./context";
import { purge } from "./flows/deletion";

/** How often the job looks for deletions left half done (1b design, section 11): nothing stays behind for longer than this. */
export const PURGE_INTERVAL_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;

export interface PurgeReport {
  purged: number;
  failed: number;
  /** 3e: the terminated accounts this round took down (the moderation module's takeDownDue). */
  terminated: number;
}

/**
 * One round. First (3e design, section 7.8 step 3) the terminated accounts whose termination is final for their author
 * are taken down, through the moderation module's takeDownDue, which holds each account's profile and its case while the
 * auth module takes the account down: a failed take-down is counted in `failed`, and the call stands in a try of its own,
 * so whatever happens there the round goes on, and no person's own deletion ever waits on a termination that cannot be
 * taken down. Then every account the auth module reports as deleted but not purged is run through the purge, oldest
 * deletion first, the accounts just taken down among them. A failure is logged with the account and counted; the account
 * stays pending and is tried again next round. A plain function, so tests call it directly.
 */
export async function purgePending(deps: AccountDeps): Promise<PurgeReport> {
  const report: PurgeReport = { purged: 0, failed: 0, terminated: 0 };
  if (deps.moderation) {
    try {
      const taken = await deps.moderation.takeDownDue((account, facts) => deps.auth.takeDownTerminated(account, facts));
      report.terminated += taken.terminated;
      report.failed += taken.failed;
    } catch (err) {
      deps.log.error({ err }, "account purge: the terminations due could not be taken down this round; the deletions are purged all the same");
    }
  }
  for (const userId of await deps.auth.pendingPurges()) {
    try {
      await purge(deps, userId);
      report.purged++;
    } catch (err) {
      report.failed++;
      deps.log.error({ err, userId }, "account purge: the account could not be purged; it stays pending for the next round");
    }
  }
  // As the janitor: a round that did something is logged with its counts, an idle one is not.
  if (report.purged > 0 || report.failed > 0 || report.terminated > 0) deps.log.info(report, "account purge: round finished");
  return report;
}

/** Runs the round every five minutes under the shared lock job:account-purge, one instance at a time. */
export function createPurgeJob(deps: AccountDeps, lock: JobLock) {
  return createJob({ name: "account-purge", intervalMs: PURGE_INTERVAL_MS, lockTtlMs: PURGE_INTERVAL_MS, lock, log: deps.log, run: () => purgePending(deps) });
}
```
